snaps.d:
581 年二月北周静帝禅位于丞相杨坚，隋朝建立，年号开皇。隋承北周之地，据有黄河、长江以北及巴蜀；南朝陈以长江为界据江南、岭南；江陵的后梁是隋的附庸，交州李佛子割据自立，营州尚有北齐旧将高宝宁。
北方突厥沙钵略可汗控弦数十万，东自辽海、西至西海，是隋最大的外患；西陲吐谷浑据青海，高昌、焉耆、龟兹、于阗诸国附于突厥；东北高句丽、百济、新罗三国鼎立。
snaps.te: Yang Jian supplants the Zhou · Sui founded
snaps.de:
In the 2nd month of 581 Emperor Jing of Northern Zhou abdicated in favor of his chancellor Yang Jian; the Sui dynasty was founded, with the era name Kaihuang. Sui inherited the Northern Zhou lands, holding the country north of the Yellow River and the Yangtze as well as Ba and Shu; Chen of the Southern Dynasties held Jiangnan and Lingnan, with the Yangtze as the border; the Later Liang at Jiangling was a Sui vassal; Lý Phật Tử had set himself up independently in Jiaozhou; and Yingzhou was still held by Gao Baoning, a former Northern Qi general.
To the north the Turks under Ishbara Qaghan had several hundred thousand archers and ranged from the Liao Sea in the east to the Western Sea in the west: the greatest external threat to Sui. On the western frontier the Tuyuhun held Qinghai, and Gaochang, Karasahr, Kucha, Khotan and other states were subject to the Turks; in the northeast the three kingdoms of Goguryeo, Baekje and Silla stood in rivalry.

snaps.d:
583 年隋分化突厥，沙钵略与阿波、达头反目，突厥分裂为东西两部；同年隋迁入新都大兴城，营州高宝宁败亡。584 年沙钵略向隋称臣，587 年隋废后梁，收江陵。
588 年冬，晋王杨广为元帅，五十一万大军分八路伐陈；589 年正月贺若弼自广陵渡江、韩擒虎自横江夜渡袭采石，攻入建康，陈后主被俘。岭南冼夫人率众归隋，自西晋末年以来近三百年的分裂结束。
snaps.te: Conquest of Chen · north and south reunited
snaps.de:
In 583 Sui set the Turkic leaders against one another: Ishbara fell out with Apa and Tardu, and the Turks split into eastern and western halves. The same year Sui moved into its new capital, Daxing City, and Gao Baoning of Yingzhou was defeated and perished. In 584 Ishbara submitted to Sui as a vassal; in 587 Sui abolished the Later Liang and took over Jiangling.
In winter 588, with Yang Guang, Prince of Jin, as commander-in-chief, an army of 510,000 advanced on Chen along eight routes; in the 1st month of 589 Heruo Bi crossed the Yangtze from Guangling, and Han Qinhu crossed by night from Hengjiang to take Caishi; they broke into Jiankang, and the Last Ruler of Chen was captured. Lady Xian of Lingnan led her people to submit to Sui, and the division that had lasted nearly 300 years since the end of the Western Jin came to an end.

snaps.d:
599 年东突厥突利可汗（启民）南投，隋为之筑大利城；603 年西突厥达头可汗败走，启民尽有东突厥之众，称臣于隋。602 年刘方入交州，李佛子降。
604 年七月文帝崩于仁寿宫，太子杨广即位（炀帝）。605 年三月营建东都洛阳，同时征发河南、淮北百余万人开通济渠，重修邗沟，八月龙舟南巡江都。同年刘方击破林邑，入其都典冲，隋于其地置比景、海阴、林邑三郡。
snaps.te: Emperor Yang enthroned · Eastern Capital begun
snaps.de:
In 599 Tuli Qaghan (Qimin) of the Eastern Turks came south to submit, and Sui built Dali City for him; in 603 Tardu Qaghan of the Western Turks was defeated and fled, and Qimin took over all the Eastern Turkic people and declared himself a Sui vassal. In 602 Liu Fang entered Jiaozhou and Lý Phật Tử surrendered.
In the 7th month of 604 Emperor Wen died at the Renshou Palace, and Crown Prince Yang Guang took the throne (Emperor Yang). In the 3rd month of 605 work began on the Eastern Capital, Luoyang; at the same time over a million people from Henan and Huaibei were conscripted to dig the Tongji Canal, the Han Canal was rebuilt, and in the 8th month the emperor toured south to Jiangdu in his dragon boats. The same year Liu Fang defeated Linyi (Champa) and entered its capital, Simhapura, and Sui set up three commanderies there: Bijing, Haiyin and Linyi.

snaps.d:
607 年炀帝北巡至启民可汗牙帐，发丁男百万修长城；608 年开永济渠，裴矩经营西域，伊吾归附，筑新伊吾城。
609 年炀帝亲征吐谷浑，伏允可汗南逃，隋于其地置西海、河源、鄯善、且末四郡；六月炀帝出大斗拔谷，至张掖，高昌王麴伯雅、伊吾吐屯设等西域二十七国君长谒见。是年隋有郡一百九十、县一千二百五十五、户八百九十余万，为隋代极盛。
snaps.te: Western tour to Zhangye · Sui at its greatest extent
snaps.de:
In 607 Emperor Yang toured the north as far as the royal camp of Qimin Qaghan and conscripted a million able-bodied men to repair the Great Wall; in 608 the Yongji Canal was opened, Pei Ju managed the Western Regions, Yiwu submitted, and New Yiwu City was built.
In 609 Emperor Yang personally campaigned against the Tuyuhun; Fuyun Qaghan fled south, and Sui set up four commanderies in his lands: Xihai, Heyuan, Shanshan and Qiemo. In the 6th month the emperor came out through the Dadouba Valley to Zhangye, where Qu Boya, King of Gaochang, the Tudun Shad of Yiwu and other rulers of 27 states of the Western Regions came to pay homage. That year Sui had 190 commanderies, 1,255 counties and over 8.9 million households: the height of the Sui.

snaps.d:
611 年炀帝下诏征高句丽，于涿郡集结，山东、河北水旱相仍，王薄在长白山作《无向辽东浪死歌》起事，窦建德、高士达聚众高鸡泊，隋末民变由此而起。
612 年正月一百一十三万大军自涿郡出发，三月渡辽水，围辽东城不下；宇文述、于仲文率三十万五千人直趋平壤，七月在萨水被乙支文德半渡而击，还至辽东者仅二千七百人。隋仅取辽水以西的武厉逻，置辽东郡。
snaps.te: First Goguryeo campaign · defeat on the Salsu
snaps.de:
In 611 Emperor Yang issued an edict for a campaign against Goguryeo, with troops assembling at Zhuo Commandery. Shandong and Hebei suffered flood and drought one after another; Wang Bo composed the song "Do Not Go to Liaodong to Die in Vain" and rose in revolt at Changbai Mountain, and Dou Jiande and Gao Shida gathered followers at Gaoji Marsh. So began the popular risings of the late Sui.
In the 1st month of 612 an army of 1,130,000 set out from Zhuo Commandery, crossed the Liao River in the 3rd month, and besieged Yodong Fortress without taking it; Yuwen Shu and Yu Zhongwen led 305,000 men straight for Pyongyang, and in the 7th month Eulji Mundeok struck them halfway across the Salsu River; only 2,700 made it back to Liaodong. Sui took only Wuliluo, west of the Liao River, where it set up Liaodong Commandery.

snaps.d:
613 年杨玄感乘二征高句丽之机在黎阳起兵，围东都，两月而败；614 年三征高句丽，高句丽请降而止。615 年八月炀帝北巡，被始毕可汗围于雁门，年仅十六岁的李世民应募从军，献疑兵之计。
616 年七月炀帝南幸江都，北方大乱：瓦岗军翟让、李密十月于大海寺斩隋名将张须陀；窦建德聚众高鸡泊；林士弘十二月称帝于豫章。林邑王范梵志收复故地，辽东郡亦废。
snaps.te: Emperor Yang goes south · rebels everywhere
snaps.de:
In 613 Yang Xuangan took advantage of the second Goguryeo campaign to rise in arms at Liyang and besiege the Eastern Capital, but was defeated within two months; in 614 the third Goguryeo campaign was halted when Goguryeo asked to surrender. In the 8th month of 615 Emperor Yang, touring the north, was besieged at Yanmen by Shibi Qaghan; Li Shimin, only 16, answered the call for volunteers and proposed a ruse with decoy troops.
In the 7th month of 616 Emperor Yang went south to Jiangdu, and the north fell into chaos: in the 10th month Zhai Rang and Li Mi of the Wagang army killed the noted Sui general Zhang Xutuo at Dahai Monastery; Dou Jiande gathered followers at Gaoji Marsh; and in the 12th month Lin Shihong proclaimed himself emperor at Yuzhang. Sambhuvarman, King of Linyi (Champa), recovered his former lands, and Liaodong Commandery was also abandoned.

snaps.d:
617 年春天下鼎沸：二月刘武周杀马邑太守王仁恭，北附突厥称定杨可汗；梁师都据朔方称帝；李密袭取兴洛仓，称魏公，围东都；窦建德正月称长乐王；四月薛举据金城称西秦霸王；杜伏威据历阳。
太原留守李渊在次子李世民、晋阳令刘文静策动下，五月斩副留守王威、高君雅，起兵晋阳；六月遣李建成、李世民攻克西河，建大将军府，遣使称臣于突厥以换取马匹。
snaps.te: Rising at Jinyang
snaps.de:
In spring 617 the realm was in turmoil: in the 2nd month Liu Wuzhou killed Wang Rengong, governor of Mayi Commandery, submitted to the Turks in the north and took the title Dingyang Qaghan; Liang Shidu seized Shuofang and proclaimed himself emperor; Li Mi took the Xingluo Granary by surprise, styled himself Duke of Wei and besieged the Eastern Capital; Dou Jiande had styled himself Prince of Changle in the 1st month; in the 4th month Xue Ju seized Jincheng and styled himself Hegemon-King of Western Qin; and Du Fuwei held Liyang.
Li Yuan, custodian of Taiyuan, urged on by his second son Li Shimin and by Liu Wenjing, magistrate of Jinyang, beheaded the deputy custodians Wang Wei and Gao Junya in the 5th month and rose in arms at Jinyang. In the 6th month he sent Li Jiancheng and Li Shimin to take Xihe, set up a Grand General's Headquarters, and sent envoys to declare himself a vassal of the Turks in exchange for horses.

labe.51: Xue Ju, Hegemon-King of Western Qin

snaps.d:
617 年七月李渊率甲士三万南下，阻雨贾胡堡，八月李世民力主进军，霍邑一战斩隋将宋老生；九月西渡龙门，取永丰仓，隋将屈突通、尧君素据守河东。李建成扼守潼关以拒屈突通，李世民经略渭北，关中豪杰及李渊之女（平阳公主）的“娘子军”纷纷来会，众至二十万。
十一月攻克长安，立代王杨侑为帝（恭帝），遥尊炀帝为太上皇，李渊自为大丞相、唐王。十二月李世民在扶风大败薛仁杲。此前十月萧铣已起兵巴陵，七月李轨据武威称河西大凉王。
snaps.te: Into Guanzhong, Chang'an taken · Emperor Gong enthroned
snaps.de:
In the 7th month of 617 Li Yuan marched south with 30,000 armored troops and was held up by rain at Guhu Fort; in the 8th month, with Li Shimin pressing for an advance, he killed the Sui general Song Laosheng in a single battle at Huoyi. In the 9th month he crossed west at Longmen and took the Yongfeng Granary, while the Sui generals Qutu Tong and Yao Junsu held Hedong. Li Jiancheng held the Tong Pass against Qutu Tong and Li Shimin campaigned north of the Wei; the leading men of Guanzhong and the "Women's Army" (niangzi jun) of Li Yuan's daughter (Princess Pingyang) came in one after another to join them, bringing their numbers to 200,000.
In the 11th month they took Chang'an and enthroned Yang You, Prince of Dai, as emperor (Emperor Gong), honoring the absent Emperor Yang as Retired Emperor; Li Yuan made himself Grand Chancellor and Prince of Tang. In the 12th month Li Shimin heavily defeated Xue Rengao at Fufeng. Earlier, in the 10th month, Xiao Xian had risen in arms at Baling, and in the 7th month Li Gui had seized Wuwei and styled himself Prince of Great Liang of Hexi.

labe.52: Li Gui, Prince of Great Liang (Hexi)
labe.1: Li Yuan, Prince of Tang (in the name of Emperor Gong)

snaps.d:
618 年正月李建成、李世民东略东都，四月还师，置新安、宜阳二郡；山南、巴蜀诸郡相继归附。三月宇文化及在江都缢杀炀帝，立秦王杨浩，率骁果北归。
五月李渊受恭帝禅让，即皇帝位，国号唐，改元武德；同月东都留守官拥立越王杨侗（皇泰主），王世充渐握大权。萧铣四月称帝，迁都江陵；沈法兴据毗陵；罗艺据涿郡自称幽州总管；隋末流散的吐谷浑伏允收复故地。
snaps.te: Jiangdu coup · Li Yuan accepts the abdication
snaps.de:
In the 1st month of 618 Li Jiancheng and Li Shimin campaigned east toward the Eastern Capital, returning in the 4th month after setting up the Xin'an and Yiyang Commanderies; the commanderies of Shannan and Ba and Shu submitted one after another. In the 3rd month Yuwen Huaji strangled Emperor Yang at Jiangdu, enthroned Yang Hao, Prince of Qin, and led the Xiaoguo guards back north.
In the 5th month Li Yuan accepted the abdication of Emperor Gong and took the throne, naming the dynasty Tang and adopting the era name Wude; the same month the custodians of the Eastern Capital enthroned Yang Tong, Prince of Yue (the Huangtai emperor), and Wang Shichong gradually took control. Xiao Xian proclaimed himself emperor in the 4th month and moved his capital to Jiangling; Shen Faxing held Piling; Luo Yi held Zhuo Commandery, styling himself area commander of Youzhou; and Fuyun of the Tuyuhun, a fugitive since the late Sui, recovered his old lands.

labe.52: Li Gui, Prince of Great Liang (Hexi)
labe.59: Yuwen Huaji (in the name of Yang Hao, Prince of Qin)

snaps.d:
618 年七月薛举在浅水原大败唐军，八月病死；十一月李世民坚壁六十余日后决战浅水原，大破宗罗睺，追至折墌城，薛仁杲出降，陇右平定。郭子和以榆林降唐。
东方，李密七月在童山击败宇文化及，九月却在邙山被王世充偷袭大败，十月入关降唐，所部多归王世充，徐世勣以黎阳一带归唐；宇文化及退至魏县。十一月窦建德称夏王，李轨在武威称帝；冯盎据岭南，高开道取北平、渔阳。
snaps.te: Battle of Qianshuiyuan · Longyou pacified
snaps.de:
In the 7th month of 618 Xue Ju heavily defeated the Tang army at Qianshuiyuan, and he died of illness in the 8th month. In the 11th month Li Shimin, after holding his fortified camp for over 60 days, fought a decisive battle at Qianshuiyuan, crushed Zong Luohou and pursued to Zhezhi City, where Xue Rengao came out and surrendered: Longyou was pacified. Guo Zihe surrendered Yulin to Tang.
In the east, Li Mi defeated Yuwen Huaji at Tongshan in the 7th month, but in the 9th month he was surprised and badly beaten by Wang Shichong at Mount Mang; in the 10th month he entered Guanzhong and submitted to Tang, most of his troops went over to Wang Shichong, and Xu Shiji brought the Liyang area over to Tang; Yuwen Huaji fell back to Wei County. In the 11th month Dou Jiande styled himself Prince of Xia and Li Gui proclaimed himself emperor at Wuwei; Feng Ang held Lingnan, and Gao Kaidao took Beiping and Yuyang.

labe.0: Sui (Huangtai emperor, Wang Shichong in power)

snaps.t: 刘武周南下·秦王屯柏壁
snaps.d:
619 年闰二月窦建德破聊城、斩宇文化及，随后迁都洺州，十月取黎阳，河北尽归于夏。四月王世充废皇泰主，自立为帝，国号郑。五月河西安修仁兄弟执李轨降唐。九月杜伏威降唐，李子通攻取江都称帝。
刘武周以宋金刚为将南下，连陷介州、晋阳，齐王李元吉弃城逃回长安；九月裴寂大败于度索原，晋、浍诸州相继失陷，关中震动，唐高祖一度欲弃河东。十一月李世民率军自龙门踏冰渡河，屯兵柏壁，坚壁不战，以待宋金刚粮尽；十二月殷开山、秦叔宝破尉迟敬德于美良川。

lab.55: 杜伏威（降唐·东南道行台）

snaps.te: Liu Wuzhou drives south · Prince of Qin holds Baibi
snaps.de:
In the intercalary 2nd month of 619 Dou Jiande took Liaocheng and beheaded Yuwen Huaji, then moved his capital to Mingzhou; in the 10th month he took Liyang, and all of Hebei came under Xia. In the 4th month Wang Shichong deposed the Huangtai emperor and made himself emperor, naming his state Zheng. In the 5th month An Xiuren and his brothers in Hexi seized Li Gui and surrendered to Tang. In the 9th month Du Fuwei submitted to Tang, and Li Zitong took Jiangdu and proclaimed himself emperor.
With Song Jingang as his general, Liu Wuzhou drove south and took Jiezhou and then Jinyang; Li Yuanji, Prince of Qi, abandoned the city and fled back to Chang'an. In the 9th month Pei Ji was heavily defeated at Dusuo Plain; Jinzhou, Kuaizhou and other prefectures fell one after another, Guanzhong was shaken, and Emperor Gaozu of Tang for a time wanted to abandon Hedong. In the 11th month Li Shimin led his army across the frozen Yellow River from Longmen and camped at Baibi, staying behind his walls without giving battle until Song Jingang's supplies ran out; in the 12th month Yin Kaishan and Qin Shubao defeated Yuchi Jingde at Meiliangchuan.

labe.55: Du Fuwei (submitted to Tang, Southeast Branch Department)

snaps.d:
620 年四月宋金刚粮尽北退，李世民率军追击，在雀鼠谷一日八战，再破于介休，宋金刚北逃，猛将尉迟敬德、寻相以介休、永安降唐；刘武周弃晋阳投突厥，河东尽复，其部将苑君璋依突厥据马邑。罗艺以幽州归唐，高开道亦降。
七月李世民率军东征王世充，先断洛阳外围，九月后郑之州县纷纷来降，年底洛阳成为孤城。江南，辅公祏为杜伏威击败李子通，取丹阳、江都；李子通转而攻灭沈法兴，据余杭。

lab.48: 苑君璋（定杨余部·附突厥）
lab.55: 吴王杜伏威（唐东南道行台）

snaps.te: Hedong recovered · Luoyang besieged
snaps.de:
In the 4th month of 620 Song Jingang, his supplies exhausted, fell back north. Li Shimin pursued him, fought eight battles in one day in the Queshu Valley and defeated him again at Jiexiu; Song Jingang fled north, and his fierce generals Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang surrendered Jiexiu and Yong'an to Tang. Liu Wuzhou abandoned Jinyang and fled to the Turks, Hedong was entirely recovered, and his general Yuan Junzhang held Mayi under Turkic protection. Luo Yi brought Youzhou over to Tang, and Gao Kaidao also surrendered.
In the 7th month Li Shimin marched east against Wang Shichong, first cutting Luoyang off from its surroundings; from the 9th month on, Zheng's prefectures and counties came over in numbers, and by the end of the year Luoyang was an isolated city. In Jiangnan, Fu Gongshi defeated Li Zitong for Du Fuwei and took Danyang and Jiangdu; Li Zitong turned instead to destroy Shen Faxing and held Yuhang.

labe.48: Yuan Junzhang (Dingyang remnant, under the Turks)
labe.55: Du Fuwei, Prince of Wu (Tang Southeast Branch Department)

snaps.d:
621 年三月窦建德率十余万众救援洛阳，李世民分兵围城，自率三千五百骑东据虎牢，扼其西进之路。五月初二窦建德列阵二十里挑战，李世民待其饥疲，午后率轻骑直冲其阵，大破夏军，窦建德坠马被擒。
王世充见窦建德被押至城下，五月初九率百官出降。夏、郑两国的河南、河北州县随之归唐，徐圆朗亦降。李世民入洛阳，封府库、收图籍，七月凯旋长安，披金甲、陈俘献于太庙。

lab.48: 苑君璋（定杨余部·附突厥）
lab.55: 吴王杜伏威（唐东南道行台）

snaps.te: Battle of Hulao · two kings taken in one battle
snaps.de:
In the 3rd month of 621 Dou Jiande led over 100,000 men to relieve Luoyang. Li Shimin divided his forces to keep up the siege and himself led 3,500 horsemen east to hold Hulao, blocking Dou's way west. On the 2nd day of the 5th month Dou Jiande drew up a battle line 20 li long and offered battle; Li Shimin waited until Dou's men were hungry and tired, then in the afternoon charged straight into their line with light cavalry and routed the Xia army; Dou Jiande fell from his horse and was captured.
When Wang Shichong saw Dou Jiande brought under the city walls as a prisoner, he led all his officials out to surrender on the 9th day of the 5th month. The prefectures and counties of Xia and Zheng in Henan and Hebei then went over to Tang, and Xu Yuanlang also surrendered. Li Shimin entered Luoyang, sealed the treasuries and took over the maps and registers; in the 7th month he returned in triumph to Chang'an and, in golden armor, presented his captives at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

labe.48: Yuan Junzhang (Dingyang remnant, under the Turks)
labe.55: Du Fuwei, Prince of Wu (Tang Southeast Branch Department)

snaps.d:
621 年九月李孝恭、李靖率巴蜀水军乘秋水东下，十月围江陵，萧铣出降，荆湘、岭表悉平；冯盎等岭南酋豪遣子弟谒李靖，汪华以歙州等六州归附，林士弘退保安成。十一月杜伏威部将王雄诞擒李子通，江东尽入杜伏威之手。
七月窦建德旧将刘黑闼在漳南起兵，联络突厥，半年之间尽复夏国故地；徐圆朗在兖州响应，自称鲁王；高开道亦复叛。十二月李世民受命再次东征。

lab.48: 苑君璋（定杨余部·附突厥）
lab.55: 吴王杜伏威（唐东南道行台）

snaps.te: Xiao Xian surrenders · Liu Heita rises
snaps.de:
In the 9th month of 621 Li Xiaogong and Li Jing led the Ba and Shu fleet east on the autumn floods and besieged Jiangling in the 10th month; Xiao Xian came out and surrendered, and the Jing–Xiang region and the lands beyond the Ridges were all pacified. Feng Ang and other chieftains of Lingnan sent their sons and brothers to call on Li Jing, Wang Hua submitted with six prefectures including Shezhou, and Lin Shihong fell back on Ancheng. In the 11th month Du Fuwei's general Wang Xiongdan captured Li Zitong, and all of Jiangdong fell into Du Fuwei's hands.
In the 7th month Liu Heita, a former general of Dou Jiande, rose in arms at Zhangnan and made contact with the Turks, and within half a year he recovered all the former lands of Xia; Xu Yuanlang rose in support at Yanzhou, styling himself Prince of Lu, and Gao Kaidao also revolted again. In the 12th month Li Shimin was ordered east on campaign once more.

labe.48: Yuan Junzhang (Dingyang remnant, under the Turks)
labe.55: Du Fuwei, Prince of Wu (Tang Southeast Branch Department)
labe.54: Chu (Lin Shihong, fallen back on Ancheng)

snaps.d:
622 年正月刘黑闼在洺州称汉东王。李世民进至洺水，与之对峙两月，筑堰截断洺水上游；三月刘黑闼渡水决战，李世民亲率精骑击其左翼，随即决堰放水，汉东军被淹溺、斩首万余，刘黑闼北奔突厥，河北州县复归唐。
四月李世民移兵兖州讨徐圆朗。岭南、江西已平，林士弘病死，交州丘和以交、爱之地归唐。隋末群雄仅余徐圆朗、高开道、苑君璋、梁师都及名义降唐的杜伏威。

lab.48: 苑君璋（定杨余部·附突厥）
lab.55: 吴王杜伏威（唐东南道行台）

snaps.te: Battle of the Ming River · Hebei retaken
snaps.de:
In the 1st month of 622 Liu Heita styled himself Prince of Handong at Mingzhou. Li Shimin advanced to the Ming River and faced him for two months, building a dam to cut off the river's upper course. In the 3rd month Liu Heita crossed the river for a decisive battle; Li Shimin in person led crack cavalry against his left wing and then had the dam broken: Handong troops were drowned, and over 10,000 were beheaded. Liu Heita fled north to the Turks, and the prefectures and counties of Hebei returned to Tang.
In the 4th month Li Shimin moved his army to Yanzhou against Xu Yuanlang. Lingnan and Jiangxi had been pacified, Lin Shihong died of illness, and Qiu He of Jiaozhou brought the lands of Jiaozhou and Aizhou over to Tang. Of the late-Sui contenders only Xu Yuanlang, Gao Kaidao, Yuan Junzhang and Liang Shidu remained, along with Du Fuwei, who had submitted to Tang in name.

labe.48: Yuan Junzhang (Dingyang remnant, under the Turks)
labe.55: Du Fuwei, Prince of Wu (Tang Southeast Branch Department)

snaps.d:
622 年六月刘黑闼借突厥兵复入河北，十月于下博杀唐淮阳王李道玄，再据洺州；太子李建成请缨，用魏征之策释放俘虏、瓦解其众，623 年正月刘黑闼兵败被擒，斩于洺州。二月徐圆朗败死。
622 年七月杜伏威入朝，623 年八月辅公祏在丹阳反，称帝国号宋；624 年三月李孝恭、李靖大破冯慧亮于博望山，克丹阳，辅公祏被擒。高开道部将张金树等作乱，高开道自缢。四月颁行武德律令与均田、租庸调之法。中原只剩梁师都据朔方，依附突厥。
snaps.te: Fu Gongshi crushed · the realm largely settled
snaps.de:
In the 6th month of 622 Liu Heita returned to Hebei with borrowed Turkic troops; in the 10th month he killed the Tang Prince of Huaiyang, Li Daoxuan, at Xiabo and retook Mingzhou. Crown Prince Li Jiancheng volunteered for the command and, following Wei Zheng's plan, released prisoners to break up Liu's following; in the 1st month of 623 Liu Heita was defeated and captured, and beheaded at Mingzhou. In the 2nd month Xu Yuanlang was defeated and killed.
In the 7th month of 622 Du Fuwei went to court; in the 8th month of 623 Fu Gongshi rebelled at Danyang, proclaiming himself emperor of a state named Song. In the 3rd month of 624 Li Xiaogong and Li Jing crushed Feng Huiliang at Mount Bowang and took Danyang, and Fu Gongshi was captured. Gao Kaidao's officer Zhang Jinshu and others mutinied, and Gao Kaidao hanged himself. In the 4th month the Wude Code and Statutes were promulgated, together with the equal-field system and the zu-yong-diao taxes (grain, labor and cloth). In the Central Plains only Liang Shidu remained, holding Shuofang as a client of the Turks.

snaps.d:
统一战争中秦王李世民功高，天策府人才济济，与太子李建成、齐王李元吉矛盾激化。626 年六月初四，李世民伏兵玄武门，射杀李建成，尉迟敬德杀李元吉；三日后立为太子，八月高祖退位，李世民即位（太宗）。
新君初立，东突厥颉利、突利二可汗率十余万骑南下，八月二十八日兵临渭水便桥北，距长安仅四十里。太宗亲率六骑至渭水边与颉利隔河对话，两日后刑白马盟于便桥，突厥退兵。
snaps.te: Xuanwu Gate incident · Covenant on the Wei
snaps.de:
In the wars of unification Li Shimin, Prince of Qin, had won outstanding merit, and his Office of Heaven's Strategy was full of able men; his conflict with Crown Prince Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanji, Prince of Qi, grew acute. On the 4th day of the 6th month of 626 Li Shimin laid an ambush at the Xuanwu Gate and shot Li Jiancheng dead, while Yuchi Jingde killed Li Yuanji; three days later Li Shimin was made crown prince, and in the 8th month Gaozu abdicated and Li Shimin took the throne (Taizong).
With the new ruler just enthroned, the Eastern Turkic Illig and Tuli Qaghans came south with over 100,000 horsemen and on the 28th day of the 8th month reached the north end of the Bian Bridge over the Wei, only 40 li from Chang'an. Taizong rode with six horsemen to the bank of the Wei and spoke with Illig across the river; two days later they sacrificed a white horse and swore a covenant at the Bian Bridge, and the Turks withdrew.

snaps.d:
627 年改元贞观，并省州县，分天下为关内、河南、河东、河北、山南、陇右、淮南、江南、剑南、岭南十道。同年漠北薛延陀、回纥等铁勒诸部叛离东突厥，颉利可汗又逢大雪饥荒。
628 年四月，唐军柴绍、薛万均乘突厥衰弱进围朔方，梁师都的堂弟梁洛仁杀之以降，隋末以来割据势力至此全部平定。薛延陀首领夷男在漠北自立，与唐通好。

lab.7: 西突厥（咄陆·弩失毕分立）

snaps.te: Liang Shidu destroyed · the realm reunited
snaps.de:
In 627 the era name was changed to Zhenguan, prefectures and counties were merged or abolished, and the realm was divided into ten circuits: Guannei, Henan, Hedong, Hebei, Shannan, Longyou, Huainan, Jiangnan, Jiannan and Lingnan. The same year the Xueyantuo, Huihe (Uyghurs) and other Tiele tribes north of the Gobi broke away from the Eastern Turks, and Illig Qaghan was also hit by heavy snow and famine.
In the 4th month of 628 the Tang generals Chai Shao and Xue Wanjun, taking advantage of the Turks' weakness, advanced and besieged Shuofang; Liang Shidu's cousin Liang Luoren killed him and surrendered, and with that every regional regime that had arisen since the late Sui had been put down. Yinan, chief of the Xueyantuo, set himself up as ruler north of the Gobi and established friendly relations with Tang.

snaps.d:
629 年冬，太宗以李靖为定襄道行军大总管，与李勣等六路出击。630 年正月李靖率三千骁骑夜袭定襄，颉利北走；二月李靖、李勣会师白道，乘颉利遣使请降之际雾中突袭阴山牙帐，斩首万余，三月擒颉利，东突厥亡。
唐将十余万降众安置于幽州至灵州一带，设顺、祐、化、长四州及定襄、云中都督府。四月西北诸蕃君长请上太宗尊号“天可汗”。同年伊吾城主举七城来降，置西伊州。高原上松赞干布继承赞普之位，吐蕃崛起。

lab.70: 定襄·云中都督府（突厥降部）
lab.7: 西突厥（咄陆·弩失毕分立）

snaps.te: Battle of the Yin Mountains · Heavenly Qaghan
snaps.de:
In winter 629 Taizong made Li Jing commander-in-chief of the Dingxiang Route expedition, and Li Jing, Li Ji and others struck out along six routes. In the 1st month of 630 Li Jing led 3,000 picked horsemen in a night attack on Dingxiang, and Illig fled north; in the 2nd month Li Jing and Li Ji joined forces at Baidao and, while Illig was sending envoys to ask to surrender, made a surprise attack in the fog on his royal camp in the Yin Mountains, beheading over 10,000; in the 3rd month Illig was captured, and the Eastern Turkic Qaghanate fell.
Tang settled over 100,000 surrendered Turks in the area from Youzhou to Lingzhou, setting up the four prefectures of Shunzhou, Youzhou, Huazhou and Changzhou and the Dingxiang and Yunzhong Area Commands. In the 4th month the rulers of the northwestern peoples asked to confer on Taizong the title "Heavenly Qaghan". The same year the lord of Yiwu came over with its seven towns, and Xiyi Zhou was set up. On the plateau Songtsen Gampo succeeded to the throne as tsenpo, and Tibet rose to power.

labe.70: Dingxiang and Yunzhong Area Commands (surrendered Turks)

snaps.d:
634—635 年李靖、侯君集远征吐谷浑，伏允败死，吐谷浑臣属于唐。638 年吐蕃以求婚不遂进攻松州，被唐军夜袭击退，遂遣使谢罪。党项拓跋赤辞降唐，置羁縻州数十。
高昌王麴文泰附西突厥、阻隔西域商路，640 年侯君集率军出伊州，八月麴智盛出降，唐以其地为西州，九月于交河城置安西都护府；西突厥驻守可汗浮图城的叶护亦降，置庭州。丝路北道由此直通唐境。

lab.70: 定襄·云中都督府（突厥降部）

snaps.te: Gaochang conquered · Anxi Protectorate founded
snaps.de:
In 634–635 Li Jing and Hou Junji led a distant expedition against the Tuyuhun; Fuyun was defeated and died, and the Tuyuhun submitted to Tang as vassals. In 638 Tibet, its marriage proposal refused, attacked Songzhou, was driven off by a Tang night attack, and then sent envoys to apologize. Tuoba Chici of the Tanguts surrendered to Tang, and dozens of loose-rein prefectures were set up.
Qu Wentai, King of Gaochang, attached himself to the Western Turks and blocked the trade routes of the Western Regions. In 640 Hou Junji led an army out from Yizhou; in the 8th month Qu Zhisheng came out and surrendered, Tang made the territory into Xizhou, and in the 9th month the Anxi Protectorate was set up at Jiaohe City. The Western Turkic Yabghu stationed at Kehan Futu City also surrendered, and Tingzhou was set up. From then on the northern route of the Silk Road led straight into Tang territory.

labe.70: Dingxiang and Yunzhong Area Commands (surrendered Turks)

snaps.d:
641 年文成公主入藏，嫁松赞干布；同年冬李勣破薛延陀于诺真水。644 年郭孝恪破焉耆。645 年太宗亲征高句丽，克辽东、白岩等十城，驻跸山大破高句丽援军十五万，但安市城久攻不下，九月寒冬将至，班师。
646 年唐与回纥夹击，薛延陀灭亡；八月太宗至灵州，铁勒诸部请置唐官，尊太宗为“天可汗”。647 年以回纥等部为瀚海、燕然、金微等六府七州，置燕然都护府统之，开“参天可汗道”，设驿站六十八所。吐蕃并羊同。

lab.70: 定襄·云中都督府（突厥降部）

snaps.te: Xueyantuo destroyed · Yanran Protectorate founded
snaps.de:
In 641 Princess Wencheng went to Tibet and married Songtsen Gampo; in the winter of the same year Li Ji defeated the Xueyantuo at the Nuozhen River. In 644 Guo Xiaoke defeated Karasahr. In 645 Taizong personally campaigned against Goguryeo, took ten fortresses including Yodong and Baegam, and crushed a Goguryeo relief army of 150,000 at Mount Zhubi, but Ansi Fortress held out against a long siege, and in the 9th month, with the cold of winter approaching, he withdrew.
In 646 Tang and the Huihe (Uyghurs) attacked the Xueyantuo from both sides, and the Xueyantuo were destroyed; in the 8th month Taizong came to Lingzhou, where the Tiele tribes asked for Tang officials to be appointed and hailed him as "Heavenly Qaghan". In 647 the Huihe and other tribes were organized as six area commands, including Hanhai, Yanran and Jinwei, and seven prefectures, with the Yanran Protectorate set up to govern them; the "Road to the Heavenly Qaghan" was opened, with 68 post stations. Tibet annexed Zhangzhung.

labe.70: Dingxiang and Yunzhong Area Commands (surrendered Turks)

snaps.d:
648 年阿史那社尔、郭孝恪率军攻龟兹，十二月破其都城，擒国王白诃黎布失毕；安西都护府移治龟兹，以龟兹、于阗、疏勒、焉耆为四镇。同年契丹窟哥、奚可度者率部内附，唐置松漠、饶乐都督府；黠戛斯入朝，置坚昆都督府。王玄策借吐蕃、泥婆罗兵平定中天竺。
649 年五月太宗崩于终南山翠微宫，太子李治即位（高宗）。

lab.70: 定襄·云中都督府（突厥降部）

snaps.te: Kucha conquered · Four Garrisons set up · death of Taizong
snaps.de:
In 648 Ashina She'er and Guo Xiaoke attacked Kucha; in the 12th month they took its capital and captured its king, Bai Helibushibi. The Anxi Protectorate moved its seat to Kucha, and Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar and Karasahr became the Four Garrisons. The same year Kuge of the Khitan and Keduzhe of the Xi brought their tribes to submit to the empire, and Tang set up the Songmo and Raole Area Commands; the Kyrgyz came to court, and the Jiankun Area Command was set up. Wang Xuance, with troops borrowed from Tibet and Nepal, subdued Central India.
In the 5th month of 649 Taizong died at the Cuiwei Palace in the Zhongnan Mountains, and Crown Prince Li Zhi took the throne (Gaozong).

labe.70: Dingxiang and Yunzhong Area Commands (surrendered Turks)

snaps.d:
651 年阿史那贺鲁叛唐，自称沙钵罗可汗，复统西突厥十姓，安西都护府退回西州，四镇罢废。同年阿拉伯人攻入木鹿，萨珊波斯亡。655 年高宗立武则天为皇后。
657 年冬苏定方率回纥兵大破贺鲁于曳咥河（额尔齐斯河），追至石国擒之。658 年唐分西突厥之地，以碎叶川为界置昆陵、濛池二都护府；昭武九姓诸国置康居、大宛等都督府州；安西都护府复移龟兹，升大都护府。
snaps.te: Su Dingfang destroys the Western Turks
snaps.de:
In 651 Ashina Helu rebelled against Tang, styled himself Shaboluo Qaghan and again united the Ten Tribes of the Western Turks; the Anxi Protectorate fell back to Xizhou, and the Four Garrisons were abolished. The same year the Arabs broke into Merv, and Sasanian Persia fell. In 655 Gaozong made Wu Zetian empress.
In winter 657 Su Dingfang, with troops of the Huihe (Uyghurs), crushed Helu on the Irtysh, pursued him to Chach and captured him. In 658 Tang divided the Western Turkic lands, setting up the Kunling and Mengchi Protectorates with the Suyab River as the boundary; the Sogdian states (Zhaowu) were organized as Kangju, Dawan and other area commands and prefectures; and the Anxi Protectorate moved back to Kucha and was raised to a Grand Protectorate.

snaps.d:
660 年苏定方率水陆十三万自成山渡海，与新罗金庾信夹击百济，七月攻破泗沘，义慈王出降，唐置熊津等五都督府；百济遗臣鬼室福信等迎王子扶余丰于倭国，据周留城复国，围攻唐军，刘仁轨孤军坚守熊津。
661 年六月，王名远奉使吐火罗，以其地为月氏、条支、写凤、修鲜等十六都督府、七十二州，以疾陵城为波斯都督府，皆隶安西。苏定方等进围平壤，至次年二月无功而还。
snaps.te: Baekje conquered · sixteen area commands set up in the Western Regions
snaps.de:
In 660 Su Dingfang led 130,000 land and naval troops across the sea from Chengshan and, with Kim Yu-sin of Silla, attacked Baekje from both sides; in the 7th month he took Sabi, King Uija came out and surrendered, and Tang set up five area commands, Ungjin among them. Gwisil Boksin and other former Baekje officials brought Prince Buyeo Pung back from Wa (Japan), held Juryu Fortress to restore the state and besieged the Tang army, while Liu Rengui held out at Ungjin with an isolated force.
In the 6th month of 661 Wang Mingyuan, sent as envoy to Tokharistan, organized its lands into 16 area commands, including Yuezhi, Tiaozhi, Xiefeng and Xiuxian, and 72 prefectures, and made Zaranj the Persian Area Command, all under Anxi. Su Dingfang and others advanced and besieged Pyongyang, withdrawing without success in the 2nd month of the following year.

snaps.d:
662 年三月薛仁贵在天山大破九姓铁勒，“将军三箭定天山”。663 年五月吐蕃大相禄东赞攻灭吐谷浑，诺曷钵与弘化公主率残部奔凉州。
八月刘仁轨、杜爽率唐水军在白江口与倭国援军遭遇，四战四捷，焚倭船四百艘，周留城随即陷落，扶余丰逃往高句丽，百济复国失败。燕然都护府移治漠北回纥部落、改名瀚海都护府，漠南改设云中都护府；新罗为鸡林州都督府。
snaps.te: Baekgang · Tibet absorbs the Tuyuhun
snaps.de:
In the 3rd month of 662 Xue Rengui crushed the Nine Tiele Tribes at Tianshan: "the general's three arrows settled Tianshan". In the 5th month of 663 the Tibetan chief minister Gar Tongtsen destroyed the Tuyuhun, and Nuohebo and Princess Honghua fled with the remnants to Liangzhou.
In the 8th month Liu Rengui and Du Shuang, leading the Tang fleet, met the relief force from Wa (Japan) at Baekgang, won all four engagements and burned 400 Wa ships; Juryu Fortress fell soon after, Buyeo Pung fled to Goguryeo, and the Baekje restoration failed. The Yanran Protectorate moved its seat to the tribal lands of the Huihe (Uyghurs) north of the Gobi and was renamed the Hanhai Protectorate, while south of the Gobi the Yunzhong Protectorate was set up instead; Silla was made the Gyerim Area Command.

snaps.d:
666 年正月高宗封禅泰山。同年泉盖苏文死，长子泉男生被二弟驱逐而降唐。666 年十二月李勣为辽东道行军大总管东征，667 年九月克新城，668 年二月薛仁贵拔扶余城，九月与新罗军合围平壤，宝藏王出降，高句丽亡；十二月于平壤置安东都护府。
664 年云中都护府改称单于大都护府，669 年瀚海都护府改称安北都护府；西南置姚州都督府。此时唐东至朝鲜半岛，西抵咸海与葱岭以西，北逾大漠、远及贝加尔湖，南至林邑北境，是唐代疆域的极盛。
snaps.te: Goguryeo conquered · Tang at its greatest extent
snaps.de:
In the 1st month of 666 Gaozong performed the feng and shan sacrifices at Mount Tai. The same year Yeon Gaesomun died, and his eldest son Yeon Namsaeng, driven out by his two younger brothers, submitted to Tang. In the 12th month of 666 Li Ji, as commander-in-chief of the Liaodong Route expedition, marched east; he took Sinseong in the 9th month of 667, Xue Rengui stormed Buyeo Fortress in the 2nd month of 668, and in the 9th month the Tang forces and the Silla army surrounded Pyongyang; King Bojang came out and surrendered, and Goguryeo fell. In the 12th month the Andong Protectorate was set up at Pyongyang.
In 664 the Yunzhong Protectorate was renamed the Chanyu Grand Protectorate, and in 669 the Hanhai Protectorate was renamed the Anbei Protectorate; in the southwest the Yaozhou Area Command was set up. Tang now reached the Korean Peninsula in the east and the Aral Sea and the lands west of the Pamirs in the west; in the north it extended across the Gobi as far as Lake Baikal, and in the south to the northern border of Linyi (Champa): the greatest extent of Tang territory.

snaps.d:
670 年四月，吐蕃陷西域十八州，又与于阗袭陷龟兹拨换城，唐罢龟兹、于阗、焉耆、疏勒四镇，安西都护府退回西州。同月（《三国史记》作六月）高句丽遗民剑牟岑起兵，立安舜为王；新罗收容高句丽、百济遗民，与唐争夺半岛。
唐以薛仁贵为逻娑道行军大总管，护送吐谷浑诺曷钵复国；八月（一说七月）郭待封违令，唐军在大非川被论钦陵大败，吐谷浑故地从此尽归吐蕃，唐蕃百年之争由此展开。
snaps.te: Battle of Dafeichuan · Four Garrisons lost
snaps.de:
In the 4th month of 670 Tibet took eighteen prefectures of the Western Regions and, together with Khotan, took Bohuan City in Kucha by surprise; Tang abolished the Four Garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Karasahr and Kashgar, and the Anxi Protectorate fell back to Xizhou. In the same month (the Samguk sagi gives the 6th month) the Goguryeo loyalist Geom Mojam rose in arms and made An Seung king; Silla took in refugees from Goguryeo and Baekje and contested the peninsula with Tang.
Tang made Xue Rengui commander-in-chief of the Rasa Route expedition to escort Nuohebo of the Tuyuhun back to restore his state; in the 8th month (or the 7th month) Guo Daifeng disobeyed orders, and the Tang army was heavily defeated by Gar Trinring at Dafeichuan. From then on the former Tuyuhun lands belonged entirely to Tibet, and the century-long struggle between Tang and Tibet began.

snaps.d:
674 年唐削新罗王金法敏官爵，以刘仁轨为鸡林道大总管讨之；675 年李谨行与新罗战于买肖城，676 年十一月新罗水军在伎伐浦击败唐军。唐无力兼顾，676 年二月移安东都护府于辽东故城、熊津都督府于建安故城，次年安东再移新城；新罗尽有百济故地，北界推到临津江，临津江至清川江之间成为无人据守之地。
西陲吐蕃连年攻鄯、廓、河、芳诸州；675 年唐于鄯善、且末故地置石城、播仙二镇。674 年高宗称天皇、武后称天后；十二月波斯王卑路斯来朝，波斯都督府名存实亡。
snaps.te: Silla–Tang War · Andong moved inland
snaps.de:
In 674 Tang stripped Kim Beop-min, King of Silla, of his offices and titles and made Liu Rengui commander-in-chief of the Gyerim Route to attack him; in 675 Li Jinxing fought Silla at Maeso Fortress, and in the 11th month of 676 the Silla navy defeated the Tang forces at Gibeolpo. Unable to cope on both fronts, in the 2nd month of 676 Tang moved the Andong Protectorate to the old Yodong Fortress and the Ungjin Area Command to the old Geonan Fortress, and the next year Andong moved again, to Sinseong. Silla held all the former lands of Baekje and pushed its northern border to the Imjin River; the land between the Imjin River and the Chongchon River became a no-man's-land.
On the western frontier Tibet attacked Shanzhou, Kuozhou, Hezhou, Fangzhou and other prefectures year after year; in 675 Tang set up the Shicheng and Boxian Garrisons on the former lands of Shanshan and Qiemo. In 674 Gaozong took the title Heavenly Emperor and Empress Wu that of Heavenly Empress; in the 12th month Peroz, King of Persia, came to court, and the Persian Area Command existed in name only.

snaps.d:
677 年西突厥阿史那都支、李遮匐联结吐蕃，侵逼安西；678 年九月李敬玄率十八万众与吐蕃战于青海，大败，刘审礼被俘（一说战死），黑齿常之夜袭吐蕃营于承风岭，唐军才得退还。
679 年裴行俭以册送波斯王子泥涅师为名，自西州以校猎为名西进，突至都支牙帐擒之，李遮匐亦降；王方翼筑碎叶城，唐以碎叶、龟兹、于阗、疏勒为四镇。十月，单于都护府所领突厥阿史德温傅、奉职二部叛，立阿史那泥熟匐为可汗，漠南二十四州响应。
snaps.te: Ashina Duzhi captured · Four Garrisons restored
snaps.de:
In 677 Ashina Duzhi and Li Zhefu of the Western Turks allied with Tibet and pressed on Anxi; in the 9th month of 678 Li Jingxuan fought Tibet at Qinghai Lake with 180,000 men and was heavily defeated, and Liu Shenli was captured (or killed in battle); only after Heichi Changzhi made a night raid on the Tibetan camp at Chengfeng Pass could the Tang army withdraw.
In 679 Pei Xingjian, on the pretext of escorting the Persian prince Narseh home to be installed as king, advanced west from Xizhou under cover of a hunting expedition, suddenly arrived at Ashina Duzhi's royal camp and captured him, and Li Zhefu also surrendered; Wang Fangyi built the city of Suyab, and Tang made Suyab, Kucha, Khotan and Kashgar the Four Garrisons. In the 10th month the two Turkic tribes of Ashide Wenfu and Fengzhi under the Chanyu Protectorate rebelled and made Ashina Nishufu qaghan, and twenty-four prefectures south of the Gobi rose in support.

snaps.d:
680 年三月裴行俭大破泥熟匐于黑山；同年吐蕃陷安戎城，西洱诸蛮皆降吐蕃。682 年王方翼破西突厥车薄、咽面于热海；同年阿史那骨咄禄据黑沙城复国，史称后突厥，暾欲谷为谋主，屡寇单于府与并、代，漠北铁勒诸部渐为所并。685 年六月安北都护府侨置同城，垂拱间（一说武后时）回纥等四部南迁甘、凉。
683 年十二月高宗崩，武后临朝；684 年改东都为神都，徐敬业起兵扬州，十一月败于下阿溪。约 686 年唐弃四镇，吐蕃乘虚而入。687 年七月（《旧唐书·突厥传》作八月）黑齿常之破突厥于黄花堆。
snaps.te: Turkic revival · Four Garrisons lost again
snaps.de:
In the 3rd month of 680 Pei Xingjian crushed Nishufu at Heishan; the same year Tibet took Anrong City, and the Xi'er tribes all submitted to Tibet. In 682 Wang Fangyi defeated Chebo and Yanmian of the Western Turks at Issyk-Kul; the same year Ashina Qutlugh seized Heisha City and restored the Turkic state, known to history as the Second Turkic Qaghanate. With Tonyukuk as his chief strategist he repeatedly raided the Chanyu Protectorate, Bingzhou and Daizhou, and the Tiele tribes north of the Gobi were gradually absorbed. In the 6th month of 685 the Anbei Protectorate was temporarily seated at Tongcheng, and in the Chuigong era (or under Empress Wu) four tribes, the Huihe (Uyghurs) among them, moved south to Ganzhou and Liangzhou.
In the 12th month of 683 Gaozong died and Empress Wu took charge of the court; in 684 the Eastern Capital was renamed the Divine Capital, and Xu Jingye rose in arms at Yangzhou and was defeated at Xia'axi in the 11th month. Around 686 Tang abandoned the Four Garrisons, and Tibet moved into the gap. In the 7th month of 687 (the "Turks" chapter of the Old Book of Tang gives the 8th month) Heichi Changzhi defeated the Turks at Huanghuadui.

snaps.d:
689 年五月韦待价与吐蕃战于寅识迦河，失利。690 年九月武则天称帝，改国号周，以神都洛阳为都，边疆诸州、都护府照旧。691 年后突厥默啜可汗立，国势复振。
692 年十月武威道总管王孝杰、阿史那忠节大破吐蕃，复取龟兹、于阗、疏勒、碎叶四镇，安西都护府复治龟兹，发汉兵三万镇守，此后四镇稳守数十年。
snaps.te: Wu Zhou replaces Tang · Four Garrisons retaken
snaps.de:
In the 5th month of 689 Wei Daijia fought Tibet on the Yinshijia River and was defeated. In the 9th month of 690 Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor and changed the name of the dynasty to Zhou, with the Divine Capital, Luoyang, as her capital; the frontier prefectures and protectorates remained as before. In 691 Qapaghan Qaghan of the Second Turkic Qaghanate came to the throne, and its power revived.
In the 10th month of 692 Wang Xiaojie, commander of the Wuwei Route, and Ashina Zhongjie crushed Tibet and retook the Four Garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar and Suyab; the Anxi Protectorate again had its seat at Kucha, and 30,000 Han troops were sent to garrison them. From then on the Four Garrisons were held securely for several decades.

snaps.d:
694 年王孝杰破吐蕃于冷泉、大岭；696 年三月王孝杰与论钦陵战于素罗汗山，大败。五月契丹松漠都督李尽忠与孙万荣陷营州，自号无上可汗，唐军屡败于黄獐谷、东硖石谷（697 年三月，王孝杰战死）；默啜乘虚袭破契丹后方，孙万荣败死，契丹、奚附于后突厥，营州陷于契丹。
万岁通天年间（696—697）大祚荣率粟末靺鞨与高句丽遗民东走，698 年前后于天门岭击败李楷固，在东牟山建立震国；六月安东都护府降为都督府。八月默啜南下陷定州，九月围赵州，退兵时尽杀所掠男女万余人（《旧唐书·突厥传》作掠八九万人）。
snaps.te: Yingzhou revolt · Jin founded
snaps.de:
In 694 Wang Xiaojie defeated Tibet at Lengquan and Daling; in the 3rd month of 696 he fought Gar Trinring at Mount Suluohan and was heavily defeated. In the 5th month Li Jinzhong, the Khitan area commander of Songmo, and Sun Wanrong took Yingzhou, and Li Jinzhong styled himself Wushang Qaghan; the Tang armies were defeated again and again, at Huangzhang Valley and at Dongxiashi Valley (3rd month of 697; Wang Xiaojie was killed in battle). Qapaghan took the chance to strike the Khitan rear, Sun Wanrong was defeated and killed, the Khitan and Xi attached themselves to the Second Turkic Qaghanate, and Yingzhou was lost to the Khitan.
In the Wansui Tongtian era (696–697) Dae Joyeong led the Sumo Mohe and Goguryeo refugees east; around 698 he defeated Li Kaigu at Tianmenling and founded the state of Jin at Mount Dongmou. In the 6th month the Andong Protectorate was downgraded to an area command. In the 8th month Qapaghan came south and took Dingzhou, and in the 9th month he besieged Zhaozhou; as he withdrew he killed all of the more than 10,000 men and women he had carried off (the "Turks" chapter of the Old Book of Tang says he carried off 80,000–90,000).

snaps.d:
699 年吐蕃赞普亲讨论钦陵，论钦陵兵溃自杀，赞婆降唐；700 年闰七月唐休璟破吐蕃于洪源谷。突骑施乌质勒兴起，703 年攻陷碎叶，移牙帐于此，西突厥故地大半归之；702 年于庭州置北庭都护府，统天山以北。圣历年间吐谷浑等部多背蕃投唐，唐势力西进至黄河九曲。
705 年正月张柬之等发动神龙政变，武则天退位，中宗复位，二月复国号唐，安东都督府复为都护府。702 年日本遣唐使粟田真人入唐，始称日本；神龙以后真腊分为陆真腊（文单）、水真腊二国。
snaps.te: Tang restored · Beiting Protectorate founded
snaps.de:
In 699 the Tibetan tsenpo himself marched against Gar Trinring; Gar Trinring's army broke up and he killed himself, and Gar Tsenba surrendered to Tang; in the intercalary 7th month of 700 Tang Xiujing defeated Tibet at Hongyuan Valley. Üch Elig of the Türgesh rose to power; in 703 he took Suyab and moved his royal camp there, and most of the former Western Turkic lands came under him. In 702 the Beiting Protectorate was set up at Tingzhou to govern the lands north of the Tian Shan. In the Shengli era many of the Tuyuhun and other tribes turned away from Tibet and went over to Tang, and Tang power advanced west to Jiuqu on the Yellow River.
In the 1st month of 705 Zhang Jianzhi and others launched the Shenlong coup; Wu Zetian abdicated and Zhongzong was restored; in the 2nd month the dynasty's name reverted to Tang, and the Andong Area Command became a protectorate again. In 702 the Japanese envoy to Tang, Awata no Mahito, arrived, and the name Japan was used for the first time; after the Shenlong era Chenla split into two states, Land Chenla (Wendan) and Water Chenla.

snaps.d:
706 年唐蕃会盟（神龙盟誓，盟文已佚），大体以黄河为界；同年十二月沙吒忠义与默啜战于鸣沙，败绩。708 年张仁愿乘默啜西击突骑施，于黄河北岸筑东、中、西三受降城，拓地三百余里，自此突厥不敢逾山牧马。同年十一月突骑施娑葛叛，牛师奖败没于火烧城，安西为其所陷，唐旋册娑葛为十四姓可汗。
710 年正月金城公主入藏嫁赤德祖赞，吐蕃得河西九曲为公主汤沐之地（《新唐书·中宗纪》系于是年三月）；六月临淄王李隆基诛韦后（唐隆政变），睿宗复位；首置河西节度使（据《新唐书·方镇表》；《唐会要》作 711 年四月）。
snaps.te: Three Shouxiang Cities · Jiuqu given to Tibet
snaps.de:
In 706 Tang and Tibet swore a treaty (the Covenant of Shenlong, whose text is lost), broadly taking the Yellow River as the boundary; in the 12th month of the same year Shazha Zhongyi fought Qapaghan at Mingsha and was defeated. In 708, while Qapaghan was attacking the Türgesh in the west, Zhang Renyuan built the Eastern, Central and Western Shouxiang Cities on the north bank of the Yellow River, extending the frontier by over 300 li; from then on the Turks did not dare cross the mountains to graze their horses. In the 11th month of the same year Saqal of the Türgesh rebelled; Niu Shijiang was defeated and killed at Huoshao City and Anxi fell to Saqal, and Tang soon invested Saqal as Qaghan of the Fourteen Clans.
In the 1st month of 710 Princess Jincheng went to Tibet to marry Tride Tsuktsen, and Tibet obtained the Jiuqu lands west of the Yellow River as an estate for the princess's upkeep (the New Book of Tang's Annals of Zhongzong dates this to the 3rd month of that year); in the 6th month Li Longji, Prince of Linzi, killed Empress Wei (the Tanglong coup), and Ruizong was restored; and the post of military governor of Hexi was instituted for the first time (per the New Book of Tang's table of military governors; the Tang huiyao gives the 4th month of 711).

snaps.d:
711 年（《通鉴》系于 714 年末）默啜西击突骑施，杀娑葛；712 年六月孙佺讨奚，败于冷陉，八月玄宗即位。713 年唐册大祚荣为渤海郡王，震国改称渤海。714 年郭虔瓘破突厥于北庭，十月薛讷破吐蕃于武街；714 年三月阿史那献克碎叶；715 年张孝嵩发兵逐大食、吐蕃所立的拔汗那王。
716 年默啜为拔曳固所杀，毗伽可汗立；契丹李失活、奚李大酺归唐，复置松漠、饶乐都督府；717 年三月复置营州于柳城；714 年安东都护府移治平州。717 年七月突骑施苏禄引大食、吐蕃围钵换城。705—715 年大食屈底波攻取吐火罗与昭武诸国，711—712 年另一路大食军取信度，葱岭以西多归大食。
snaps.te: Yingzhou restored · the Caliphate advances east
snaps.de:
In 711 (the Zizhi tongjian dates it to late 714) Qapaghan attacked the Türgesh in the west and killed Saqal; in the 6th month of 712 Sun Quan campaigned against the Xi and was defeated at Lengxing, and in the 8th month Xuanzong took the throne. In 713 Tang invested Dae Joyeong as Commandery Prince of Bohai, and Jin was renamed Balhae. In 714 Guo Qianguan defeated the Turks at Beiting, and in the 10th month Xue Ne defeated Tibet at Wujie; in the 3rd month of 714 Ashina Xian took Suyab; in 715 Zhang Xiaosong sent troops to drive out the King of Ferghana set up by the Arab Caliphate and Tibet.
In 716 Qapaghan was killed by the Bayegu, and Bilge Qaghan came to the throne; Li Shihuo of the Khitan and Li Dapu of the Xi returned to Tang, and the Songmo and Raole Area Commands were set up again; in the 3rd month of 717 Yingzhou was re-established at Liucheng; in 714 the Andong Protectorate moved its seat to Pingzhou. In the 7th month of 717 Suluk of the Türgesh brought in the Arab Caliphate and Tibet to besiege Bohuan City. In 705–715 Qutayba ibn Muslim of the Arab Caliphate conquered Tokharistan and the Sogdian states (Zhaowu), and in 711–712 another Arab army took Sindh; most of the lands west of the Pamirs came under the Caliphate.

snaps.d:
719 年唐以碎叶与突骑施苏禄，改以焉耆为四镇；渤海大武艺“斥大土宇”，东北诸部多畏臣之，726 年唐以黑水靺鞨地置黑水都督府。720 年暾欲谷先破拔悉密于北庭，回师败唐军于删丹；721—722 年六胡州康待宾、康愿子相继作乱；722 年张思礼救小勃律。
727 年吐蕃悉诺逻陷瓜州，闰九月苏禄与吐蕃围安西城；728 年唐破吐蕃于祁连城，729 年三月信安王李祎拔石堡城。730 年契丹可突于杀松漠都督李邵固，率契丹并胁奚附于突厥；同年十月吐蕃请和。
snaps.te: Shibao Fortress taken · Khitan revolt again
snaps.de:
In 719 Tang gave Suyab to Suluk of the Türgesh and made Karasahr one of the Four Garrisons in its place. Dae Muye of Balhae "greatly enlarged his territory", and many of the peoples of the northeast submitted to him out of fear; in 726 Tang set up the Heishui Area Command in the lands of the Heishui Mohe. In 720 Tonyukuk first defeated the Basmyl at Beiting, then turned back and defeated a Tang army at Shandan; in 721–722 Kang Daibin and then Kang Yuanzi of the Six Hu Prefectures rebelled; in 722 Zhang Sili went to the aid of Little Balur.
In 727 Xinuoluo of Tibet took Guazhou, and in the intercalary 9th month Suluk and Tibet besieged the city of Anxi; in 728 Tang defeated Tibet at Qilian City, and in the 3rd month of 729 Li Yi, Prince of Xin'an, took Shibao Fortress. In 730 Ketuyu of the Khitan killed Li Shaogu, area commander of Songmo, and led the Khitan over to the Turks, forcing the Xi to go with them; in the 10th month of the same year Tibet asked for peace.

snaps.d:
731 年唐蕃于赤岭互市，734 年六月（《唐会要》作 733 年九月）立碑分界。732 年九月渤海大武艺遣张文休渡海袭登州，733 年唐发兵并约新罗夹击渤海，新罗遇雪无功；同年闰三月幽州副总管郭英杰败死于都山。734 年十二月张守珪斩可突于，契丹复归唐。
734 年毗伽可汗被毒杀，后突厥渐乱。735 年唐正式以浿江（大同江）以南赐新罗，新罗北界由临津江推到大同江，平壤至清川江一带仍无人据守。733 年分天下为十五道，置采访使。
snaps.te: Chiling boundary · the Paegang as frontier
snaps.de:
In 731 Tang and Tibet opened markets at Chiling, and in the 6th month of 734 (the Tang huiyao gives the 9th month of 733) they set up a stele there to mark the boundary. In the 9th month of 732 Dae Muye of Balhae sent Jang Munhyu across the sea to raid Dengzhou; in 733 Tang sent troops and arranged with Silla to attack Balhae from both sides, but the Silla army ran into snow and achieved nothing; in the intercalary 3rd month of the same year Guo Yingjie, deputy commander of Youzhou, was defeated and killed at Mount Du. In the 12th month of 734 Zhang Shougui beheaded Ketuyu, and the Khitan returned to Tang.
In 734 Bilge Qaghan was poisoned, and the Second Turkic Qaghanate gradually fell into disorder. In 735 Tang formally granted the lands south of the Paegang (Taedong River) to Silla; Silla's northern border moved from the Imjin River to the Taedong River, while the area from Pyongyang to the Chongchon River remained a no-man's-land. In 733 the realm was divided into fifteen circuits, and surveillance commissioners were appointed.

snaps.d:
737 年崔希逸袭吐蕃于青海西；738 年三月杜希望拔吐蕃新城，六月唐廷下令毁赤岭碑，唐蕃重开战端；吐蕃西击勃律，740 年以公主嫁小勃律王，西北二十余国皆附吐蕃。740 年三月章仇兼琼取安戎城。
738 年突骑施苏禄为莫贺达干、都摩度所杀；739 年八月碛西节度使盖嘉运破吐火仙可汗于碎叶城下，擒之，突骑施衰落，余部受唐册封。737 年起蒙舍诏皮罗阁在唐支持下兼并五诏，738 年受封云南王，次年迁都太和城，南诏一统洱海。
snaps.te: Six Zhao united · Türgesh in decline
snaps.de:
In 737 Cui Xiyi made a surprise attack on Tibet west of Qinghai Lake; in the 3rd month of 738 Du Xiwang took the Tibetan stronghold of Xincheng, and in the 6th month the Tang court ordered the Chiling stele destroyed, and war between Tang and Tibet broke out again. Tibet struck west against Balur, and in 740 married a princess to the King of Little Balur; more than twenty states of the northwest all went over to Tibet. In the 3rd month of 740 Zhangchou Jianqiong took Anrong City.
In 738 Suluk of the Türgesh was killed by Baga Tarqan and Dumodu; in the 8th month of 739 Gai Jiayun, military governor of Qixi, defeated Tuhuoxian Qaghan beneath the walls of Suyab and captured him. The Türgesh declined, and their remaining tribes accepted investiture from Tang. From 737 Piluoge of the Mengshe zhao, with Tang support, annexed the other five zhao; in 738 he was invested as Prince of Yunnan, and the next year he moved his capital to Taihe City: Nanzhao unified the Erhai region.

snaps.d:
741 年十二月吐蕃复陷石堡城。742 年改元天宝，边地凡安西、北庭、河西、朔方、河东、范阳、平卢、陇右、剑南九节度与岭南五府经略使，统兵四十九万，改州为郡；743 年四月皇甫惟明破吐蕃洪济城，安东都护府移治辽西故郡城。
742—744 年拔悉密、回纥、葛逻禄共攻后突厥，744 年八月王忠嗣破突厥左厢于萨河内山，回纥骨力裴罗自立为骨咄禄毗伽阙可汗，唐册为怀仁可汗；745 年回纥杀白眉可汗，后突厥亡，回纥据有漠北。同年九月契丹、奚各杀和亲公主叛唐。
snaps.te: Rise of the Uyghurs · ten military commands
snaps.de:
In the 12th month of 741 Tibet took Shibao Fortress again. In 742 the era name was changed to Tianbao; on the frontiers there were nine military governors in all, of Anxi, Beiting, Hexi, Shuofang, Hedong, Fanyang, Pinglu, Longyou and Jiannan, and the commissioner of the Five Commands of Lingnan, commanding 490,000 troops; prefectures were renamed commanderies. In the 4th month of 743 Huangfu Weiming took Hongji City from Tibet, and the Andong Protectorate moved its seat to the old seat of Liaoxi Commandery.
In 742–744 the Basmyl, the Uyghurs and the Karluks jointly attacked the Second Turkic Qaghanate; in the 8th month of 744 Wang Zhongsi defeated the Turkic left wing at Mount Sahenei, and Guli Peiluo of the Uyghurs proclaimed himself Qutlugh Bilge Kül Qaghan and was invested by Tang as Huairen Qaghan. In 745 the Uyghurs killed Baimei Qaghan, the Second Turkic Qaghanate fell, and the Uyghurs held the lands north of the Gobi. In the 9th month of the same year the Khitan and the Xi each killed the princess given to them in marriage and rebelled against Tang.

snaps.d:
747 年七月安西副都护高仙芝率步骑一万越葱岭、坦驹岭，破连云堡，擒小勃律王苏失利之，以其地置归仁军，拂菻、大食诸胡七十二国皆震慑降附。748 年北庭节度使王正见破碎叶城，毁城而还，碎叶仍为突骑施余部所据；哥舒翰于青海筑神威军、应龙城。
749 年六月哥舒翰率陇右、河西及突厥阿布思兵六万余攻拔石堡城，士卒死者数万，闰六月以其地置神武军。745—748 年南诏兼并两爨，迁西爨二十余万户于永昌。
snaps.te: Battle of Shibao Fortress · Little Balur taken
snaps.de:
In the 7th month of 747 Gao Xianzhi, deputy protector-general of Anxi, led 10,000 infantry and cavalry over the Pamirs and the Darkot Pass, took Lianyun Fort and captured Sushilizhi, King of Little Balur, and the Guiren Jun was set up in his lands; the 72 Hu states, Fulin (Byzantium) and the Arab Caliphate among them, were all overawed and submitted. In 748 Wang Zhengjian, military governor of Beiting, took Suyab, razed the city and withdrew, and Suyab remained in the hands of the Türgesh remnants; Geshu Han built the Shenwei Jun and Yinglong City at Qinghai Lake.
In the 6th month of 749 Geshu Han, with over 60,000 troops of Longyou and Hexi and Abusi's Turks, stormed Shibao Fortress at the cost of tens of thousands of dead, and in the intercalary 6th month the Shenwu Jun was set up there. In 745–748 Nanzhao annexed the two Cuan and moved over 200,000 households of the Western Cuan to Yongchang.

snaps.d:
750 年高仙芝假意与石国约和，虏其王献于长安；同年阿拔斯王朝取代倭马亚王朝，唐称黑衣大食。南诏阁罗凤不堪云南太守张虔陀侮辱，攻陷姚州，杀张虔陀。
751 年四月剑南节度使鲜于仲通率兵八万讨南诏，败于西洱河，士卒死者六万；七月高仙芝率蕃汉三万深入怛罗斯，与大食军相持五日，葛逻禄倒戈，唐军大败；八月安禄山讨契丹，败于土护真水。一年之间，唐三面受挫。
snaps.te: Defeats at Talas and the Xi'er River
snaps.de:
In 750 Gao Xianzhi pretended to make peace with Chach, then seized its king and presented him at Chang'an; the same year the Abbasid dynasty, known to Tang as the Black-Robed Arabs, replaced the Umayyad dynasty. Geluofeng of Nanzhao, unable to bear the insults of Zhang Qiantuo, governor of Yunnan Commandery, took Yaozhou and killed Zhang Qiantuo.
In the 4th month of 751 Xianyu Zhongtong, military governor of Jiannan, led 80,000 troops against Nanzhao and was defeated at the Xi'er River, losing 60,000 men; in the 7th month Gao Xianzhi led 30,000 tribal and Han troops deep into Talas and faced the Caliphate army for five days, until the Karluks changed sides and the Tang army was heavily defeated; in the 8th month An Lushan campaigned against the Khitan and was defeated on the Tuhuzhen River. Within a single year Tang suffered defeats on three fronts.

snaps.d: 天宝十四载（755）冬安禄山起兵前的唐朝：边疆设安西、北庭、河西、陇右、朔方、河东、范阳、平卢、剑南、岭南五府十个节度经略使，内地仍以采访使分十五道监察州县。安禄山一人兼领范阳、平卢、河东三镇，统兵近二十万。四周吐蕃、南诏、回纥、渤海、契丹、奚环伺。
snaps.te: Eve of the An Lushan Rebellion
snaps.de: Tang in the winter of Tianbao 14 (755), before An Lushan rose in arms: on the frontiers there were ten military governors and commissioners, of Anxi, Beiting, Hexi, Longyou, Shuofang, Hedong, Fanyang, Pinglu, Jiannan and the Five Commands of Lingnan, while in the interior surveillance commissioners still oversaw the prefectures and counties in fifteen circuits. An Lushan alone held the three commands of Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong, with nearly 200,000 troops. All around, Tibet, Nanzhao, the Uyghurs, Balhae, the Khitan and the Xi watched and waited.

units.note:
杨坚 581 年二月受北周静帝禅位，国号隋，年号开皇；都大兴城（582 年于汉长安城东南新建，583 年迁入），炀帝 605 年起营建东都洛阳。
文帝：开皇律令、三省六部、均田与租调、大索貌阅与输籍法；587 年废后梁，589 年灭陈，结束近三百年南北分裂。
炀帝：开通济渠、永济渠、江南河，三征高句丽，北巡突厥、西巡张掖；609 年设郡一百九十，户八百九十余万，为隋极盛。
611 年后民变四起，616 年炀帝南幸江都，618 年三月宇文化及发动江都之变，炀帝被缢；越王杨侗在东都称帝（皇泰），619 年被王世充所废，隋亡。
units.notee:
Yang Jian accepted the abdication of Emperor Jing of Northern Zhou in the 2nd month of 581, naming his state Sui, with the era name Kaihuang; the capital was Daxing City (newly built in 582 southeast of the Han Chang'an city and occupied in 583), and from 605 Emperor Yang built the Eastern Capital at Luoyang.
Emperor Wen: the Kaihuang Code and Statutes, the Three Departments and Six Ministries, the equal-field system and the grain-and-cloth taxes, the great census with personal inspection (dasuo maoyue) and the tax-assessment register system (shuji fa); in 587 he abolished Later Liang and in 589 destroyed Chen, ending nearly 300 years of division between north and south.
Emperor Yang: opened the Tongji Canal, the Yongji Canal and the Jiangnan Canal, launched three campaigns against Goguryeo, and toured north to the Turks and west to Zhangye; in 609 there were 190 commanderies and over 8.9 million households, the height of Sui.
After 611 popular revolts broke out everywhere; in 616 Emperor Yang went south to Jiangdu, and in the 3rd month of 618 Yuwen Huaji launched the Jiangdu coup and Emperor Yang was strangled; Yang Tong, Prince of Yue, proclaimed himself emperor in the Eastern Capital (era name Huangtai), and when Wang Shichong deposed him in 619 the Sui came to an end.

units.note:
李渊，隋唐国公、太原留守。617 年五月起兵晋阳，七月南下，十一月入长安，立代王杨侑为帝（恭帝），自为唐王；618 年五月受禅，国号唐，年号武德，都长安。
统一战争（618—624，余波至 628）：李世民平薛仁杲（618）、刘武周（620）、王世充与窦建德（621），622 年大破刘黑闼（次年李建成平之）；李孝恭、李靖平萧铣（621）、辅公祏（624）；628 年灭梁师都，天下一统。
626 年六月玄武门之变，八月李世民即位（太宗），次年改元贞观。630 年灭东突厥，被尊为“天可汗”；此后灭高昌（640）、薛延陀（646）、龟兹（648）。
高宗（649—683）时苏定方灭西突厥（657）、平百济（660），李勣平高句丽（668），669 年（总章二年）前后东至朝鲜半岛，西抵咸海、葱岭以西，北逾大漠，南至林邑北境，为唐代疆域极盛。
670 年后吐蕃夺四镇、新罗据半岛、后突厥复兴（682），边疆收缩。690—705 年武则天改国号周（武周），705 年神龙政变后复唐。
708 年张仁愿筑三受降城，阴山以南复归唐；玄宗开元年间（713—741）号称盛世，717 年复置营州，729 年拔石堡城；742 年置十节度经略使，改州为郡。天宝后期边镇坐大，751 年怛罗斯、西洱河两败，755 年冬安禄山起兵范阳。
units.notee:
Li Yuan was the Sui Duke of Tang and custodian of Taiyuan. In the 5th month of 617 he rose in arms at Jinyang, in the 7th month marched south, and in the 11th month entered Chang'an, where he enthroned Yang You, Prince of Dai, as emperor (Emperor Gong) and made himself Prince of Tang; in the 5th month of 618 he accepted the abdication, naming his dynasty Tang, with the era name Wude and the capital at Chang'an.
Wars of unification (618–624, with mopping-up until 628): Li Shimin defeated Xue Rengao (618), Liu Wuzhou (620), Wang Shichong and Dou Jiande (621), and in 622 crushed Liu Heita (finally put down by Li Jiancheng the following year); Li Xiaogong and Li Jing defeated Xiao Xian (621) and Fu Gongshi (624); with the destruction of Liang Shidu in 628 the realm was unified.
In the 6th month of 626 came the Xuanwu Gate incident, and in the 8th month Li Shimin took the throne (Emperor Taizong), changing the era name to Zhenguan the following year. In 630 he destroyed the Eastern Turks and was honored as "Heavenly Qaghan"; he went on to destroy Gaochang (640), the Xueyantuo (646) and Kucha (648).
Under Gaozong (649–683), Su Dingfang destroyed the Western Turks (657) and conquered Baekje (660), and Li Ji conquered Goguryeo (668); around 669 (Zongzhang 2) the empire reached the Korean Peninsula in the east, the Aral Sea and beyond the Pamirs in the west, beyond the Gobi in the north and the northern border of Linyi in the south, the greatest territorial extent of the Tang dynasty.
After 670 Tibet seized the Four Garrisons, Silla took the peninsula and the Turks revived as the Second Turkic Qaghanate (682), and the frontiers shrank. Wu Zetian changed the dynasty's name to Zhou (Wu Zhou, 690–705), and after the Shenlong coup of 705 the Tang was restored.
In 708 Zhang Renyuan built the Three Shouxiang Cities, and the lands south of the Yin Mountains returned to Tang. The Kaiyuan era of Xuanzong (713–741) was hailed as a golden age; Yingzhou was re-established in 717 and Shibao Fortress was stormed in 729; in 742 ten military governors and commissioners were set up and the prefectures were renamed commanderies. In the late Tianbao era the frontier commands grew too powerful; in 751 came the two defeats at Talas and on the Xi'er River, and in the winter of 755 An Lushan rose in arms at Fanyang.

units.note:
陈霸先 557 年代梁所建，都建康。579 年失淮南于北周，此后以长江为界与北朝对峙；后主陈叔宝（582—589 在位）荒于酒色。
589 年正月隋军贺若弼、韩擒虎渡江，攻入建康，后主被俘，陈亡；岭南冼夫人随后率众归隋。
units.notee:
Founded in 557 by Chen Baxian, who supplanted Liang, with its capital at Jiankang. In 579 it lost Huainan to Northern Zhou, and thereafter it faced the Northern Dynasties across the Yangtze; the Last Ruler, Chen Shubao (r. 582–589), indulged in wine and women.
In the 1st month of 589 the Sui forces of Heruo Bi and Han Qinhu crossed the Yangtze and stormed Jiankang; the Last Ruler was captured and Chen fell. Lady Xian of Lingnan then led her people in submitting to Sui.

units.note:
萧詧 555 年在西魏扶植下据江陵称帝，史称后梁或西梁，为北周、隋附庸，疆域仅江陵一隅“方三百里”。
587 年隋文帝征后主萧琮入朝，废其国；萧琮之族子即后来起兵巴陵的萧铣。
units.notee:
Xiao Cha proclaimed himself emperor at Jiangling in 555 with Western Wei backing; known to history as Later Liang or Western Liang, it was a vassal of Northern Zhou and Sui, its territory confined to the area around Jiangling, "300 li square".
In 587 Emperor Wen of Sui summoned its Last Ruler, Xiao Cong, to court and abolished the state; Xiao Cong's clan nephew was Xiao Xian, who later rose in arms at Baling.

units.note:
北齐营州刺史，齐亡后不降北周，据营州（今辽宁朝阳），联结突厥、契丹，拥戴流亡突厥的北齐宗室高绍义。
583 年隋军击败突厥后，高宝宁众叛亲离，为部下所杀。
units.notee:
Northern Qi prefect of Yingzhou; when Qi fell he refused to surrender to Northern Zhou, held Yingzhou (modern Chaoyang, Liaoning) and allied with the Turks and the Khitan, and upheld Gao Shaoyi of the Northern Qi imperial house, then in exile among the Turks.
In 583, after Sui forces defeated the Turks, Gao Baoning was deserted by his followers and kin and was killed by his own men.

units.note:
交州豪族李贲 541 年起兵、544 年称帝（越南史称前李朝），李佛子承其余绪，据交州龙编一带，名义上奉南朝。
602 年隋以刘方为交州道行军总管，李佛子请降，被送往长安，交州归隋。
units.notee:
The Jiaozhou magnate Lý Bí rose in arms in 541 and proclaimed himself emperor in 544 (the Early Lý dynasty in Vietnamese history); Lý Phật Tử carried on his cause, holding the area around Longbian in Jiaozhou and nominally acknowledging the Southern Dynasties.
In 602 Sui appointed Liu Fang expedition commander of the Jiaozhou route; Lý Phật Tử asked to surrender and was sent to Chang'an, and Jiaozhou came under Sui.

units.note:
突厥 552 年由阿史那土门建国，灭柔然，木杆可汗时东至辽海、西至西海（里海）。581 年隋立时可汗为沙钵略。
583 年隋分化离间，阿波可汗、达头可汗与沙钵略决裂，突厥分为东西。599 年突利可汗（启民）南投隋，隋为筑大利城；启民在隋扶持下统一东突厥，臣属于隋。
始毕可汗（609—619）乘隋乱复强，615 年围炀帝于雁门；隋末群雄刘武周、梁师都、窦建德乃至李渊皆曾向其称臣借兵。颉利可汗（620—630）屡次南侵，626 年兵临渭水便桥。
630 年李靖、李勣大破颉利于阴山，颉利被擒，东突厥亡；部众降唐，散处漠南，唐设定襄、云中等都督府安置。
units.notee:
The Turks founded their state in 552 under Ashina Tumen and destroyed the Rouran; under Muqan Qaghan their realm reached the Liao Sea in the east and the Western Sea (the Caspian) in the west. When Sui was founded in 581, the qaghan was Ishbara.
In 583 Sui sowed discord among them: Apa Qaghan and Tardu Qaghan broke with Ishbara, and the Turks split into east and west. In 599 Tuli Qaghan (Qimin) came south to submit to Sui, which built Dali City for him; with Sui backing Qimin unified the Eastern Turks and became a Sui vassal.
Shibi Qaghan (609–619) grew strong again amid the Sui disorder and in 615 besieged Emperor Yang at Yanmen; the late-Sui contenders Liu Wuzhou, Liang Shidu, Dou Jiande and even Li Yuan all declared themselves his subjects and borrowed troops from him. Illig Qaghan (620–630) repeatedly invaded the south, and in 626 his army reached the Bian Bridge over the Wei.
In 630 Li Jing and Li Ji crushed Illig at the Yin Mountains; Illig was captured and the Eastern Turks fell. Their people surrendered to Tang and were dispersed south of the Gobi, where Tang set up the Dingxiang, Yunzhong and other area commands to settle them.

units.note:
583 年突厥东西分裂后，达头、阿波一系据金山以西，牙帐在鹰娑川、千泉，控有天山南北、七河、昭武九姓与吐火罗诸国，西与萨珊波斯接壤。
统叶护可汗（618—628）时最盛，“霸有西域”，玄奘西行途中在碎叶附近见之。此后内乱分裂为咄陆、弩失毕两部。
651 年阿史那贺鲁叛唐，自称沙钵罗可汗，复统十姓；657 年冬苏定方破之于曳咥河，次年擒贺鲁于石国，唐分其地置昆陵、濛池二都护府。
units.notee:
After the Turks split into east and west in 583, the line of Tardu and Apa held the lands west of the Altai Mountains, with royal camps in the Yulduz valley and at Mingbulak, controlling the lands north and south of the Tian Shan, Semirechye, the Sogdian states and the states of Tokharistan, and bordering Sasanian Persia to the west.
It was at its height under Tong Yabghu Qaghan (618–628), who "dominated the Western Regions"; Xuanzang met him near Suyab during his journey west. Later, internal strife split it into the Duolu and Nushibi divisions.
In 651 Ashina Helu rebelled against Tang, styled himself Shaboluo Qaghan and reunited the Ten Tribes; in the winter of 657 Su Dingfang defeated him on the Irtysh and the following year captured Helu in Chach, and Tang divided his lands between the Kunling and Mengchi Protectorates.

units.note:
鲜卑慕容部西迁所建，以青海湖西伏俟城为都，控制“河南道”丝路。609 年隋炀帝亲征，伏允可汗南奔党项，隋于其地置西海、河源、鄯善、且末四郡。
隋末伏允复国。634—635 年李靖、侯君集远征，伏允败死，唐立其子慕容顺、孙诺曷钵，吐谷浑臣属于唐，弘化公主下嫁诺曷钵。
663 年吐蕃攻灭吐谷浑，诺曷钵率残部奔凉州，后迁灵州一带。
units.notee:
Founded by the Murong tribe of the Xianbei after they migrated west, with its capital at Fuqi City west of Qinghai Lake, it controlled the "Henan Road" of the Silk Road. In 609 Emperor Yang of Sui led a campaign in person; Fuyun Qaghan fled south to the Tanguts, and Sui set up four commanderies in his lands: Xihai, Heyuan, Shanshan and Qiemo.
Fuyun restored his state at the end of Sui. In 634–635 Li Jing and Hou Junji led a distant expedition; Fuyun was defeated and died, Tang installed his son Murong Shun and grandson Nuohebo, the Tuyuhun became a Tang vassal, and Princess Honghua was married to Nuohebo.
In 663 Tibet attacked and destroyed the Tuyuhun; Nuohebo fled with the remnants of his people to Liangzhou and later moved to the Lingzhou area.

units.note:
麴氏高昌（499—640），都高昌城（今吐鲁番高昌故城），汉人为主的绿洲王国。麴伯雅 609 年朝隋，娶华容公主；麴文泰 630 年（一说 628 年）厚礼玄奘，结为兄弟。
后麴文泰附西突厥、阻绝西域商路，640 年侯君集破之，唐于其地置西州，以交河城为安西都护府治所。
units.notee:
Gaochang under the Qu family (499–640), with its capital at Gaochang City (today the Gaochang ruins, Turpan, Xinjiang), was an oasis kingdom with a mainly Han Chinese population. Qu Boya paid court to Sui in 609 and married Princess Huarong; in 630 (or 628) Qu Wentai received Xuanzang with rich gifts and swore brotherhood with him.
Qu Wentai later sided with the Western Turks and blocked the trade routes of the Western Regions; in 640 Hou Junji conquered it, and Tang set up Xizhou in its lands, making Jiaohe City the seat of the Anxi Protectorate.

units.note: 龙氏焉耆，西域北道绿洲国。644 年郭孝恪破之，648 年起为安西四镇之一（焉耆镇），670 年代以碎叶代之。
units.notee: Karasahr under the Long family, an oasis state on the northern route of the Western Regions. Guo Xiaoke defeated it in 644; from 648 it was one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi (Karasahr Garrison), and in the 670s Suyab replaced it.

units.note: 白氏龟兹，西域大国，佛教与乐舞中心，鸠摩罗什故乡。648 年阿史那社尔、郭孝恪破之，安西都护府移治于此，为四镇之首。
units.notee: Kucha under the Bai family, a great state of the Western Regions, a center of Buddhism, music and dance, and the homeland of Kumarajiva. In 648 Ashina She'er and Guo Xiaoke conquered it; the Anxi Protectorate moved its seat here, and it was the first of the Four Garrisons.

units.note: 尉迟氏于阗，西域南道大国，以美玉、佛教著称。648 年龟兹之役后降唐，为安西四镇之一。
units.notee: Khotan under the Yuchi family, a great state on the southern route of the Western Regions, famed for its fine jade and its Buddhism. It surrendered to Tang after the Kucha campaign of 648 and became one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi.

units.note: 裴氏疏勒，扼葱岭东麓。648 年归唐，为安西四镇之一；后屡为吐蕃、西突厥余部所扰。
units.notee: Kashgar under the Pei family, commanding the eastern foot of the Pamirs. It submitted to Tang in 648 and became one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi; it was later repeatedly harassed by Tibet and by remnants of the Western Turks.

units.note:
高氏王朝，427 年迁都平壤（586 年移居长安城），据辽东与朝鲜半岛北部。598 年起隋文帝、炀帝四次东征（612 萨水之败），皆无功。
642 年泉盖苏文（渊盖苏文）弑荣留王，专权；645 年唐太宗亲征，克辽东、白岩等十城，阻于安市城而还。
666 年盖苏文死，诸子相争，长子泉男生降唐；668 年九月李勣、薛仁贵攻破平壤，宝藏王降，高句丽亡，唐置安东都护府。
units.notee:
Ruled by the Go dynasty, it moved its capital to Pyongyang in 427 (and to Jangan Fortress in 586) and held Liaodong and the northern Korean Peninsula. From 598 Emperor Wen and Emperor Yang of Sui launched four eastern campaigns against it (the defeat on the Salsu in 612), all without success.
In 642 Yeon Gaesomun killed King Yeongnyu and seized power; in 645 Emperor Taizong of Tang led a campaign in person, took ten fortresses including Yodong and Baegam, and turned back after being held at Ansi Fortress.
In 666 Gaesomun died and his sons fought among themselves; the eldest, Yeon Namsaeng, surrendered to Tang. In the 9th month of 668 Li Ji and Xue Rengui stormed Pyongyang, King Bojang surrendered, Goguryeo fell, and Tang set up the Andong Protectorate.

units.note:
扶余氏百济，都泗沘城（今韩国扶余），据半岛西南，与倭国交好、与新罗世仇。
660 年唐苏定方与新罗金庾信水陆合击，泗沘陷，义慈王降；唐置熊津等五都督府。
鬼室福信、僧道琛迎王子扶余丰于倭国，据周留城复国，倭国发兵援助；663 年八月唐军刘仁轨大败倭、百济联军于白江口，周留城陷，复国失败。
units.notee:
Baekje under the Buyeo family, with its capital at Sabi (modern Buyeo, South Chungcheong, South Korea), held the southwest of the peninsula; it was on good terms with Wa and a long-standing enemy of Silla.
In 660 the Tang general Su Dingfang and the Silla general Kim Yu-sin attacked together by land and sea; Sabi fell and King Uija surrendered, and Tang set up five area commands, including Ungjin.
Gwisil Boksin and the monk Dochim brought Prince Buyeo Pung back from Wa and restored the state from Juryu Fortress, with Wa sending troops to help; in the 8th month of 663 the Tang force under Liu Rengui crushed the allied Wa and Baekje army at Baekgang, Juryu Fortress fell, and the restoration failed.

units.note:
金氏新罗，都金城（今韩国庆州）。6 世纪真兴王夺取汉江流域，打通对华航路。善德女王、真德女王时依附唐朝，648 年金春秋入唐结盟。
660 年联唐灭百济，668 年联唐灭高句丽；663 年唐以其地为鸡林州都督府，以新罗王为都督。此后与唐争夺百济、高句丽故地（670—676）。
675 年买肖城、676 年伎伐浦之战后唐军退出半岛，新罗北界先到临津江一带；735 年唐正式以浿江（大同江）以南赐新罗。
units.notee:
Silla under the Kim family, with its capital at Geumseong (modern Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang, South Korea). In the 6th century King Jinheung seized the Han River basin, opening a sea route to China. Under Queen Seondeok and Queen Jindeok it aligned itself with Tang, and in 648 Kim Chunchu went to Tang to conclude an alliance.
Allied with Tang, it destroyed Baekje in 660 and Goguryeo in 668; in 663 Tang made its territory the Gyerim Area Command, with the King of Silla as area commander. Thereafter it fought Tang for the former lands of Baekje and Goguryeo (670–676).
After the battles of Maeso Fortress in 675 and Gibeolpo in 676 the Tang army withdrew from the peninsula, and Silla's northern border at first reached the area of the Imjin River; in 735 Tang formally granted Silla the land south of the Paegang (the Taedong River).

units.note:
大和政权，都飞鸟。600、607 年遣使入隋（607 年国书称“日出处天子致书日没处天子”），630 年起派遣唐使。
645 年乙巳之变后推行大化改新，仿隋唐制度；663 年出兵援助百济复国，大败于白江口，此后筑水城、山城防御唐朝，后改国号日本（702 年遣唐使始以日本之名入唐，见日本）。
units.notee:
The Yamato polity, with its capital at Asuka. It sent embassies to Sui in 600 and 607 (the 607 letter read "The Son of Heaven where the sun rises sends a letter to the Son of Heaven where the sun sets"), and from 630 sent embassies to Tang.
After the Isshi Incident of 645 it carried out the Taika Reform, modeled on Sui and Tang institutions; in 663 it sent troops to help restore Baekje and was heavily defeated at Baekgang, after which it built the Mizuki ("water fortress") and mountain fortresses against Tang, and later changed its name to Japan (in 702 an embassy first came to Tang under the name Japan; see Japan).

units.note: 占婆人所建，都典冲（今越南岘港茶荞）。605 年隋将刘方击破林邑王范梵志，入其都，隋于其地置比景、海阴、林邑三郡；隋末范梵志复国，遣使称藩。唐至德（756—758）以后改称环王，9 世纪后期起称占城。
units.notee: Founded by the Cham, with its capital at Simhapura (modern Trà Kiệu, Đà Nẵng, Vietnam). In 605 the Sui general Liu Fang defeated Sambhuvarman, King of Linyi, and entered his capital, and Sui set up three commanderies there: Bijing, Haiyin and Linyi; at the end of Sui, Sambhuvarman restored his state and sent envoys declaring himself a vassal. After the Zhide era of Tang (756–758) it was renamed Huanwang, and from the late 9th century it was called Zhancheng.

units.note: 高棉人所建，本扶南属国。6 世纪末至 7 世纪初兼并扶南，伊奢那跋摩建都伊奢那城（今柬埔寨三波坡雷古），616 年遣使入隋。神龙（705—707）以后分为二：北部多山阜的称陆真腊，唐人称文单国；南部近海的称水真腊（见水真腊）。
units.notee: Founded by the Khmer, originally a vassal of Funan. Between the late 6th and early 7th centuries it annexed Funan, and Ishanavarman built his capital at Ishanapura (modern Sambor Prei Kuk, Kampong Thom, Cambodia); in 616 it sent envoys to Sui. After the Shenlong era (705–707) it split in two: the hilly northern part was called Land Chenla, which the Tang called the state of Wendan; the southern part, near the sea, was called Water Chenla (see Water Chenla).

units.note: 骠人城邦，都室利差呾罗（今缅甸卑谬附近），信奉佛教，唐代以骠国乐闻名。
units.notee: City-states of the Pyu, with their capital at Sri Ksetra (near modern Pyay, Myanmar); Buddhist, and famed in Tang times for Pyu music.

units.note: 孟人所建的佛教王国，位于今泰国湄南河下游，638、649 年遣使入唐。
units.notee: A Buddhist kingdom founded by the Mon, on the lower Chao Phraya in today's Thailand; it sent envoys to Tang in 638 and 649.

units.note:
五天竺诸国。606—647 年戒日王（尸罗逸多）统一北天竺，都曲女城，玄奘曾在其国参加无遮大会。
641 年戒日王遣使入唐；647 年戒日王死，臣下阿罗那顺篡位，劫掠唐使王玄策，次年王玄策借吐蕃、泥婆罗兵破之，擒阿罗那顺献于长安。
units.notee:
The states of the Five Indias. Between 606 and 647 Harsha (Siladitya) unified northern India, with his capital at Kanyakubja; Xuanzang took part in a great open assembly in his kingdom.
In 641 Harsha sent envoys to Tang; when he died in 647 his minister Arunasva usurped the throne and plundered the Tang envoy Wang Xuance, and the next year Wang Xuance, with troops borrowed from Tibet and Nepal, defeated him, captured Arunasva and presented him at Chang'an.

units.note: 今尼泊尔加德满都谷地的王国，7 世纪臣属吐蕃，尺尊公主嫁松赞干布；648 年出兵助王玄策。
units.notee: A kingdom in today's Kathmandu Valley, Nepal; in the 7th century it was subject to Tibet, and Princess Bhrikuti married Songtsen Gampo; in 648 it sent troops to help Wang Xuance.

units.note: 今克什米尔谷地的佛教王国，玄奘在此留学两年。
units.notee: A Buddhist kingdom in today's Kashmir Valley, where Xuanzang studied for two years.

units.note:
萨珊王朝，与突厥争夺中亚。636 年起被阿拉伯人连败，651 年末代君主伊嗣俟三世在木鹿被杀，萨珊亡。
其子卑路斯东奔吐火罗，向唐求援；661 年唐以疾陵城为波斯都督府，以卑路斯为都督，实为名义安置。
units.notee:
The Sasanian dynasty, which contended with the Turks for Central Asia. From 636 it suffered successive defeats by the Arabs; in 651 the last ruler, Yazdegerd III, was killed at Merv, and the Sasanian state fell.
His son Peroz fled east to Tokharistan and asked Tang for help; in 661 Tang made Zaranj the Persian Area Command with Peroz as its area commander, in reality only a nominal arrangement.

units.note: 阿拉伯帝国（正统哈里发，661 年起为倭马亚王朝）。651 年夺取木鹿，控有呼罗珊，此后不断向河中地区推进，651 年遣使入唐。705—715 年呼罗珊总督屈底波攻取吐火罗、布哈拉、撒马尔罕、花剌子模与石国、拔汗那，另一路由穆罕默德·本·卡西姆率领，711—712 年东取信度；750 年阿拔斯王朝代倭马亚王朝（唐称黑衣大食，倭马亚为白衣大食），751 年怛罗斯之战败高仙芝。
units.notee: The Arab empire (the Rashidun Caliphate, and from 661 the Umayyad dynasty). In 651 it took Merv and controlled Khorasan, thereafter pressing steadily into Transoxiana; in 651 it sent envoys to Tang. In 705–715 Qutayba ibn Muslim, governor of Khorasan, took Tokharistan, Bukhara, Samarkand, Khwarazm, Chach and Ferghana, and another army under Muhammad ibn al-Qasim took Sindh in the east in 711–712; in 750 the Abbasid dynasty replaced the Umayyad dynasty (Tang called the Abbasids the Black-Robed Arabs and the Umayyads the White-Robed Arabs), and in 751 it defeated Gao Xianzhi at the Battle of Talas.

units.note: 阿姆河上游两岸及兴都库什山一带的诸小国（活国、缚喝、骨咄、帆延、罽宾等），嚈哒灭亡后属西突厥，西突厥叶护坐镇活国。661 年唐以其地为月氏、条支、写凤、修鲜等十六都督府。8 世纪初为大食所侵，吐火罗叶护仍屡遣使入唐求援。
units.notee: The small states on both banks of the upper Amu Darya and in the Hindu Kush (Warwaliz, Balkh, Khuttal, Bamiyan, Jibin and others); after the fall of the Hephthalites they were subject to the Western Turks, and a Western Turkic yabghu was stationed at Warwaliz. In 661 Tang made the region into sixteen area commands, including Yuezhi, Tiaozhi, Xiefeng and Xiuxian. In the early 8th century it was invaded by the Arab Caliphate, but the Tokharistan yabghu still repeatedly sent envoys to Tang to ask for help.

units.note: 粟特诸城邦：康（萨末建）、安（布豁）、石（柘支）、史、米、何、曹、火寻、戊地等，以商业贯通丝路，长期附属西突厥。658 年后唐于其地置康居、大宛、安息等都督府州，隶安西都护府。705—715 年间为大食屈底波所征服，诸国仍向唐朝贡、请援，唐册封其王。
units.notee: The Sogdian city-states: Samarkand, Bukhara, Chach, Kesh, Maymurgh, Kushaniya, Kabudhan, Khwarazm, Betik and others, whose trade linked the Silk Road and which were long subject to the Western Turks. After 658 Tang set up area commands and prefectures there, such as Kangju, Dawan and Anxi Zhou, under the Anxi Protectorate. In 705–715 they were conquered by Qutayba ibn Muslim of the Arab Caliphate, but the states still sent tribute to Tang and asked for help, and Tang invested their kings.

units.note: 今费尔干纳盆地的王国，以汗血马著称，658 年唐置休循州都督府。715 年大食与吐蕃另立阿了达为王，张孝嵩发安西兵讨平；744 年改国名为宁远，唐以和义公主嫁其王。
units.notee: A kingdom in today's Ferghana Valley, famed for its blood-sweating horses; in 658 Tang set up the Xiuxun Zhou Area Command there. In 715 the Arab Caliphate and Tibet set up another king, Aliaoda, and Zhang Xiaosong raised troops from Anxi and put him down; in 744 the name of the state was changed to Ningyuan, and Tang married Princess Heyi to its king.

units.note:
雅隆河谷的悉补野部，6 世纪末至 7 世纪初兼并苏毗等部。松赞干布（629—650 在位）统一高原，迁都逻些，创制文字；641 年迎娶文成公主，并娶泥婆罗尺尊公主。
此后陆续征服羊同（644）、白兰、党项诸羌；663 年灭吐谷浑，670 年大非川之战击败薛仁贵，与唐争夺安西四镇百余年。
禄东赞 667 年卒后，其子论钦陵兄弟专政，696 年素罗汗山大败王孝杰；699 年赞普亲讨论钦陵，论钦陵兵溃自杀，赞婆降唐。710 年迎金城公主，得河西九曲；此后与唐反复争夺石堡城、小勃律，734 年赤岭立碑分界，738 年后战事再起。752 年册封南诏为“赞普钟”。
units.notee:
The Pugyal clan of the Yarlung valley, which annexed Sumpa and other peoples between the late 6th and early 7th centuries. Songtsen Gampo (r. 629–650) unified the plateau, moved the capital to Rasa and created a script; in 641 he married Princess Wencheng, and he also married Princess Bhrikuti of Nepal.
It went on to conquer Zhangzhung (644), the Bailan, the Tanguts and other Qiang; in 663 it destroyed the Tuyuhun, in 670 defeated Xue Rengui at the Battle of Dafeichuan, and it contested the Four Garrisons of Anxi with Tang for over a century.
After Gar Tongtsen died in 667, his son Gar Trinring and his brothers held power, and in 696 they crushed Wang Xiaojie at Mount Suluohan; in 699 the tsenpo himself marched against Gar Trinring; Gar Trinring's army broke up and he killed himself, and Gar Tsenba surrendered to Tang. In 710 Tibet received Princess Jincheng and gained Jiuqu west of the Yellow River; thereafter it fought Tang again and again over Shibao Fortress and Little Balur; in 734 a stele was erected at Chiling to mark the boundary, but after 738 fighting resumed. In 752 it invested Nanzhao as "Tsenpo Zhong" ("younger brother of the tsenpo").

units.note: 藏北羌塘与那曲一带的女王国（孙波），7 世纪初被悉补野部征服，成为吐蕃的重要组成部分。
units.notee: A queen-ruled kingdom (Sunbo) around the Changtang and Nagqu in northern Tibet; conquered by the Pugyal in the early 7th century, it became an important part of Tibet.

units.note: 今西藏阿里一带的古国，本教发源地，都穹窿银城。644 年前后为吐蕃所灭。
units.notee: An ancient kingdom around today's Ngari, Tibet, the birthplace of Bon, with its capital at Khyunglung Ngulkhar. Destroyed by Tibet around 644.

units.note: 川西高原的嘉良、东女诸羌部族，《隋书》称附国，与隋唐时通贡使，后多为吐蕃所并。
units.ne: Fuguo, Eastern Women's Kingdom and Qiang tribes
units.notee: The Jialiang, Eastern Women and other Qiang tribes of the western Sichuan plateau, called Fuguo in the Book of Sui; from time to time they sent tribute missions to Sui and Tang, and most were later absorbed by Tibet.

units.note: 羌人一支，分布今川西北、青海东南。635 年拓跋赤辞降唐，唐置羁縻州三十余，隶松州都督府；西部诸部 660 年代为吐蕃所并；此后诸部陆续内徙庆、灵、银、夏诸州。
units.notee: A branch of the Qiang, spread across today's northwestern Sichuan and southeastern Qinghai. In 635 Tuoba Chici surrendered to Tang, which set up over thirty loose-rein prefectures under the Songzhou Area Command; the western tribes were absorbed by Tibet in the 660s; thereafter the tribes moved inland one after another to Qingzhou, Lingzhou, Yinzhou and Xiazhou.

units.note: 居于今青海玛多、柴达木南缘的羌部，先附吐谷浑，7 世纪中叶为吐蕃所并。
units.notee: A Qiang tribe living around today's Madoi, Qinghai, and the southern edge of the Qaidam Basin; first subject to the Tuyuhun, it was absorbed by Tibet in the mid-7th century.

units.note: 南中大姓爨氏世据滇东（今云南曲靖一带）。597 年史万岁南征爨翫，隋末复自立；621 年唐置南宁州，以爨弘达为昆州刺史。745—748 年间为南诏所并，西爨二十余万户被迁往永昌。
units.notee: The Cuan, a great clan of Nanzhong, held eastern Yunnan (around today's Qujing, Yunnan) for generations. In 597 Shi Wansui campaigned south against Cuan Wan; at the end of Sui the clan again made itself independent; in 621 Tang set up Nanning Zhou, and Cuan Hongda was made prefect of Kunzhou. In 745–748 it was absorbed by Nanzhao, and over 200,000 households of the Western Cuan were moved to Yongchang.

units.note: 洱海周边的乌蛮、白蛮部落，蒙舍、蒙巂等六诏并立；664 年唐置姚州都督府管辖。680 年前后西洱诸蛮多附吐蕃；738 年蒙舍诏皮罗阁兼并五诏，建立南诏（见南诏）。
units.notee: The Wuman and Baiman tribes around Erhai Lake, among whom the Six Zhao, including Mengshe and Mengxi, coexisted; in 664 Tang set up the Yaozhou Area Command to govern them. Around 680 most of the Xi'er tribes submitted to Tibet; in 738 Piluoge of the Mengshe zhao annexed the other five zhao and founded Nanzhao (see Nanzhao).

units.note: 今贵州中部的牂柯、东谢、西赵诸部，621 年起先后内附，唐置牂州等羁縻州。
units.notee: The Zangke, Dongxie, Xizhao and other tribes of today's central Guizhou; from 621 they submitted to the empire one after another, and Tang set up Zangzhou and other loose-rein prefectures.

units.note: 居潢水（西拉木伦河）、土河（老哈河）流域的鲜卑别部，大贺氏部落联盟。648 年窟哥率众内附，唐置松漠都督府，以窟哥为都督、赐姓李。696 年李尽忠、孙万荣陷营州叛唐，697 年败散后附后突厥；716 年李失活归唐，复置松漠都督府；730 年可突于杀李邵固，叛附突厥，734 年张守珪斩可突于，契丹复归；745 年又杀静乐公主叛唐，751 年安禄山讨之，大败于土护真水。
units.notee: A branch of the Xianbei living in the basins of the Huang River (Xar Moron) and the Tu River (Laoha River), a tribal confederation led by the Dahe clan. In 648 Kuge led his people to submit to the empire; Tang set up the Songmo Area Command, made Kuge its area commander and granted him the surname Li. In 696 Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong took Yingzhou and rebelled against Tang; after they were defeated and scattered in 697 the Khitan submitted to the Second Turks. In 716 Li Shihuo returned to Tang, and the Songmo Area Command was re-established; in 730 Ketuyu killed Li Shaogu and rebelled, going over to the Turks, and in 734 Zhang Shougui beheaded Ketuyu and the Khitan returned to Tang; in 745 they killed Princess Jingle and rebelled against Tang again, and in 751 An Lushan campaigned against them and was heavily defeated on the Tuhuzhen River.

units.note: 库莫奚，居契丹西南、今河北承德与内蒙古宁城一带。648 年内附，唐置饶乐都督府。696—716 年附后突厥；716 年李大酺归唐，复置饶乐都督府；730 年随契丹叛，732 年复归；745 年杀宜芳公主叛唐。
units.notee: The Kumo Xi, living southwest of the Khitan, around today's Chengde, Hebei, and Ningcheng, Inner Mongolia. They submitted to the empire in 648, and Tang set up the Raole Area Command. In 696–716 they were subject to the Second Turks; in 716 Li Dapu returned to Tang, and the Raole Area Command was re-established; in 730 they joined the Khitan in revolt and in 732 returned to Tang; in 745 they killed Princess Yifang and rebelled against Tang.

units.note: 居奚之北的小部落，附于突厥、奚。
