units.notee: A small tribe living north of the Xi, subject to the Turks and the Xi.

units.note: 大兴安岭东西的森林、草原部落，分南、北、钵、深末怛、大室韦等，隋唐时附属突厥，后蒙兀室韦即蒙古之先。
units.notee: Forest and steppe tribes on both sides of the Greater Khingan, divided into the Southern, Northern, Bo, Shenmoda and Great Shiwei, among others; in Sui and Tang times they were subject to the Turks, and the later Mengwu Shiwei were the ancestors of the Mongols.

units.note: 粟末、白山、伯咄、安车骨、拂涅、号室、黑水七部，粟末、白山附高句丽，黑水最北最强；698 年粟末部大祚荣建震国（后称渤海），粟末、白山诸部归之，黑水部另见黑水靺鞨。
units.notee: Seven tribes: Sumo, Baishan, Boduo, Anchegu, Funie, Haoshi and Heishui; the Sumo and Baishan were subject to Goguryeo, and the Heishui were the northernmost and strongest; in 698 Dae Joyeong of the Sumo tribe founded Jin (later called Balhae), and the Sumo, Baishan and other tribes joined him; for the Heishui tribe see Heishui Mohe.

units.note:
铁勒诸部之一。627 年联合回纥等叛离东突厥，628 年夷男称可汗，629 年受唐册封为真珠毗伽可汗，牙帐在郁督军山，“胜兵二十万”。
641 年南侵被李勣破于诺真水；646 年唐与回纥夹击，薛延陀亡，铁勒诸部归唐。
units.notee:
One of the Tiele tribes. In 627, together with the Huihe (Uyghurs) and others, it broke away from the Eastern Turks; in 628 Yinan proclaimed himself qaghan, and in 629 Tang invested him as Zhenzhu Bilge Qaghan; his royal camp was at Ötüken, with "200,000 fighting men".
In 641 it invaded the south and was defeated by Li Ji on the Nuozhen River; in 646 Tang and the Huihe attacked it from both sides, the Xueyantuo fell, and the Tiele tribes submitted to Tang.

units.note:
瓦岗军本为东郡翟让所聚（611），李密 616 年入伙。617 年二月李密袭取兴洛仓，开仓赈济，自称魏公，围东都洛阳；同年冬杀翟让。
“赵、魏以南，江、淮以北”群雄多附之。618 年七月童山之战败宇文化及，九月在邙山被王世充击败，十月率残部降唐，年底叛走，被杀于熊耳山。
units.notee:
The Wagang army was originally gathered by Zhai Rang of Dong Commandery (611), and Li Mi joined it in 616. In the 2nd month of 617 Li Mi seized the Xingluo Granary by surprise and opened it to relieve the hungry, styled himself Duke of Wei and besieged the Eastern Capital, Luoyang; in the winter of the same year he killed Zhai Rang.
Most of the contenders "south of Zhao and Wei and north of the Yangtze and Huai" attached themselves to him. In the 7th month of 618 he defeated Yuwen Huaji at the Battle of Tongshan, in the 9th month was defeated by Wang Shichong at Mount Mang, and in the 10th month surrendered to Tang with his remaining forces; at the end of the year he rebelled and fled, and was killed in the Xiong'er Mountains.

units.note:
窦建德，贝州漳南人，611 年起参加高士达起义，聚众高鸡泊。617 年正月称长乐王，七月于七里井大破隋将薛世雄；618 年十一月称夏王，619 年灭宇文化及，迁都洺州，河北尽为其有。
621 年率十余万众救援王世充，五月被李世民大败于虎牢，被擒后斩于长安。其部将刘黑闼随即起兵复仇。
units.notee:
Dou Jiande, a native of Zhangnan in Beizhou, joined Gao Shida's uprising from 611 and gathered followers at Gaoji Marsh. In the 1st month of 617 he styled himself Prince of Changle, and in the 7th month crushed the Sui general Xue Shixiong at Qilijing; in the 11th month of 618 he styled himself Prince of Xia, and in 619 he destroyed Yuwen Huaji and moved his capital to Mingzhou, and all of Hebei was his.
In 621 he led over 100,000 men to relieve Wang Shichong, and in the 5th month was crushed by Li Shimin at Hulao; he was captured and beheaded at Chang'an. His general Liu Heita promptly rose in arms to avenge him.

units.note:
王世充，隋江都通守，617 年奉诏率江淮兵赴东都抗击李密。618 年炀帝死后与元文都等拥立越王杨侗（皇泰主），随即专权；九月邙山大败李密，尽收其众。
619 年四月废杨侗，称帝，国号郑。620 年七月李世民东征，围洛阳八月；621 年五月窦建德援军败于虎牢，王世充出降，赦为庶人徙蜀，未行即为仇人独孤修德所杀。
units.notee:
Wang Shichong, Sui vice-governor (tongshou) of Jiangdu, was sent by imperial order in 617 with troops from Jianghuai to the Eastern Capital to fight Li Mi. After Emperor Yang's death in 618 he and Yuan Wendu and others enthroned Yang Tong, Prince of Yue (the Huangtai emperor), and he soon took power for himself; in the 9th month he crushed Li Mi at Mount Mang and took over all his forces.
In the 4th month of 619 he deposed Yang Tong and proclaimed himself emperor, naming his state Zheng. In the 7th month of 620 Li Shimin campaigned east and besieged Luoyang for eight months; in the 5th month of 621, after Dou Jiande's relief army was defeated at Hulao, Wang Shichong came out and surrendered, was spared, reduced to a commoner and banished to Shu, but before he set out he was killed by his enemy Dugu Xiude.

units.note:
刘武周，马邑鹰扬府校尉，617 年杀太守王仁恭起兵，北附突厥，称定杨可汗，旋称帝；夺楼烦、雁门、定襄。
619 年用宋金刚南下，夏秋间攻陷晋阳，李元吉弃城逃回长安；宋金刚连败裴寂，夺晋、浍二州，关中震动。
619 年十一月李世民自龙门踏冰渡河，屯柏壁坚壁相持；620 年四月追击宋金刚于雀鼠谷、介休，一日八战，宋金刚败走，尉迟敬德降，刘武周北逃突厥，后被杀。余部苑君璋据马邑，依附突厥。
units.notee:
Liu Wuzhou, a junior officer (xiaowei) of the Soaring Hawk Garrison (yingyang fu) at Mayi, killed the governor Wang Rengong in 617 and rose in arms; he submitted to the Turks in the north, styled himself Dingyang Qaghan and soon proclaimed himself emperor, and seized Loufan, Yanmen and Dingxiang.
In 619 he sent Song Jingang south, and between summer and autumn took Jinyang, while Li Yuanji abandoned the city and fled back to Chang'an; Song Jingang defeated Pei Ji repeatedly and took Jinzhou and Kuaizhou, and Guanzhong was shaken.
In the 11th month of 619 Li Shimin crossed the Yellow River on the ice from Longmen and encamped at Baibi, holding his fortified lines in a standoff; in the 4th month of 620 he pursued Song Jingang to the Queshu Valley and Jiexiu, fighting eight battles in one day; Song Jingang fled, Yuchi Jingde surrendered, and Liu Wuzhou fled north to the Turks and was later killed. His remaining forces under Yuan Junzhang held Mayi as dependents of the Turks.

units.note:
梁师都，夏州朔方豪族，617 年杀郡丞起兵，攻掠雕阴、弘化、延安、盐川诸郡，称帝，国号梁，年号永隆，北附突厥（始毕可汗赐号“大度毗伽可汗”）。
多次引突厥南侵。东突厥衰落后孤立无援，628 年四月唐军柴绍、薛万均围朔方，其从父弟梁洛仁杀梁师都降唐，隋末群雄至此尽灭。
units.notee:
Liang Shidu, of a powerful family of Shuofang in Xiazhou, killed the assistant governor in 617 and rose in arms; he raided the commanderies of Diaoyin, Honghua, Yan'an and Yanchuan, proclaimed himself emperor, naming his state Liang with the era name Yonglong, and submitted to the Turks in the north (Shibi Qaghan gave him the title "Dadu Bilge Qaghan").
He repeatedly brought the Turks south to invade. Isolated and without support after the Eastern Turks declined, he was besieged at Shuofang in the 4th month of 628 by the Tang generals Chai Shao and Xue Wanjun; his cousin Liang Luoren killed him and surrendered to Tang, and with that all the late-Sui contenders were gone.

units.note: 郭子和，617 年三月据榆林郡，北附突厥，称永乐王；618 年降唐，任灵州总管。
units.notee: Guo Zihe seized Yulin Commandery in the 3rd month of 617, submitted to the Turks in the north and styled himself Prince of Yongle; in 618 he surrendered to Tang and was made area commander of Lingzhou.

units.note:
薛举，金城豪强，617 年四月据金城，称西秦霸王，七月称帝，迁都天水；尽有陇西之地，胜兵十三万。
617 年十二月其子薛仁杲在扶风为李世民所败。618 年七月薛举在浅水原大败唐军（李世民卧病、刘文静等违令出战），八月病死；十一月李世民再战浅水原，大破宗罗睺，薛仁杲于折墌城出降，秦亡。
units.notee:
Xue Ju, a local strongman of Jincheng, seized Jincheng in the 4th month of 617 and styled himself Hegemon-King of Western Qin; in the 7th month he proclaimed himself emperor and moved his capital to Tianshui. He held all of Longxi, with 130,000 fighting men.
In the 12th month of 617 his son Xue Rengao was defeated by Li Shimin at Fufeng. In the 7th month of 618 Xue Ju crushed the Tang army at Qianshuiyuan (Li Shimin was ill, and Liu Wenjing and others gave battle against orders), and in the 8th month he died of illness; in the 11th month Li Shimin fought again at Qianshuiyuan and crushed Zong Luohou, Xue Rengao surrendered at Zhezhi City, and Qin fell.

units.note: 李轨，武威豪族，617 年七月起兵称河西大凉王，据河西五郡，618 年十一月称帝。619 年五月部将安修仁、安兴贵（粟特人）执李轨降唐，凉亡。
units.notee: Li Gui, of a powerful family of Wuwei, rose in arms in the 7th month of 617 and styled himself Prince of Great Liang of Hexi, holding the five commanderies of Hexi; in the 11th month of 618 he proclaimed himself emperor. In the 5th month of 619 his officers An Xiuren and An Xinggui (Sogdians) seized him and surrendered to Tang, and Liang fell.

units.note:
萧铣，后梁宣帝曾孙，隋罗川县令。617 年十月起兵于巴陵，称梁王；618 年四月称帝，迁都江陵。
全盛时“东至九江，西抵三峡，南尽交趾，北距汉川”，胜兵四十万。后诸将骄横，萧铣削兵权、杀功臣。
621 年九月李孝恭、李靖率巴蜀之兵乘秋水东下，十月围江陵，萧铣出降，被斩于长安。
units.notee:
Xiao Xian, great-grandson of Emperor Xuan of Later Liang, was Sui magistrate of Luochuan County. In the 10th month of 617 he rose in arms at Baling and styled himself Prince of Liang; in the 4th month of 618 he proclaimed himself emperor and moved his capital to Jiangling.
At its height his realm reached "Jiujiang in the east, the Three Gorges in the west, the far end of Jiaozhi in the south and Hanchuan in the north", with 400,000 fighting men. Later his generals grew arrogant, and Xiao Xian curtailed their commands and killed meritorious officers.
In the 9th month of 621 Li Xiaogong and Li Jing led the troops of Ba and Shu downriver on the autumn floods, and in the 10th month besieged Jiangling; Xiao Xian came out and surrendered, and was beheaded at Chang'an.

units.note: 林士弘，鄱阳人，616 年继操师乞起兵，十二月称帝于豫章，国号楚，据江西诸郡，“北自九江，南至番禺”。后为萧铣所逼，地盘日蹙，621 年后退保安成山洞，622 年病死，余众散降。
units.notee: Lin Shihong, a native of Poyang, succeeded Cao Shiqi as leader of a rising in 616 and in the 12th month proclaimed himself emperor at Yuzhang, naming his state Chu; he held the commanderies of Jiangxi, "from Jiujiang in the north to Panyu in the south". Later, under pressure from Xiao Xian, his territory shrank steadily; after 621 he fell back to hold the mountain caves of Ancheng, and in 622 he died of illness and his followers scattered and surrendered.

units.note:
杜伏威，齐州章丘人，少年即与辅公祏起兵，转战江淮，617 年据历阳。
619 年九月降唐，后拜东南道行台尚书令，封吴王；620 年其将辅公祏破李子通，取丹阳、江都，621 年擒李子通，尽有江东、淮南。622 年七月入朝长安，留辅公祏守丹阳。
units.notee:
Du Fuwei, a native of Zhangqiu in Qizhou, rose in arms with Fu Gongshi while still a youth, fought his way across Jianghuai, and in 617 held Liyang.
In the 9th month of 619 he surrendered to Tang, and was later appointed Director of the Southeast Branch Department and made Prince of Wu; in 620 his general Fu Gongshi defeated Li Zitong and took Danyang and Jiangdu, and in 621 he captured Li Zitong and held all of Jiangdong and Huainan. In the 7th month of 622 he went to court at Chang'an, leaving Fu Gongshi to hold Danyang.

units.note: 李子通，东海人，起兵后据海陵，619 年九月攻取江都，称帝，国号吴；620 年为杜伏威所败，渡江取沈法兴之地，据余杭；621 年十一月被杜伏威部将王雄诞擒获，送长安后伏诛。
units.notee: Li Zitong, a native of Donghai, held Hailing after rising in arms; in the 9th month of 619 he took Jiangdu and proclaimed himself emperor, naming his state Wu; in 620, defeated by Du Fuwei, he crossed the Yangtze, took Shen Faxing's lands and held Yuhang; in the 11th month of 621 he was captured by Du Fuwei's general Wang Xiongdan, sent to Chang'an and executed.

units.note: 沈法兴，隋吴兴郡守，618 年江都之变后以讨宇文化及为名起兵，据毗陵、吴郡、余杭等江表十余郡，称梁王；620 年为李子通所败，投江死。
units.notee: Shen Faxing, Sui governor of Wuxing Commandery, rose in arms after the Jiangdu coup of 618 in the name of punishing Yuwen Huaji, held more than ten commanderies south of the Yangtze, including Piling, Wu Commandery and Yuhang, and styled himself Prince of Liang; in 620 he was defeated by Li Zitong and drowned himself in the river.

units.note: 汪华，歙州豪族，隋末据新安，兼有宣、杭、睦、婺、饶等州，称吴王，保境安民十余年；621 年九月以六州之地降唐，徽州人至今奉为“汪公大帝”。
units.notee: Wang Hua, of a powerful family of Shezhou, held Xin'an at the end of Sui together with Xuanzhou, Hangzhou, Muzhou, Wuzhou, Raozhou and other prefectures, styled himself Prince of Wu and kept his territory safe and its people at peace for over ten years; in the 9th month of 621 he surrendered to Tang with six prefectures, and the people of Huizhou still revere him as "Great Emperor Lord Wang".

units.note: 宇文化及，宇文述之子。618 年三月在江都缢杀隋炀帝，立秦王杨浩，率骁果十余万北归；七月童山之战败于李密，退据魏县，鸩杀杨浩，自称皇帝，国号许；619 年闰二月窦建德破聊城，擒而斩之。
units.notee: Yuwen Huaji, son of Yuwen Shu. In the 3rd month of 618 he strangled Emperor Yang of Sui at Jiangdu, enthroned Yang Hao, Prince of Qin, and led over 100,000 Xiaoguo guards back north; in the 7th month he was defeated by Li Mi at the Battle of Tongshan, fell back to Wei County, poisoned Yang Hao and proclaimed himself emperor, naming his state Xu; in the intercalary 2nd month of 619 Dou Jiande took Liaocheng, captured him and beheaded him.

units.note: 高开道，渤海蓨县人，初从格谦起兵，618 年十二月取北平、渔阳，称燕王，后都怀戎。620 年冬降唐，赐姓李、封北平王；621 年冬复叛，北连突厥，屡寇幽、易；624 年部将张金树、张君立发动兵变，高开道自缢。
units.notee: Gao Kaidao, a native of Tiao County in Bohai, first rose in arms under Ge Qian; in the 12th month of 618 he took Beiping and Yuyang and styled himself Prince of Yan, later making Huairong his capital. In the winter of 620 he surrendered to Tang, was granted the surname Li and made Prince of Beiping; in the winter of 621 he rebelled again, allied with the Turks to the north and repeatedly raided Youzhou and Yizhou; in 624 his officers Zhang Jinshu and Zhang Junli mutinied, and Gao Kaidao hanged himself.

units.note: 罗艺，隋虎贲郎将，隋末据涿郡，自称幽州总管，拒窦建德、高开道；620 年奉表归唐，封燕王、赐姓李。
units.notee: Luo Yi, a Sui Tiger-Brave general (huben langjiang), held Zhuo Commandery at the end of Sui and styled himself area commander of Youzhou, resisting Dou Jiande and Gao Kaidao; in 620 he sent a memorial submitting to Tang, and was made Prince of Yan and granted the surname Li.

units.note:
刘黑闼，窦建德旧将。621 年七月于漳南起兵为窦建德复仇，半年间尽复夏国故地，622 年正月称汉东王，都洺州。
622 年三月洺水之战被李世民大破，北奔突厥；六月借突厥兵复入，十月于下博杀唐淮阳王李道玄，再据河北；同年十二月至 623 年正月，太子李建成用魏征之策分化其众，刘黑闼兵败被擒，斩于洺州。
units.notee:
Liu Heita, a former general of Dou Jiande. In the 7th month of 621 he rose in arms at Zhangnan to avenge Dou Jiande, and within half a year recovered all the former lands of Xia; in the 1st month of 622 he styled himself Prince of Handong, with his capital at Mingzhou.
In the 3rd month of 622 he was crushed by Li Shimin at the Battle of the Ming River and fled north to the Turks; in the 6th month he returned with Turkic troops, and in the 10th month killed the Tang Prince of Huaiyang, Li Daoxuan, at Xiabo and retook Hebei; from the 12th month of that year to the 1st month of 623 Crown Prince Li Jiancheng, following Wei Zheng's plan, sowed division among Liu Heita's followers, and Liu Heita was defeated, captured and beheaded at Mingzhou.

units.note: 徐圆朗，隋末据东平、鲁郡，先附李密、窦建德，619 年降唐；621 年八月响应刘黑闼，称鲁王，据兖、郓等八州；623 年二月兵败，为野人所杀。
units.notee: Xu Yuanlang held Dongping and Lu Commanderies at the end of Sui, attaching himself first to Li Mi and then to Dou Jiande, and surrendered to Tang in 619; in the 8th month of 621 he joined Liu Heita, styled himself Prince of Lu and held Yanzhou, Yunzhou and other prefectures, eight in all; in the 2nd month of 623 he was defeated and was killed by country people.

units.note: 孟海公，济阴周桥人，隋末据曹、戴二州，称宋义王；621 年二月为窦建德所并，窦建德败后其地归唐。
units.notee: Meng Haigong, a native of Zhouqiao in Jiyin, held Caozhou and Daizhou at the end of Sui and styled himself Prince of Songyi; in the 2nd month of 621 he was absorbed by Dou Jiande, and after Dou Jiande's defeat his lands passed to Tang.

units.note: 冯盎，冼夫人之孙，高凉冯氏世为岭南酋豪。隋亡后回岭南，平定番禺、新兴诸乱，据番禺、苍梧、朱崖二十余州，有人劝其称南越王，不从；621 年萧铣亡后遣子弟谒李靖归附，622 年以所部降唐，授高州总管、封越国公。
units.notee: Feng Ang was a grandson of Lady Xian; the Feng clan of Gaoliang had long been chieftains of Lingnan. After Sui fell he returned to Lingnan, put down disturbances at Panyu, Xinxing and elsewhere, and held more than twenty prefectures, including Panyu, Cangwu and Zhuya; someone urged him to style himself Prince of Nanyue, but he refused; after Xiao Xian fell in 621 he sent his sons and brothers to call on Li Jing and submit, and in 622 he surrendered to Tang with his following and was made area commander of Gaozhou and Duke of Yue.

units.note: 辅公祏，杜伏威旧友。622 年杜伏威入朝，留守丹阳；623 年八月诈称杜伏威之命起兵，称帝于丹阳，国号宋；624 年三月李孝恭、李靖破冯慧亮于博望山，攻克丹阳，辅公祏东逃被擒。
units.notee: Fu Gongshi, an old friend of Du Fuwei. When Du Fuwei went to court in 622, Fu was left to hold Danyang; in the 8th month of 623, falsely claiming Du Fuwei's orders, he rose in arms and proclaimed himself emperor at Danyang, naming his state Song; in the 3rd month of 624 Li Xiaogong and Li Jing defeated Feng Huiliang at Mount Bowang and took Danyang, and Fu Gongshi fled east and was captured.

units.note: 隋末各地郡县长官或豪强据守本境，名义上仍奉隋朝（或东都皇泰主），尚未归属任何新政权。
units.notee: Local commandery and county officials or strongmen at the end of Sui who held their own territories, still nominally loyal to the Sui (or to the Huangtai emperor in the Eastern Capital) and not yet under any of the new regimes.

units.note:
640 年平高昌后置于西州交河城；648 年平龟兹，移治龟兹，始置龟兹、于阗、疏勒、焉耆四镇。
651 年阿史那贺鲁叛，退回西州；658 年平西突厥，复移龟兹，升为大都护府，统四镇及葱岭以西诸都督府州。
661 年王名远于吐火罗故地置月氏、条支、写凤、修鲜等十六都督府，又以疾陵城为波斯都督府，名义上西抵波斯东境。
670 年吐蕃陷四镇，退回西州；679 年复置四镇（以碎叶代焉耆），约 686 年再弃；692 年王孝杰收复，复治龟兹，以汉兵三万镇守。719 年以焉耆代碎叶为四镇。开元年间置安西四镇节度使，天宝时兵二万四千；747 年远征小勃律，此后高仙芝、封常清相继为节度使。
units.notee:
Set up at Jiaohe City in Xizhou after Gaochang was conquered in 640; in 648, after Kucha was conquered, its seat moved to Kucha and the four garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar and Karasahr were first established.
In 651, when Ashina Helu rebelled, it withdrew to Xizhou; in 658, after the Western Turks were conquered, it moved back to Kucha and was raised to a Grand Protectorate, governing the Four Garrisons and the area commands and prefectures west of the Pamirs.
In 661 Wang Mingyuan set up sixteen area commands, including Yuezhi, Tiaozhi, Xiefeng and Xiuxian, in the former lands of Tokharistan, and made Zaranj the Persian Area Command, so that its nominal reach extended west to the eastern border of Persia.
In 670 Tibet took the Four Garrisons and the protectorate withdrew to Xizhou; in 679 the Four Garrisons were restored (with Suyab in place of Karasahr), and around 686 they were abandoned again; in 692 Wang Xiaojie recovered them, the seat returned to Kucha, and 30,000 Han troops were stationed there. In 719 Karasahr replaced Suyab among the Four Garrisons. In the Kaiyuan era the military governorship of the Four Garrisons of Anxi was set up; in the Tianbao era it had 24,000 troops, in 747 it sent a distant expedition against Little Balur, and thereafter Gao Xianzhi and then Feng Changqing were its military governors.

units.note:
646 年灭薛延陀后，铁勒回纥等十余部请置唐官，太宗以其地为瀚海、金微、燕然等六府七州，647 年置燕然都护府统之，开“参天可汗道”。
663 年燕然都护府移治回纥部落，改名瀚海都护府，统碛北；669 年改名安北都护府。
682 年后突厥复兴，漠北失守，685 年侨治同城（居延），此后屡迁，天宝时治于朔方境内，名存实亡。
units.notee:
After the Xueyantuo were destroyed in 646, the Huihe (Uyghurs) and other Tiele tribes, more than ten in all, asked for Tang officials; Taizong made their lands into six area commands and seven prefectures, including Hanhai, Jinwei and Yanran, and in 647 set up the Yanran Protectorate to govern them, opening the "Road to the Heavenly Qaghan".
In 663 the Yanran Protectorate moved its seat to the Huihe tribe and was renamed the Hanhai Protectorate, governing the lands north of the Gobi; in 669 it was renamed the Anbei Protectorate.
In 682 the Turks revived as the Second Turkic Qaghanate and the lands north of the Gobi were lost; in 685 the protectorate was temporarily seated at Tongcheng (Juyan), and thereafter it moved repeatedly; in the Tianbao era its seat was within Shuofang, and it existed in name only.

units.note:
630 年东突厥亡，唐将降众安置于漠南与河套，设定襄、云中等都督府。
650 年擒车鼻可汗后于云中古城（今内蒙古和林格尔土城子）置瀚海都护府统漠南突厥诸部；663 年改称云中都护府，664 年改为单于大都护府。
679 年辖下突厥二部叛，682 年后突厥复兴，漠南多为所据；708 年张仁愿筑三受降城，阴山以南复归唐，单于都护府隶朔方、河东。
units.notee:
After the Eastern Turks fell in 630, Tang settled the surrendered people south of the Gobi and in the Ordos Loop, setting up the Dingxiang, Yunzhong and other area commands.
In 650, after Chebi Qaghan was captured, the Hanhai Protectorate was set up at Old Yunzhong City (modern Tuchengzi, Horinger, Inner Mongolia) to govern the Turkic tribes south of the Gobi; in 663 it was renamed the Yunzhong Protectorate, and in 664 it became the Chanyu Grand Protectorate.
In 679 two Turkic tribes under its rule rebelled, and in 682 the Turks revived as the Second Turkic Qaghanate and took most of the lands south of the Gobi; in 708 Zhang Renyuan built the Three Shouxiang Cities, the lands south of the Yin Mountains returned to Tang, and the Chanyu Protectorate was placed under Shuofang and Hedong.

units.note: 668 年平高句丽，于平壤置安东都护府，薛仁贵为都护，统新城、辽东等九都督府、四十二州、百县。676 年迁辽东故城，677 年迁新城；698 年降为安东都督府，705 年复为都护府；714 年迁平州，743 年迁辽西故郡城，隶平卢节度。
units.notee: Set up at Pyongyang in 668 after Goguryeo was conquered, with Xue Rengui as protector-general, governing nine area commands, including Sinseong and Yodong, 42 prefectures and 100 counties. In 676 it moved to the old Yodong Fortress and in 677 to Sinseong; in 698 it was reduced to the Andong Area Command, and in 705 it became a protectorate again; in 714 it moved to Pingzhou and in 743 to the old seat of Liaoxi Commandery, under the Pinglu military governorship.

units.note: 660 年平百济后置熊津、马韩、东明、金涟、德安五都督府；663 年白江口战后以百济王子扶余隆为熊津都督，统百济故地，后渐为新罗所并；676 年移治建安故城。
units.notee: After Baekje was conquered in 660, five area commands were set up: Ungjin, Mahan, Dongmyeong, Geumnyeon and Deogan; after the Battle of Baekgang in 663 the Baekje prince Buyeo Yung was made area commander of Ungjin, governing the former lands of Baekje, which were gradually absorbed by Silla; in 676 its seat moved to the old Geonan Fortress.

units.note: 658 年平阿史那贺鲁后，以阿史那弥射为兴昔亡可汗兼昆陵都护，统碎叶川以东的五咄陆部落。699 年后突骑施兴起，703 年乌质勒据碎叶，二府名存实亡。
units.notee: After Ashina Helu was crushed in 658, Ashina Mishe was made Xingxiwang Qaghan and protector-general of Kunling, governing the five Duolu tribes east of the Suyab River. After 699 the Türgesh rose, and in 703 Üch Elig took Suyab; from then on the two protectorates existed in name only.

units.note: 658 年以阿史那步真为继往绝可汗兼濛池都护，统碎叶川以西的五弩失毕部落；后为突骑施所并。
units.notee: In 658 Ashina Buzhen was made Jiwangjue Qaghan and protector-general of Mengchi, governing the five Nushibi tribes west of the Suyab River; they were later absorbed by the Türgesh.

units.note:
682 年东突厥颉利族人阿史那骨咄禄据黑沙城（今呼和浩特北）复国，史称后突厥或第二突厥汗国，暾欲谷为谋主，后移牙帐于于都斤山。
默啜可汗（691—716）时最强，屡寇河北、陇右，697 年袭破契丹；708 年唐乘其西征筑三受降城。毗伽可汗（716—734）与阙特勤、暾欲谷当政，与唐和好互市。
734 年毗伽可汗卒后内乱；742—744 年拔悉密、回纥、葛逻禄共攻，744 年乌苏米施可汗被杀，745 年回纥杀白眉可汗，后突厥亡。
units.notee:
In 682 Ashina Qutlugh, a clansman of Illig of the Eastern Turks, held Heisha City (north of today's Hohhot) and restored the Turkic state; it is known to history as the Later Turks or the Second Turkic Qaghanate. Tonyukuk was his chief strategist, and the royal camp was later moved to Ötüken.
It was at its strongest under Qapaghan Qaghan (691–716), repeatedly raiding Hebei and Longyou, and in 697 it fell on the Khitan and crushed them; in 708 Tang took advantage of its campaign in the west to build the Three Shouxiang Cities. Bilge Qaghan (716–734) held power together with Kül Tegin and Tonyukuk, and was on good terms with Tang and traded with it.
After Bilge Qaghan died in 734 there was internal strife; in 742–744 the Basmyl, the Uyghurs and the Karluks attacked it together, Ozmish Qaghan was killed in 744, and in 745 the Uyghurs killed Baimei Qaghan and the Second Turkic Qaghanate fell.

units.note:
西突厥别部，原属五咄陆。699 年后乌质勒兴起，703 年攻陷碎叶，移牙帐于此，以弓月城、伊丽水为小牙，西突厥故地大半归之。
其子娑葛 708 年叛唐、陷安西，709 年七月受封（《通鉴》作钦化可汗，《旧唐书·郭元振传》作十四姓可汗），711 年为后突厥默啜所杀（《通鉴》系于 714 年末）。约 716 年苏禄收余众自立，719 年唐以碎叶与之、改以焉耆为四镇。
738 年苏禄被杀，739 年盖嘉运擒吐火仙可汗于碎叶，此后黄、黑二姓相攻，部众衰散。
units.notee:
A branch of the Western Turks, originally one of the five Duolu tribes. After 699 Üch Elig rose to power; in 703 he took Suyab and moved his royal camp there, with Gongyue City and the Ili River as his lesser camp, and most of the former lands of the Western Turks came under him.
His son Saqal rebelled against Tang in 708 and took Anxi; in the 7th month of 709 he was invested (the Zizhi tongjian gives Qinhua Qaghan, the biography of Guo Yuanzhen in the Old Book of Tang gives Qaghan of the Fourteen Clans), and in 711 he was killed by Qapaghan of the Second Turks (the Zizhi tongjian dates it to late 714). Around 716 Suluk gathered the remnants of his people and made himself ruler; in 719 Tang gave Suyab to him and made Karasahr one of the Four Garrisons in its place.
In 738 Suluk was killed, and in 739 Gai Jiayun captured Tuhuoxian Qaghan at Suyab; thereafter the Yellow and Black clans fought each other, and the tribes declined and dispersed.

units.note:
西突厥别部，居金山（阿尔泰山）之西、北庭西北，分谋落、炽俟、踏实力三姓，唐置阴山、大漠、玄池等羁縻都督府。
742—744 年与拔悉密、回纥共攻后突厥；751 年怛罗斯之战阵前倒戈，唐军大败。
units.notee:
A branch of the Western Turks, living west of the Altai Mountains and northwest of Beiting and divided into three clans, the Bulaq, Chigil and Tashliq; Tang set up the Yinshan, Damo, Xuanchi and other loose-rein area commands for them.
In 742–744 they joined the Basmyl and the Uyghurs in attacking the Second Turkic Qaghanate; at the Battle of Talas in 751 they changed sides in the middle of the fighting, and the Tang army was routed.

units.note:
铁勒诸部之一，居娑陵水（色楞格河）、独乐河（土拉河）一带。646 年助唐灭薛延陀，唐以其地为瀚海都督府，隶燕然（后为安北）都护府。
后突厥复兴后，部分部落于垂拱年间（《新唐书·回鹘传》作武后时默啜方强之际）南迁甘、凉。744 年骨力裴罗与葛逻禄攻杀拔悉密颉跌伊施可汗，自立为骨咄禄毗伽阙可汗，唐册为怀仁可汗；745 年杀后突厥白眉可汗，后突厥亡，回纥据有漠北，牙帐在乌德鞬山。788 年（《唐会要》作 789 年，《旧唐书》作 809 年）后改称回鹘。
units.notee:
One of the Tiele tribes, living around the Selenga and the Tuul River. In 646 it helped Tang destroy the Xueyantuo, and Tang made its lands the Hanhai Area Command, under the Yanran (later Anbei) Protectorate.
After the Turks revived as the Second Turkic Qaghanate, some of its tribes moved south to Ganzhou and Liangzhou in the Chuigong era (the "Uyghurs" chapter of the New Book of Tang says under Empress Wu, when Qapaghan was at his strongest). In 744 Guli Peiluo, together with the Karluks, attacked and killed Xiedie Yishi Qaghan of the Basmyl and made himself Qutlugh Bilge Kül Qaghan, and Tang invested him as Huairen Qaghan; in 745 he killed Baimei Qaghan of the Second Turks, the Second Turkic Qaghanate fell, and the Uyghurs held the lands north of the Gobi, with their royal camp at Ötüken. Its Chinese name was later changed to Huihu in 788 (the Tang huiyao gives 789, the Old Book of Tang 809).

units.note: 居剑河（叶尼塞河上游）的部族，即汉代坚昆。648 年遣使入唐，唐以其地为坚昆都督府，隶燕然都护府；后突厥兴起后脱离唐，屡受后突厥攻伐。
units.notee: A people on the Kem River (the upper Yenisei), the Jiankun of Han times. In 648 they sent envoys to Tang, and Tang made their lands the Jiankun Area Command, under the Yanran Protectorate; after the Second Turkic Qaghanate rose they broke away from Tang and were repeatedly attacked by the Second Turks.

units.note:
698 年粟末靺鞨首领大祚荣率靺鞨与高句丽遗民东走，于天门岭击败唐将李楷固，在东牟山（今吉林敦化）建国，号震国；713 年唐册封为渤海郡王、忽汗州都督，此后以渤海为国号。
大武艺（719—737，卒年《通鉴》作 738 年）“斥大土宇”，东北诸夷畏臣之；732 年遣张文休袭登州，次年唐与新罗夹击。大钦茂（737—793）时与唐和好，先后迁都显州（中京）、上京。
units.notee:
In 698 Dae Joyeong, a chief of the Sumo Mohe, led the Mohe and the remaining Goguryeo people east, defeated the Tang general Li Kaigu at Tianmenling and founded a state at Mount Dongmou (today's Dunhua, Jilin), named Jin; in 713 Tang invested him as Commandery Prince of Bohai and area commander of Huhan Zhou, and from then on the state took Balhae as its name.
Dae Muye (719–737; the Zizhi tongjian gives 738 for his death) "greatly enlarged his territory", and the peoples of the northeast feared him and submitted to him; in 732 he sent Jang Munhyu to raid Dengzhou, and the next year Tang and Silla attacked him from both sides. Under Dae Heummu (737–793) Balhae was on good terms with Tang, and moved its capital first to Xianzhou (the Central Capital) and then to the Supreme Capital.

units.note:
洱海六诏中最南的蒙舍诏。737 年起皮罗阁在唐支持下兼并五诏，738 年唐册封为云南王，739 年迁都太和城（今大理太和村）。
745—748 年兼并两爨。750 年阁罗凤因云南太守张虔陀之辱，攻陷姚州；751 年西洱河、754 年太和城下两次大败唐军，752 年正月臣属吐蕃，受封“赞普钟”。
units.notee:
The Mengshe zhao, the southernmost of the Six Zhao around Erhai Lake. From 737 Piluoge, with Tang support, annexed the other five zhao; in 738 Tang invested him as Prince of Yunnan, and in 739 he moved his capital to Taihe City (today's Taihe Village, Dali, Yunnan).
In 745–748 it annexed the two Cuan. In 750 Geluofeng, insulted by Zhang Qiantuo, governor of Yunnan Commandery, attacked and took Yaozhou; it crushed Tang armies twice, on the Xi'er River in 751 and at Taihe City in 754, and in the 1st month of 752 became a vassal of Tibet, receiving the title "Tsenpo Zhong" ("younger brother of the tsenpo").

units.note: 神龙（705—707）以后真腊分为二，南部近海、多陂泽的称水真腊，在今柬埔寨南部与湄公河三角洲，诸城邦并立。
units.notee: After the Shenlong era (705–707) Chenla split in two; the southern part, near the sea and rich in lakes and marshes, was called Water Chenla. It lay in today's southern Cambodia and the Mekong Delta, where several city-states coexisted.

units.note:
702 年遣唐使粟田真人入唐，始以日本为国号。701 年颁行大宝律令，694 年迁藤原京，710 年迁平城京（今奈良），即奈良时代。
奈良时代屡遣遣唐使，阿倍仲麻吕、吉备真备、玄昉等随之入唐；753 年鉴真第六次东渡，抵萨摩。
units.notee:
In 702 Awata no Mahito went to Tang as envoy, and for the first time Japan was used as the name of the state. In 701 the Taihō Code was promulgated; in 694 the capital moved to Fujiwara-kyō, and in 710 to Heijō-kyō (today's Nara): the Nara period.
In the Nara period embassies were sent to Tang again and again, and Abe no Nakamaro, Kibi no Makibi, Genbō and others went to Tang with them; in 753 Jianzhen, on his sixth voyage east, reached Satsuma.

units.note: 靺鞨七部中最北的一部，居黑水（黑龙江下游、松花江下游）。渤海兴起后与之相抗，726 年唐以其地置黑水都督府，引起渤海大武艺讨伐。
units.notee: The northernmost of the seven Mohe tribes, living along the Heishui (the lower Amur and the lower Songhua River). After Balhae rose they resisted it; in 726 Tang set up the Heishui Area Command in their lands, which provoked Dae Muye of Balhae into attacking them.

units.note:
今克什米尔吉尔吉特一带的小国，扼吐蕃通西域之路，玄奘称钵露罗；约 7 世纪末分为大、小勃律。小勃律王没谨忙亲唐，722 年吐蕃夺其九城，北庭节度使张孝嵩遣张思礼救之。
737 年起吐蕃西击勃律，740 年以公主嫁小勃律王苏失利之，西北二十余国皆附吐蕃；747 年高仙芝远征，擒苏失利之，以其地置归仁军。
units.notee:
A small state around today's Gilgit in Kashmir, commanding Tibet's route to the Western Regions; Xuanzang called it Bolor. Around the end of the 7th century it split into Great and Little Balur. Mojinmang, King of Little Balur, was friendly to Tang; in 722 Tibet seized nine of his cities, and Zhang Xiaosong, military governor of Beiting, sent Zhang Sili to relieve him.
From 737 Tibet struck west against Balur, and in 740 it married a princess to Sushilizhi, King of Little Balur, after which more than twenty states of the northwest all submitted to Tibet; in 747 Gao Xianzhi led a distant expedition, captured Sushilizhi and set up the Guiren Jun in its lands.

units.note: 679 年十月，单于都护府所领突厥阿史德温傅、奉职二部叛唐，立阿史那泥熟匐为可汗，二十四州酋长响应；680 年三月裴行俭于黑山大破之，泥熟匐为部下所杀。
units.notee: In the 10th month of 679 the two Turkic tribes of Ashide Wenfu and Fengzhi under the Chanyu Protectorate rebelled against Tang and set up Ashina Nishufu as qaghan, and the chiefs of twenty-four prefectures joined them; in the 3rd month of 680 Pei Xingjian crushed them at Heishan, and Nishufu was killed by his own men.

units.note:
702 年于庭州（今吉木萨尔北庭故城）置北庭都护府，分安西都护府天山以北之地，统庭州与天山以北突骑施、葛逻禄、坚昆等羁縻府州；开元间置伊西北庭节度，兼领伊、西二州。
天宝时为北庭节度，兵二万，与安西合称“四镇北庭”。
units.notee:
In 702 the Beiting Protectorate was set up at Tingzhou (the Beiting ruins in today's Jimsar), taking over the lands of the Anxi Protectorate north of the Tian Shan and governing Tingzhou and the loose-rein area commands and prefectures of the Türgesh, the Karluks, the Jiankun (Kyrgyz) and others north of the Tian Shan; in the Kaiyuan era the Yi–Xi–Beiting military governorship was set up, also controlling Yizhou and Xizhou.
In the Tianbao era it became the Beiting military governorship, with 20,000 troops, and together with Anxi it was called "the Four Garrisons and Beiting".

units.note: 河西节度，710 年（景云元年，据《新唐书·方镇表》；《唐会要》作景云二年四月）首置，治凉州（武威郡），统赤水、大斗、建康、玉门、墨离、豆卢等军，断隔吐蕃与突厥；天宝时兵七万余，哥舒翰兼领。
units.notee: The Hexi military governorship, first set up in 710 (Jingyun 1, per the New Book of Tang's table of military governors; the Tang huiyao gives Jingyun 2, 4th month), with its seat at Liangzhou (Wuwei Commandery); it controlled the Chishui, Dadou, Jiankang, Yumen, Moli, Doulu and other Jun, keeping Tibet and the Turks apart. In the Tianbao era it had over 70,000 troops, and Geshu Han held it concurrently.

units.note: 陇右节度，开元初置，治鄯州（西平郡，今乐都），统临洮、河源、白水、安人、积石等军，防吐蕃于青海、河湟；天宝时兵七万余，749 年哥舒翰攻拔石堡城，753 年收九曲。
units.notee: The Longyou military governorship, set up early in the Kaiyuan era, with its seat at Shanzhou (Xiping Commandery, today's Ledu, Qinghai); it controlled the Lintao, Heyuan, Baishui, Anren, Jishi and other Jun, defending against Tibet around Qinghai Lake and in Hehuang. In the Tianbao era it had over 70,000 troops; in 749 Geshu Han stormed Shibao Fortress, and in 753 he recovered Jiuqu.

units.note: 朔方节度，开元中置，治灵州（灵武郡，今吴忠），统三受降城、丰安、定远等军，防后突厥与回纥；天宝时兵六万余。
units.notee: The Shuofang military governorship, set up in the middle of the Kaiyuan era, with its seat at Lingzhou (Lingwu Commandery, today's Wuzhong, Ningxia); it controlled the Three Shouxiang Cities and the Feng'an, Dingyuan and other Jun, defending against the Second Turks and the Uyghurs. In the Tianbao era it had over 60,000 troops.

units.note: 河东节度，开元中置，治太原府（北都），统天兵、大同、横野、岢岚等军；天宝时兵五万余，751 年起由安禄山兼领。
units.notee: The Hedong military governorship, set up in the middle of the Kaiyuan era, with its seat at Taiyuan Fu (the Northern Capital); it controlled the Tianbing, Datong, Hengye, Kelan and other Jun. In the Tianbao era it had over 50,000 troops, and from 751 An Lushan held it concurrently.

units.note: 范阳节度（开元初为幽州节度，天宝元年改称），治幽州（范阳郡），统经略、威武、清夷、静塞等九军，防奚、契丹；兵九万余，744 年起安禄山兼领。
units.notee: The Fanyang military governorship (the Youzhou military governorship in the early Kaiyuan era, renamed in Tianbao 1), with its seat at Youzhou (Fanyang Commandery); it controlled nine Jun, including the Jinglüe, Weiwu, Qingyi and Jingsai Jun, to guard against the Xi and the Khitan. It had over 90,000 troops, and from 744 An Lushan held it concurrently.

units.note: 平卢节度，719 年闰七月张敬忠为平卢军节度使，始有节度之号；治营州（柳城郡），镇抚室韦、靺鞨，统平卢、卢龙二军及安东都护府；742 年分平卢别为节度，以安禄山为节度使。
units.notee: The Pinglu military governorship: in the intercalary 7th month of 719 Zhang Jingzhong became military governor of the Pinglu Jun, the first time Pinglu bore the title of military governor. With its seat at Yingzhou (Liucheng Commandery), it kept the Shiwei and the Mohe in check and controlled the Pinglu and Lulong Jun and the Andong Protectorate; in 742 Pinglu was split off as a separate military governorship, with An Lushan as its military governor.

units.note: 剑南节度，开元初置，治益州（蜀郡），西抗吐蕃、南抚蛮獠，统天宝、平戎、昆明等军；天宝时兵三万余，751、754 年两次大败于南诏。
units.notee: The Jiannan military governorship, set up early in the Kaiyuan era, with its seat at Yizhou (Shu Commandery), resisting Tibet to the west and keeping the Man and Lao tribes in check to the south; it controlled the Tianbao, Pingrong, Kunming and other Jun. In the Tianbao era it had over 30,000 troops, and in 751 and 754 it was twice heavily defeated by Nanzhao.

units.note: 岭南五府经略使，治广州（南海郡），统广、桂、容、邕、安南五管，绥静夷獠；天宝时兵一万五千余。
units.notee: The pacification commissioner of the Five Commands of Lingnan, with its seat at Guangzhou (Nanhai Commandery), controlling the Five Commands of Guang, Gui, Rong, Yong and Annan and keeping the Yi and Lao tribes at peace. In the Tianbao era it had over 15,000 troops.

units.note: 京畿采访使道（733 年分置十五道时设），以京兆府（长安）为中心，直属朝廷。
units.notee: The Capital District surveillance commissioner's circuit (set up in 733, when the fifteen circuits were established), centered on Jingzhao Fu (Chang'an) and directly under the court.

units.note: 关内采访使道（未设节度的关中北部诸州）。
units.notee: The Guannei surveillance commissioner's circuit (the prefectures of northern Guanzhong where no military governor was established).

units.note: 都畿采访使道（733 年分置），以河南府（东都洛阳）为中心。
units.notee: The Eastern Capital District surveillance commissioner's circuit (set up as a separate circuit in 733), centered on Henan Fu (the Eastern Capital, Luoyang).

units.note: 河南采访使道，治汴州（陈留郡），包括淮河以北、黄河以南的广大州县。
units.notee: The Henan surveillance commissioner's circuit, with its seat at Bianzhou (Chenliu Commandery), covering the many prefectures and counties north of the Huai River and south of the Yellow River.

units.note: 河北采访使道（魏、博、相、卫等州），天宝时由安禄山兼采访使。
units.notee: The Hebei surveillance commissioner's circuit (Weizhou, Bozhou, Xiangzhou, Weizhou and other prefectures); in the Tianbao era An Lushan was concurrently its surveillance commissioner.

units.note: 河东采访使道南部诸州（蒲、晋、绛、泽、潞等），未置节度。
units.notee: The southern prefectures of the Hedong surveillance commissioner's circuit (Puzhou, Jinzhou, Jiangzhou, Zezhou, Luzhou and others), where no military governor was established.

units.note: 山南东道采访使，治襄州（襄阳郡）。
units.notee: The surveillance commissioner of the Shannan East Circuit, with its seat at Xiangzhou (Xiangyang Commandery).

units.note: 山南西道采访使，治梁州（汉中郡），扼守秦岭蜀道。
units.notee: The surveillance commissioner of the Shannan West Circuit, with its seat at Liangzhou (Hanzhong Commandery), guarding the Shu roads across the Qinling Mountains.

units.note: 淮南采访使道，治扬州（广陵郡）；扬州为江淮漕运与海外贸易中心，“扬一益二”。
units.notee: The Huainan surveillance commissioner's circuit, with its seat at Yangzhou (Guangling Commandery); Yangzhou was the center of grain transport on the Yangtze and Huai and of overseas trade: "Yangzhou first, Yizhou second."

units.note: 江南东道采访使，治苏州（吴郡），包括今苏南、浙江、福建。
units.notee: The surveillance commissioner of the Jiangnan East Circuit, with its seat at Suzhou (Wu Commandery), covering today's southern Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Fujian.

units.note: 江南西道采访使，治洪州（豫章郡），包括今皖南、江西、湖南及鄂东南。
units.notee: The surveillance commissioner of the Jiangnan West Circuit, with its seat at Hongzhou (Yuzhang Commandery), covering today's southern Anhui, Jiangxi, Hunan and southeastern Hubei.

units.note: 黔中采访使，治黔州（黔中郡，今重庆彭水），统辖今黔东北、湘西、渝东南的羁縻蛮州。
units.notee: The Qianzhong surveillance commissioner, with its seat at Qianzhou (Qianzhong Commandery, today's Pengshui, Chongqing), controlling the loose-rein tribal prefectures of today's northeastern Guizhou, western Hunan and southeastern Chongqing.

items.note: 隋初暂居汉长安旧城，582 年命宇文恺于其东南营建新都，583 年三月迁入，名大兴城；宫城、皇城、外郭城三重，外郭一百零八坊，为当时世界最大的城市。

e.note: The early Sui court stayed for a time in the old Han city of Chang'an; in 582 Yuwen Kai was ordered to build a new capital to its southeast, which the court moved into in the 3rd month of 583 and named Daxing City. It had three walled layers (palace city, imperial city and outer city), with 108 wards in the outer city, and was the largest city in the world at the time.

items.note: 617 年十一月李渊攻克大兴城，次年受禅建唐，改称长安。太极宫为正宫，626 年玄武门之变即发生在太极宫北门；634 年起营建大明宫。

e.note: Li Yuan took Daxing City in the 11th month of 617; the next year he accepted the abdication, founded the Tang and renamed the city Chang'an. The Taiji Palace was the main palace, and the Xuanwu Gate incident of 626 took place at its north gate; construction of the Daming Palace began in 634.

items.note: 605 年三月炀帝命杨素、宇文恺营建，每月役丁二百万，次年正月建成，称东京，609 年改称东都；城跨洛水，有含嘉仓、回洛仓。618 年五月越王杨侗在此即位（皇泰主），619 年四月被王世充所废。

e.note: Emperor Yang of Sui ordered Yang Su and Yuwen Kai to build it in the 3rd month of 605, with two million laborers conscripted every month. It was completed in the 1st month of the following year and called the Eastern Metropolis (Dongjing), and was renamed the Eastern Capital in 609. The city straddled the Luo River and held the Hanjia and Huiluo granaries. In the 5th month of 618 Yang Tong, Prince of Yue, took the throne here (the Huangtai emperor); he was deposed by Wang Shichong in the 4th month of 619.

items.note: 619 年四月王世充废皇泰主，在洛阳称帝，国号郑；620 年七月起被李世民围困，621 年五月出降。

e.note: In the 4th month of 619 Wang Shichong deposed the Huangtai emperor and proclaimed himself emperor at Luoyang, naming his state Zheng. Besieged by Li Shimin from the 7th month of 620, he came out and surrendered in the 5th month of 621.

items.note: 621 年平王世充后，李世民下令焚乾阳殿、拆端门楼等“奢侈”宫室；657 年高宗以洛阳宫为东都，此后常驻洛阳。684 年九月改称神都，690—705 年武周以此为都，705 年复称东都。

e.note: After Wang Shichong was crushed in 621, Li Shimin ordered the Qianyang Hall burned and the Duan Gate tower pulled down, along with other "extravagant" palace buildings. In 657 Emperor Gaozong made the Luoyang Palace the Eastern Capital and thereafter often resided at Luoyang. In the 9th month of 684 it was renamed the Divine Capital; in 690–705 it was the capital of Wu Zhou, and in 705 it was renamed the Eastern Capital again.

items.note: 炀帝三下江都：605、610、616 年。616 年七月第三次南幸后不再北返，618 年三月骁果军思归，宇文化及等发动兵变，炀帝被缢于江都宫。

e.note: Emperor Yang of Sui went down to Jiangdu three times: in 605, 610 and 616. After the third journey south, in the 7th month of 616, he never returned north. In the 3rd month of 618, with the Xiaoguo guards longing to go home, Yuwen Huaji and others staged a mutiny, and Emperor Yang was strangled in the Jiangdu Palace.

items.note: 619 年九月李子通攻取江都，称帝，国号吴；次年为杜伏威部将辅公祏所败，南渡长江。

e.note: Li Zitong took Jiangdu in the 9th month of 619 and proclaimed himself emperor, naming his state Wu; the following year he was defeated by Du Fuwei's general Fu Gongshi and crossed south over the Yangtze.

items.note: 六朝古都。589 年正月隋军攻入，陈后主与张丽华藏于景阳殿井中被俘；隋文帝下令将建康城邑宫室“平荡耕垦”，另于石头城置蒋州。

e.note: An ancient capital of the Six Dynasties. Sui troops broke in during the 1st month of 589; the Last Ruler of Chen and Zhang Lihua hid in a well at the Jingyang Hall and were captured. Emperor Wen of Sui ordered the city and palaces of Jiankang to be "leveled and plowed for farmland", and set up Jiangzhou at Shitou City instead.

items.note: 620 年杜伏威部将辅公祏破李子通，杜伏威由历阳移驻丹阳，为唐东南道行台所在。

e.note: In 620 Du Fuwei's general Fu Gongshi defeated Li Zitong, and Du Fuwei moved his base from Liyang to Danyang, which became the seat of the Tang Southeast Branch Department.

items.note: 623 年八月辅公祏在丹阳陈朝故都称帝，国号宋；624 年三月李孝恭攻克丹阳。

e.note: In the 8th month of 623 Fu Gongshi proclaimed himself emperor at Danyang, the old Chen capital, naming his state Song; Li Xiaogong took Danyang in the 3rd month of 624.

items.note: 后梁（西梁）都城，萧氏三代据此为北周、隋附庸，587 年被废。

e.note: Capital of the Later Liang (Western Liang); three generations of the Xiao family held it as vassals of the Northern Zhou and the Sui until the state was abolished in 587.

items.note: 618 年四月萧铣称帝后自巴陵迁都江陵，重建后梁宗庙；621 年十月李孝恭、李靖兵临城下，萧铣出降。

e.note: After proclaiming himself emperor in the 4th month of 618, Xiao Xian moved his capital from Baling to Jiangling and rebuilt the ancestral temples of the Later Liang. In the 10th month of 621 Li Xiaogong and Li Jing arrived beneath its walls, and Xiao Xian came out and surrendered.

items.note: 617 年十月萧铣在巴陵起兵，称梁王，以此为最初的都城。

e.note: Xiao Xian rose in arms at Baling in the 10th month of 617, styled himself Prince of Liang and made it his first capital.

items.note: 隋太原郡治、炀帝晋阳宫所在。617 年五月李渊在此起兵，六月建大将军府，七月留李元吉镇守、率军南下。

e.note: Seat of the Sui Taiyuan Commandery and site of the Jinyang Palace of Emperor Yang of Sui. Li Yuan rose in arms here in the 5th month of 617, set up the Grand General's Headquarters in the 6th month, and in the 7th month left Li Yuanji to hold the city and led his army south.

items.note: 马邑郡治善阳。617 年二月刘武周在此杀太守王仁恭起兵，称定杨可汗，以此为都。

e.note: Shanyang, seat of Mayi Commandery. In the 2nd month of 617 Liu Wuzhou killed the governor Wang Rengong here and rose in arms; he took the title Dingyang Qaghan and made it his capital.

items.note: 十六国赫连勃勃所筑统万城，隋为朔方郡治。梁师都据此十一年，628 年四月城破。

e.note: Tongwan City, built by Helian Bobo in the Sixteen Kingdoms period, was the seat of Shuofang Commandery under the Sui. Liang Shidu held it for eleven years; the city fell in the 4th month of 628.

items.mod: 内蒙古准格尔旗十二连城
items.note: 隋榆林郡治，617 年郭子和据此称永乐王。

e.note: Seat of the Sui Yulin Commandery; in 617 Guo Zihe held it and styled himself Prince of Yongle.

items.note: 617 年四月薛举在金城起兵，称西秦霸王。

e.note: In the 4th month of 617 Xue Ju rose in arms at Jincheng and styled himself Hegemon-King of Western Qin.

items.note: 617 年七月薛举称帝，迁都天水（秦州），618 年十一月秦亡。

e.note: In the 7th month of 617 Xue Ju proclaimed himself emperor and moved his capital to Tianshui (Qinzhou); Qin fell in the 11th month of 618.

items.note: 617 年七月李轨据武威称河西大凉王，618 年称帝；619 年五月被安修仁兄弟所执。

e.note: In the 7th month of 617 Li Gui seized Wuwei and styled himself Prince of Great Liang (Hexi); he proclaimed himself emperor in 618, and in the 5th month of 619 he was seized by An Xiuren and his brother.

items.note: 隋大业二年于巩县东南置兴洛仓（洛口仓），仓城周二十余里、窖三千。617 年二月李密袭取后开仓散粮，就地称魏公，此后以洛口与金墉城为根据地。

e.note: In Daye 2 the Sui set up the Xingluo Granary (Luokou Granary) southeast of Gong County; its walled compound was over 20 li around and held 3,000 storage pits. After seizing it by surprise in the 2nd month of 617, Li Mi opened it to hand out grain and took the title Duke of Wei on the spot; from then on Luokou and Jinyong City were his bases.

items.note: 617 年正月窦建德在乐寿称长乐王，618 年冬称夏王，皆都于此。

e.note: Dou Jiande styled himself Prince of Changle at Leshou in the 1st month of 617 and Prince of Xia in the winter of 618, with his capital here both times.

items.note: 619 年窦建德迁都洺州（武安郡永年）。

e.note: In 619 Dou Jiande moved his capital to Mingzhou (Yongnian County, Wu'an Commandery).

items.note: 622 年正月刘黑闼在洺州称汉东王；三月洺水之战后弃城北走，十月再据洺州，623 年正月兵败被斩于此。

e.note: In the 1st month of 622 Liu Heita styled himself Prince of Handong at Mingzhou. After the Battle of the Ming River in the 3rd month he abandoned the city and fled north; he took Mingzhou again in the 10th month, and in the 1st month of 623, defeated, he was beheaded here.

items.note: 618 年七月宇文化及败于童山后退据魏县，鸩杀秦王杨浩，自称皇帝，国号许；次年移聊城，被窦建德所擒。

e.mod: old town of Wei County, Hebei
e.note: Defeated at Tongshan in the 7th month of 618, Yuwen Huaji fell back to hold Wei County, poisoned Yang Hao, Prince of Qin, and proclaimed himself emperor, naming his state Xu; the next year he moved to Liaocheng, where he was captured by Dou Jiande.

items.note: 616 年十二月林士弘在豫章称帝，国号楚，年号太平。

e.note: In the 12th month of 616 Lin Shihong proclaimed himself emperor at Yuzhang, naming his state Chu, with the reign title Taiping.

items.note: 617 年杜伏威据历阳，自称总管，以辅公祏为长史。

e.note: In 617 Du Fuwei seized Liyang, styled himself area commander and made Fu Gongshi his chief administrator.

items.note: 李子通据海陵，自称楚王，619 年九月南下攻取江都。

e.note: Li Zitong held Hailing and styled himself Prince of Chu; in the 9th month of 619 he went south and took Jiangdu.

items.note: 620 年李子通失江都后东渡，灭沈法兴，以余杭为都；621 年十一月被擒。

e.note: After losing Jiangdu in 620, Li Zitong crossed over to the east, destroyed Shen Faxing and made Yuhang his capital; he was captured in the 11th month of 621.

items.note: 沈法兴 618 年起兵后取毗陵为都，自称梁王。

e.note: After rising in arms in 618, Shen Faxing took Piling as his capital and styled himself Prince of Liang.

items.note: 618 年十二月高开道取北平、渔阳，在渔阳称燕王。

e.note: In the 12th month of 618 Gao Kaidao took Beiping and Yuyang, and styled himself Prince of Yan at Yuyang.

items.note: 高开道复叛后以怀戎为都，北连突厥，624 年兵变自缢。

e.note: After rebelling again, Gao Kaidao made Huairong his capital and allied with the Turks to the north; in 624, after a mutiny, he hanged himself.

items.note: 隋鲁郡治瑕丘。徐圆朗据此，621 年八月响应刘黑闼，自称鲁王。

e.note: Xiaqiu, seat of the Sui Lu Commandery. Xu Yuanlang held it; in the 8th month of 621 he rose in support of Liu Heita and styled himself Prince of Lu.

items.note: 汪华据新安郡（歙州），称吴王，保境十余年，621 年九月降唐。

e.note: Wang Hua held Xin'an Commandery (Shezhou) and styled himself Prince of Wu, keeping his territory safe for over ten years; he surrendered to Tang in the 9th month of 621.

items.note: 孟海公据济阴郡周桥城，称宋义王，621 年二月为窦建德所并。

e.note: Meng Haigong held Zhouqiao City in Jiyin Commandery and styled himself Prince of Songyi; he was absorbed by Dou Jiande in the 2nd month of 621.

items.note: 突厥可汗牙帐所在的圣山（于都斤、郁督军山），突厥碑铭称“于都斤山林”。隋唐之际颉利可汗常驻漠南定襄一带。

e.note: The sacred mountain (in Chinese, Yudujin or Yudujun Mountain) where the Turkic qaghans kept their royal camp; the Turkic inscriptions call it the "Ötüken forest". Around the Sui–Tang transition Illig Qaghan usually stayed south of the Gobi, around Dingxiang.

items.note: 薛延陀夷男称可汗后建牙于郁督军山，646 年为唐与回纥所灭。

e.note: After Yinan of the Xueyantuo proclaimed himself qaghan he set up his royal camp at Ötüken; the Xueyantuo were destroyed by Tang and the Huihe (Uyghurs) in 646.

items.mod: 哈萨克斯坦梅尔克一带
items.note: 西突厥可汗夏季牙帐，玄奘称其地“泉池千所”。冬季牙帐在碎叶、鹰娑川等处。

e.note: Summer royal camp of the Western Turkic qaghans; Xuanzang wrote that the place had "a thousand springs and pools". The winter camps were at Suyab, the Yulduz Valley and elsewhere.

items.note: 吐谷浑都城，在青海湖西十五里，方形土城，今遗址犹存。

e.note: Capital of the Tuyuhun, 15 li west of Qinghai Lake: a square town with earthen walls, whose ruins survive today.

items.note: 悉补野部发祥地，雅砻河谷的青瓦达孜宫为早期赞普驻地。

e.note: Homeland of the Pugyal; the Chingwa Taktse Palace in the Yarlung Valley was the seat of the early tsenpos.

items.note: 松赞干布 7 世纪 30 年代迁都逻些，建红山宫（布达拉宫前身）；文成公主带来释迦牟尼像，修建小昭寺，尺尊公主修建大昭寺。

e.note: In the 630s Songtsen Gampo moved his capital to Rasa and built the Red Hill Palace (forerunner of the Potala Palace). Princess Wencheng brought a statue of the Buddha Shakyamuni and built the Ramoche Temple; Princess Bhrikuti built the Jokhang.

items.note: 麴氏高昌都城，630 年（一说 628 年）玄奘在此讲经月余，麴文泰与之结为兄弟。

e.note: Capital of the Qu family's Gaochang. In 630 (or 628) Xuanzang lectured on the sutras here for over a month, and Qu Wentai became his sworn brother.

items.note: 高句丽 586 年迁入新筑的长安城（平壤城），隋唐屡次远征的最终目标。668 年九月被李勣、薛仁贵与新罗军攻破。

e.note: In 586 Goguryeo moved into the newly built Jangan Fortress (Pyongyang), the ultimate target of the repeated Sui and Tang expeditions. It was stormed in the 9th month of 668 by Li Ji, Xue Rengui and Silla troops.

items.note: 百济 538 年迁都泗沘，660 年七月被苏定方攻破，义慈王自熊津出降。

e.note: Baekje moved its capital to Sabi in 538. In the 7th month of 660 the city was stormed by Su Dingfang, and King Uija came out of Ungjin to surrender.

items.note: 百济复国军的据点，662 年扶余丰自倭国归国即位于此，663 年九月白江口战后陷落。地望有争议。

e.note: Stronghold of the Baekje restoration army; in 662 Buyeo Pung returned from Wa and was enthroned here. It fell in the 9th month of 663, after the Battle of Baekgang. Its location is disputed.

items.note: 新罗王京，今庆州。善德女王时建瞻星台、皇龙寺九层塔。

e.note: The royal capital of Silla, today's Gyeongju. The Cheomseongdae observatory and the nine-story pagoda of Hwangnyong Temple were built under Queen Seondeok.

items.note: 推古天皇以来的倭国政治中心；645 年大化改新后一度迁难波，667 年三月天智天皇迁近江大津宫；672 年壬申之乱后天武天皇还都飞鸟净御原宫，694 年十二月持统天皇迁藤原京。

e.note: The political center of Wa from the reign of Empress Suiko on. After the Taika Reform of 645 the court moved for a time to Naniwa, and in the 3rd month of 667 Emperor Tenji moved the capital to the Ōmi-Ōtsu Palace. After the Jinshin War of 672 Emperor Tenmu moved the capital back to the Asuka Kiyomihara Palace, and in the 12th month of 694 Empress Jitō moved to Fujiwara-kyō.

items.note: 667 年三月天智天皇自飞鸟迁都近江大津宫，668 年正式即位；672 年壬申之乱，大友皇子败死，大海人皇子（天武天皇）还都飞鸟。

e.note: In the 3rd month of 667 Emperor Tenji moved the capital from Asuka to the Ōmi-Ōtsu Palace, and in 668 he formally took the throne. In the Jinshin War of 672 Prince Ōtomo was defeated and died, and Prince Ōama (Emperor Tenmu) moved the capital back to Asuka.

items.note: 林邑都城，梵名僧伽补罗（狮子城）。605 年刘方攻入，掠其金人十八、佛经一千三百余部而还。

e.note: Capital of Linyi; its Sanskrit name was Simhapura ("Lion City"). Liu Fang stormed it in 605 and withdrew, carrying off its eighteen golden figures and over 1,300 Buddhist scriptures.

items.note: 戒日王都城，642 年戒日王在此召集论议大会，玄奘为论主，十八日无人能难。

e.note: Capital of Harsha. In 642 he convened a great debate here with Xuanzang as the chief debater; for eighteen days no one could refute him.

items.note: 羊同（象雄）都城，644 年前后为吐蕃所灭。

e.note: Capital of Yangtong (Zhangzhung), which was destroyed by Tibet around 644.

items.note: 682 年阿史那骨咄禄聚众据黑沙城复国，以此为初期牙帐，南寇单于府与并、代；后北移于都斤山。地望诸说不一，一说在今呼和浩特北、阴山以北。

e.note: In 682 Ashina Qutlugh gathered followers, seized Heisha City and restored the Turkic state, making it his early royal camp; from here he raided south against the Chanyu Protectorate, Bingzhou and Daizhou. The camp later moved north to Ötüken. The location is disputed; one view places it north of today's Hohhot, north of the Yin Mountains.

items.note: 后突厥据漠北后复以于都斤山为牙帐，阙特勤碑、毗伽可汗碑立于其东鄂尔浑河畔（732、735 年）。745 年回纥杀白眉可汗，后突厥亡。

e.note: After the Second Turkic Qaghanate took over the lands north of the Gobi it again made Ötüken its royal camp; the steles of Kül Tegin and Bilge Qaghan were set up east of it, beside the Orkhon River (732, 735). In 745 the Uyghurs killed Baimei Qaghan, and the Second Turkic Qaghanate fell.

items.mod: 吉尔吉斯斯坦托克马克
items.note: 703 年乌质勒攻陷碎叶，以此为大牙、弓月城为小牙；711 年后突厥默啜击杀娑葛，714 年三月唐碛西节度使阿史那献克碎叶，719 年唐以碎叶与苏禄。739 年八月盖嘉运破吐火仙可汗于城下，此后碎叶为突骑施余部所据，748 年王正见破城。

e.note: In 703 Üch Elig took Suyab and made it his main royal camp, with Gongyue City as his lesser camp. In 711 Qapaghan of the Second Turkic Qaghanate attacked and killed Saqal; in the 3rd month of 714 Ashina Xian, the Tang military governor of Qixi, took Suyab, and in 719 Tang gave Suyab to Suluk. In the 8th month of 739 Gai Jiayun defeated Tuhuoxian Qaghan beneath its walls; after that Suyab was held by the Türgesh remnants, and in 748 Wang Zhengjian took the city.

items.note: 698 年大祚荣率众东走，“据东牟山，筑城以居”，建震国；渤海人称此为旧国。约 742 年大钦茂迁都显州（中京）。

e.note: In 698 Dae Joyeong led his people east; he "held Mount Dongmou and built a walled town to live in", founding the state of Jin. The people of Balhae called this place the Old Capital. Around 742 Dae Heummu moved the capital to Xianzhou (Central Capital).

items.note: 约 742 年大钦茂自旧国迁都显州，后称中京显德府；天宝末（约 756 年）再迁上京。

e.note: Around 742 Dae Heummu moved the capital from the Old Capital to Xianzhou, which was later called Xiande Fu (Central Capital); at the end of the Tianbao era (c. 756) the capital moved again, to the Supreme Capital.

items.note: 739 年皮罗阁自蒙舍川（巍山）迁都太和城，城依苍山、临洱海，766 年阁罗凤立《南诏德化碑》于城中，779 年迁阳苴咩城。

e.note: In 739 Piluoge moved his capital from the Mengshe Valley (Weishan) to Taihe City, which was set against the Cang Mountains and overlooked Erhai Lake. In 766 Geluofeng set up the Nanzhao Dehua Stele in the city; in 779 the capital moved to Yangjumie City.

items.note: 744 年骨力裴罗建回纥汗国，牙帐在乌德鞬山（于都斤山）与鄂尔浑河之间，后筑城为斡耳朵八里（今哈拉巴拉嘎斯遗址）。

e.note: In 744 Guli Peiluo founded the Uyghur Qaghanate, with his royal camp between Ötüken and the Orkhon River; a city was later built there: Ordu-Baliq (today's Kharbalgas ruins).

items.note: 694 年持统天皇迁入的日本第一座仿中国都城规划的都城，至 710 年。

e.note: Japan's first capital laid out on the model of Chinese capital cities; Empress Jitō moved into it in 694, and it remained the capital until 710.

items.note: 694 年持统天皇迁入的日本第一座仿中国都城规划的都城，710 年三月元明天皇迁平城京。

e.note: Japan's first capital laid out on the model of Chinese capital cities; Empress Jitō moved into it in 694. In the 3rd month of 710 Empress Genmei moved to Heijō-kyō.

items.note: 710 年元明天皇迁都平城京，仿长安城规划，东大寺、唐招提寺所在，为都至 784 年，奈良时代即由此得名；753 年鉴真东渡后在此传戒。

e.note: In 710 Empress Genmei moved the capital to Heijō-kyō, which was laid out on the model of Chang'an and was the site of Tōdai-ji and Tōshōdai-ji; it was the capital until 784, and the Nara period takes its name from it. After his eastward voyage in 753, Jianzhen conferred the precepts here.

items.cmd: 杨爽、李充 vs 沙钵略可汗
items.note: 隋卫王杨爽率军出朔州，李充以五千精骑袭破沙钵略于白道，沙钵略负伤而逃；突厥自此内乱分裂。

e.note: Yang Shuang, the Sui Prince of Wei, led an army out of Shuozhou, and Li Chong with 5,000 elite cavalry fell on Ishbara at Baidao and routed him; Ishbara fled wounded. From then on the Turks fell into internal strife and split apart.
e.cmd: Yang Shuang and Li Chong vs. Ishbara Qaghan

items.cmd: 杨广（元帅）、贺若弼、韩擒虎 vs 陈叔宝、萧摩诃
items.note: 贺若弼自广陵渡江、于钟山下大败萧摩诃，韩擒虎以五百人夜渡采石，先入朱雀门，陈后主被俘。自出兵至灭陈不足三月。

e.note: Heruo Bi crossed the Yangtze from Guangling and crushed Xiao Mohe below Mount Zhong; Han Qinhu crossed at Caishi by night with 500 men and was the first to enter by the Zhuque Gate, and the Last Ruler of Chen was captured. From the launch of the campaign to the fall of Chen took less than three months.
e.cmd: Yang Guang (commander-in-chief), Heruo Bi and Han Qinhu vs. Chen Shubao and Xiao Mohe

items.cmd: 杨素 vs 达头可汗
items.note: 杨素一改车骑步兵相参、鹿角方阵的旧法，令诸军为骑阵主动出击，大破达头可汗，突厥“号哭而去”。

e.note: Yang Su abandoned the old method of mixing chariots, cavalry and infantry in square formations behind abatis, and had all his units form up as cavalry and take the offensive. He crushed Tardu Qaghan, and the Turks "went off wailing".
e.cmd: Yang Su vs. Tardu Qaghan

items.sides: 隋 胜 交州李氏
items.cmd: 刘方 vs 李佛子
items.note: 刘方以瓜州刺史出任交州道行军总管，进至都隆岭，李佛子请降，被送往长安。

e.note: Liu Fang, prefect of Guazhou, was appointed expedition commander for the Jiaozhou route. When he advanced to Dulong Pass, Lý Phật Tử asked to surrender and was sent to Chang'an.
e.sides: Sui defeated the Lý of Jiaozhou
e.cmd: Liu Fang vs. Lý Phật Tử

items.cmd: 刘方 vs 范梵志
items.note: 林邑以巨象迎战，刘方掘小坑覆草、引象陷落，再以弩射象，象反践其阵，遂破其都典冲。隋军回师时多染疫，刘方病卒。

e.note: Linyi met him with great elephants. Liu Fang dug small pits covered with grass so that the elephants fell in, then shot them with crossbows, and the elephants turned and trampled Linyi's own ranks; he went on to take its capital, Simhapura. On the march back many Sui soldiers caught disease, and Liu Fang died of illness.
e.cmd: Liu Fang vs. Sambhuvarman

items.cmd: 隋炀帝、宇文述 vs 伏允可汗
items.note: 炀帝亲征，四面合围伏允于覆袁川，伏允以数十骑逃入党项；隋得其地东西四千里、南北二千里，置四郡。

e.note: Emperor Yang campaigned in person and surrounded Fuyun on all sides at Fuyuan Valley; Fuyun escaped with a few dozen horsemen into the lands of the Tanguts. Sui gained his territory, 4,000 li from east to west and 2,000 li from north to south, and set up four commanderies there.
e.cmd: Emperor Yang of Sui and Yuwen Shu vs. Fuyun Qaghan

items.cmd: 乙支文德 vs 宇文述、于仲文
items.note: 宇文述三十万五千人渡鸭绿江直趋平壤，乙支文德诈降诱敌深入，待隋军粮尽撤退、半渡萨水时奋击，隋军大溃，“还至辽东城，唯二千七百人”。

e.note: Yuwen Shu's 305,000 men crossed the Yalu River and drove straight for Pyongyang. Eulji Mundeok feigned surrender to lure them deep inside, then, once the Sui army had run out of food and was retreating, struck as it was halfway across the Salsu River. The Sui army collapsed: "when they got back to Yodong Fortress, only 2,700 men were left".
e.cmd: Eulji Mundeok vs. Yuwen Shu and Yu Zhongwen

items.cmd: 来护儿 vs 高句丽
items.note: 三征高句丽，来护儿率水军渡海破卑奢城，将趋平壤，高句丽王高元遣使请降，炀帝班师。

e.note: In the third Goguryeo campaign Lai Hu'er took the navy across the sea and stormed Bisa Fortress. As he was about to advance on Pyongyang, the Goguryeo king Go Won sent envoys to sue for surrender, and Emperor Yang withdrew.
e.cmd: Lai Hu'er vs. Goguryeo

items.cmd: 宇文述、屈突通 vs 杨玄感
items.note: 杨玄感六月在黎阳起兵，围东都不克，西进关中途中被追及，于阌乡董杜原兵败自杀，李密亡命。

e.note: Yang Xuangan rose in arms at Liyang in the 6th month and besieged the Eastern Capital without success. Heading west for Guanzhong, he was overtaken on the way, defeated at Dongdu Plain in Wenxiang, and killed himself; Li Mi became a fugitive.
e.cmd: Yuwen Shu and Qutu Tong vs. Yang Xuangan

items.cmd: 隋炀帝（李世民应募从云定兴军） vs 始毕可汗
items.note: 炀帝北巡被突厥数十万骑围于雁门郡城，四十一城被克三十九。十六岁的李世民建议多张旗鼓、昼夜钲鼓相闻以为疑兵，加以义成公主谎报北边有警，始毕解围而去。

e.note: On a northern tour Emperor Yang was surrounded in the seat of Yanmen Commandery by several hundred thousand Turkic horsemen, and 39 of its 41 towns fell. The 16-year-old Li Shimin proposed setting out many banners and drums and keeping gongs and drums sounding day and night as a ruse; together with Princess Yicheng's false report of an alarm on the northern frontier, this led Shibi to lift the siege and leave.
e.sides: Siege lifted for Sui (the Turks withdrew)
e.cmd: Emperor Yang of Sui (Li Shimin volunteered with Yun Dingxing's army) vs. Shibi Qaghan

items.cmd: 翟让、李密 vs 张须陀
items.note: 李密设伏于大海寺北林间，诱隋荥阳通守、名将张须陀追击，四面合围，张须陀战死，河南隋军为之丧气，瓦岗军声势大振。

e.note: Li Mi laid an ambush in the woods north of Dahai Monastery and lured the noted general Zhang Xutuo, Sui vice-governor of Xingyang, into pursuit. Surrounded on all sides, Zhang Xutuo was killed in battle. The Sui forces in Henan lost heart, and the Wagang army's strength and prestige soared.
e.cmd: Zhai Rang and Li Mi vs. Zhang Xutuo

items.cmd: 窦建德 vs 薛世雄
items.note: 隋涿郡留守薛世雄率三万人南援东都，窦建德以敢死之士二百八十人乘大雾夜袭其营，隋军大溃，河北郡县多附建德。

e.note: Xue Shixiong, Sui custodian of Zhuo Commandery, led 30,000 men south to relieve the Eastern Capital. Under cover of a thick fog Dou Jiande raided his camp by night with 280 men ready to die; the Sui army was routed, and many commanderies and counties of Hebei went over to Dou Jiande.
e.cmd: Dou Jiande vs. Xue Shixiong

items.cmd: 李渊、李建成、李世民 vs 宋老生
items.note: 李渊军阻雨贾胡堡，粮将尽，一度欲回师太原，李世民夜号于帐外力谏乃止。八月李建成、李世民诱宋老生出城，李世民率骑兵从南原冲断其阵，宋老生被斩，霍邑遂克。

e.note: Li Yuan's army was held up by rain at Guhu Fort and its food was nearly gone; at one point Li Yuan meant to march back to Taiyuan, and gave up the idea only when Li Shimin wailed outside his tent at night and pleaded with him. In the 8th month Li Jiancheng and Li Shimin lured Song Laosheng out of the city; Li Shimin led the cavalry charging from the southern plain and cut his line in two, Song Laosheng was beheaded, and Huoyi fell.
e.cmd: Li Yuan, Li Jiancheng and Li Shimin vs. Song Laosheng

items.cmd: 李渊、李建成、李世民 vs 阴世师、卫文昇
items.note: 九月李渊西渡龙门，十月围大兴城，二十万众“各依垒壁”，约法“毋犯隋七庙及代王宗室”。十一月军头雷永吉先登，城破，立代王杨侑为帝，改元义宁。

e.note: In the 9th month Li Yuan crossed west at Longmen, and in the 10th month he besieged Daxing City. His 200,000 men "each kept to their own ramparts", under the agreed order "do not violate the seven ancestral temples of Sui or the Prince of Dai and the imperial clan". In the 11th month the officer Lei Yongji was first onto the walls and the city fell; Yang You, Prince of Dai, was enthroned as emperor, and the era name was changed to Yining.
e.cmd: Li Yuan, Li Jiancheng and Li Shimin vs. Yin Shishi and Wei Wensheng

items.cmd: 李世民 vs 薛仁杲
items.note: 薛举遣其子薛仁杲率十万之众围扶风，李世民击破之，追至陇坻而还，关中西陲遂安。

e.note: Xue Ju sent his son Xue Rengao with 100,000 men to besiege Fufeng. Li Shimin routed him and pursued as far as Longdi before turning back, and the western edge of Guanzhong was made secure.
e.cmd: Li Shimin vs. Xue Rengao

items.sides: 魏 胜 宇文化及
items.cmd: 李密 vs 宇文化及
items.note: 宇文化及率骁果北上争东都，李密受皇泰主招抚，与其在童山下鏖战，李密中流矢坠马，部将秦叔宝死战救护，终败宇文化及；但李密精兵亦损失殆尽。

e.note: Yuwen Huaji led the Xiaoguo guards north to contend for the Eastern Capital. Li Mi, who had accepted the Huangtai emperor's offer of amnesty, fought a bitter battle with him below Tongshan. Li Mi was hit by a stray arrow and fell from his horse, and his officer Qin Shubao fought desperately to protect him; in the end Yuwen Huaji was defeated, but Li Mi's best troops were almost all lost.
e.cmd: Li Mi vs. Yuwen Huaji

items.cmd: 薛举 vs 刘文静、殷开山（李世民卧病）
items.note: 李世民患疟卧病，嘱诸将坚守勿战，刘文静、殷开山却轻敌出营，被薛举掩袭，唐军八总管皆败，死者十之五六，李世民退回长安。

e.note: Li Shimin, bedridden with malaria, ordered his generals to hold fast and not give battle, but Liu Wenjing and Yin Kaishan, underestimating the enemy, left their camp and were taken by surprise by Xue Ju. All eight Tang commanders were defeated, five or six in ten of the men died, and Li Shimin withdrew to Chang'an.
e.cmd: Xue Ju vs. Liu Wenjing and Yin Kaishan (Li Shimin ill)

items.cmd: 李世民 vs 薛仁杲、宗罗睺
items.note: 薛举八月病死，薛仁杲继立。李世民深沟高垒六十余日，待秦军粮尽、将士离心，先以梁实诱宗罗睺来攻，再亲率精骑出其阵后夹击，大破之；李世民仅以二千骑穷追至折墌城下，薛仁杲出降，陇右平定。

e.note: Xue Ju died of illness in the 8th month and Xue Rengao succeeded him. Li Shimin dug deep trenches and built high ramparts for over 60 days, waiting until the Qin army ran out of food and its officers and men lost heart. He first used Liang Shi as bait to draw Zong Luohou into attacking, then personally led elite cavalry out behind Zong's lines to strike from both sides, and crushed him. With only 2,000 horsemen Li Shimin pursued relentlessly to the walls of Zhezhi City; Xue Rengao came out and surrendered, and Longyou was pacified.
e.cmd: Li Shimin vs. Xue Rengao and Zong Luohou

items.cmd: 王世充 vs 李密
items.note: 童山战后李密军疲，王世充选精兵二万余（马二千余匹）偷袭，伏兵于邙山，又以貌似李密者缚之阵前，魏军大溃，李密西走降唐，其众多归王世充。

e.mod: Mount Mang north of Yanshi, Henan
e.note: After Tongshan Li Mi's army was exhausted. Wang Shichong picked over 20,000 elite troops (with over 2,000 horses) for a surprise attack, set an ambush on Mount Mang, and paraded a bound man who looked like Li Mi in front of the lines. The Wei army collapsed; Li Mi fled west and submitted to Tang, and most of his followers went over to Wang Shichong.
e.cmd: Wang Shichong vs. Li Mi

items.cmd: 窦建德 vs 宇文化及
items.note: 窦建德以为隋讨贼为名攻宇文化及于聊城，城破，宇文化及被擒斩首；窦建德谒见萧皇后，素服哭炀帝，收传国玺。

e.note: Claiming to punish the rebels on behalf of Sui, Dou Jiande attacked Yuwen Huaji at Liaocheng. The city fell, and Yuwen Huaji was captured and beheaded. Dou Jiande paid his respects to Empress Xiao, mourned Emperor Yang in plain white clothes, and took possession of the Imperial Seal of the Realm.
e.cmd: Dou Jiande vs. Yuwen Huaji

items.cmd: 宋金刚 vs 裴寂
items.note: 裴寂率唐军屯于度索原，营中饮水被宋金刚截断，移营之际遭袭，全军溃败，裴寂一日一夜奔还晋州，河东诸州相继失陷。

e.note: Pei Ji camped the Tang army on Dusuo Plain. Song Jingang cut off the camp's drinking water, and as the army was moving camp it was attacked and routed entirely. Pei Ji fled back to Jinzhou in a day and a night, and the prefectures of Hedong fell one after another.
e.cmd: Song Jingang vs. Pei Ji

items.cmd: 李世民 vs 宋金刚
items.note: 李世民自龙门乘坚冰渡河，屯柏壁与宋金刚相持，坚壁不战，遣兵抄掠其粮道、收集民间粮草。相持五个月，至次年四月宋金刚粮尽北走。

e.note: Li Shimin crossed the Yellow River on the thick ice at Longmen and camped at Baibi facing Song Jingang. He kept behind his walls and refused battle, sending troops to raid Song's supply lines and to collect grain and fodder from the people. After five months of standoff, in the 4th month of the following year Song Jingang ran out of food and withdrew north.
e.cmd: Li Shimin vs. Song Jingang

items.cmd: 殷开山、秦叔宝 vs 尉迟敬德、寻相
items.note: 尉迟敬德、寻相袭击夏县后回师，唐将殷开山、秦叔宝伏兵于美良川，斩首二千余级。

e.note: Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang were returning from a raid on Xia County when the Tang generals Yin Kaishan and Qin Shubao ambushed them at Meiliangchuan, taking over 2,000 heads.
e.cmd: Yin Kaishan and Qin Shubao vs. Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang

items.cmd: 李世民 vs 宋金刚
items.note: 宋金刚北撤，李世民亲率骑兵穷追，一昼夜行二百余里，在雀鼠谷一日八战皆捷，斩俘数万；李世民两日不食、三日不解甲，与士卒分食一只羊。

e.note: As Song Jingang withdrew north, Li Shimin personally led his cavalry in relentless pursuit, covering over 200 li in a day and a night. At Queshu Valley he fought eight battles in one day and won them all, killing or capturing tens of thousands. Li Shimin went two days without food and three days without taking off his armor, and shared a single sheep with his soldiers.
e.cmd: Li Shimin vs. Song Jingang

items.cmd: 李世民 vs 宋金刚、尉迟敬德
items.note: 宋金刚收余众二万背城列阵，李世民令李勣迎战、自率精骑冲其阵后，宋金刚大败北逃；尉迟敬德、寻相以介休、永安降，李世民即令尉迟敬德统其旧部八千，自此成为心腹猛将。

e.note: Song Jingang gathered his remaining 20,000 men and drew up with his back to the city. Li Shimin had Li Ji engage him while he himself led elite cavalry to charge the rear of Song's line, and Song Jingang was badly beaten and fled north. Yuchi Jingde and Xun Xiang surrendered Jiexiu and Yong'an; Li Shimin at once put Yuchi Jingde back in command of his old troops, 8,000 men, and from then on Yuchi was one of his most trusted and formidable generals.
e.cmd: Li Shimin vs. Song Jingang and Yuchi Jingde

items.cmd: 李世民 vs 王世充
items.note: 李世民率军东征，先扫清洛阳外围，在北邙、慈涧多次与王世充交战，尉迟敬德单骑救主刺落单雄信。621 年二月起四面围城，城中乏食，“绢一匹直粟三升”。

e.note: Li Shimin led his army east and first cleared the approaches to Luoyang, fighting Wang Shichong several times at Mount Mang and Cijian; Yuchi Jingde rode alone to rescue his lord and speared Shan Xiongxin from his horse. From the 2nd month of 621 the city was surrounded on all sides and ran short of food: "a bolt of silk was worth three sheng of millet".
e.cmd: Li Shimin vs. Wang Shichong

items.cmd: 李世民 vs 窦建德
items.note: 窦建德率十余万众西援洛阳，被李世民三千五百骑阻于虎牢一月有余。五月初二窦建德列阵汜水东二十里挑战，李世民待其士卒饥疲坐地争饮，午后率史大奈、程知节、秦叔宝等卷旗突入其阵后，夏军大溃，窦建德中槊坠马被擒。

e.note: Dou Jiande led over 100,000 men west to relieve Luoyang, but was held at Hulao for more than a month by Li Shimin's 3,500 horsemen. On the 2nd day of the 5th month Dou Jiande drew up a battle line stretching 20 li east of the Si River and offered battle. Li Shimin waited until Dou's soldiers, hungry and tired, were sitting on the ground and jostling to drink, then in the afternoon led Shi Danai, Cheng Zhijie, Qin Shubao and others, banners furled, to break through to the rear of Dou's lines. The Xia army collapsed, and Dou Jiande, struck by a lance, fell from his horse and was captured.
e.cmd: Li Shimin vs. Dou Jiande

items.cmd: 李孝恭、李靖 vs 萧铣
items.note: 李靖献策乘秋季江水暴涨顺流而下，“兵贵神速”；唐军连破荆门、宜都，在清江口大败文士弘，围江陵。李靖令将缴获的舟船散弃江中，使援军疑江陵已破；萧铣援兵不至，开城出降。

e.note: Li Jing proposed taking advantage of the Yangtze's autumn flood to sail downstream, since "in war, speed is everything". The Tang army took Jingmen and Yidu in succession, crushed Wen Shihong at the mouth of the Qing River, and besieged Jiangling. Li Jing had the captured boats cast adrift on the river so that relief forces would suspect Jiangling had already fallen; with no relief arriving, Xiao Xian opened the gates and surrendered.
e.cmd: Li Xiaogong and Li Jing vs. Xiao Xian

items.cmd: 李世民、李勣、罗艺 vs 刘黑闼
items.note: 李世民与刘黑闼夹洺水对峙六十余日，暗中在上游筑堰蓄水。刘黑闼粮尽，率二万步骑南渡决战，李世民亲率精骑击破其左军，随即决堰，大水骤至，汉东军被斩首万余、溺死数千，刘黑闼与数百骑北奔突厥。

e.mod: Ming River between Quzhou and Feixiang, Hebei
e.note: Li Shimin and Liu Heita faced each other across the Ming River for over 60 days, while Li Shimin secretly built a dam upstream to hold back the water. When his food ran out, Liu Heita led 20,000 infantry and cavalry south across the river to fight a decisive battle. Li Shimin personally led elite cavalry to break his left wing, then breached the dam; the water rushed down, the Handong army lost over 10,000 beheaded and several thousand drowned, and Liu Heita fled north to the Turks with a few hundred horsemen.
e.cmd: Li Shimin, Li Ji and Luo Yi vs. Liu Heita

items.cmd: 刘黑闼 vs 李道玄
items.note: 刘黑闼引突厥兵复入河北，淮阳王李道玄年仅十九，轻进于下博，兵败被杀；齐王李元吉畏敌不敢进，河北再度陷落。

e.note: Liu Heita brought Turkic troops back into Hebei. Li Daoxuan, Prince of Huaiyang, only 19 years old, advanced rashly at Xiabo and was defeated and killed; Li Yuanji, Prince of Qi, was afraid of the enemy and dared not advance, and Hebei was lost again.
e.cmd: Liu Heita vs. Li Daoxuan

items.cmd: 李建成 vs 刘黑闼
items.note: 太子李建成用魏征之计，释放俘虏、安抚河北，刘黑闼众心离散；十二月追至馆陶，刘黑闼渡永济渠北逃，623 年正月在饶阳被部将诸葛德威执送唐军，斩于洺州。

e.note: The crown prince Li Jiancheng followed Wei Zheng's plan of releasing captives and reassuring Hebei, and Liu Heita's followers lost heart and drifted away. In the 12th month Li Jiancheng pursued him to Guantao; Liu Heita crossed the Yongji Canal and fled north, and in the 1st month of 623 at Raoyang his officer Zhuge Dewei seized him and handed him over to the Tang army. He was beheaded at Mingzhou.
e.cmd: Li Jiancheng vs. Liu Heita

items.cmd: 李孝恭、李靖、李勣 vs 冯慧亮、陈正通
items.note: 辅公祏遣冯慧亮、陈正通据博望、青林二山，以铁锁横江。李靖以老弱诱敌、精兵后击，大破之，乘胜进克丹阳，辅公祏东逃被擒。

e.note: Fu Gongshi sent Feng Huiliang and Chen Zhengtong to hold the two mountains of Bowang and Qinglin, with iron chains stretched across the Yangtze. Li Jing used his old and weak troops to lure the enemy out, then struck with his best troops, crushing them. Following up the victory he took Danyang, and Fu Gongshi fled east and was captured.
e.cmd: Li Xiaogong, Li Jing and Li Ji vs. Feng Huiliang and Chen Zhengtong

items.sides: 唐 退 东突厥（未战而盟）
items.cmd: 李世民 vs 颉利、突利可汗
items.note: 颉利、突利二可汗举国入寇，至豳州五陇阪。时逢久雨，李世民率百骑至阵前责颉利负约，又暗中离间突利，颉利不战而请和，突利从此与李世民结为兄弟。

e.note: The two qaghans Illig and Tuli invaded with the full strength of their realm and reached Wulong Slope in Binzhou. It had been raining for a long time. Li Shimin rode up to their lines with a hundred horsemen and rebuked Illig for breaking his word, while secretly working to turn Tuli against him. Illig asked for peace without fighting, and from then on Tuli and Li Shimin were sworn brothers.
e.sides: Tang turned back the Eastern Turks (truce without battle)
e.cmd: Li Shimin vs. Illig and Tuli Qaghans

items.cmd: 柴绍、薛万均 vs 梁师都
items.note: 唐军乘东突厥内乱进围朔方，击退突厥援兵，城中粮尽，梁洛仁杀梁师都出降。

e.note: Taking advantage of turmoil among the Eastern Turks, the Tang army advanced and besieged Shuofang and drove off a Turkic relief force. When the city ran out of food, Liang Luoren killed Liang Shidu and surrendered.
e.cmd: Chai Shao and Xue Wanjun vs. Liang Shidu

items.cmd: 李靖 vs 颉利可汗
items.note: 李靖率三千骁骑自马邑出发，冒雪夜进恶阳岭，突袭定襄，颉利大惊，以为唐倾国而来，退走碛口；隋萧皇后与炀帝之孙杨政道被迎归。

e.note: Li Jing set out from Mayi with 3,000 picked cavalry, advanced through snow by night to Eyang Pass, and fell on Dingxiang by surprise. Illig, greatly alarmed and thinking Tang had come in full force, fell back to Qikou. Empress Xiao of Sui and Emperor Yang's grandson Yang Zhengdao were brought back.
e.cmd: Li Jing vs. Illig Qaghan

items.cmd: 李靖、李勣 vs 颉利可汗
items.note: 颉利遣使请降，太宗遣唐俭抚慰。李靖判断其“必不设备”，率万骑带二十日粮趁大雾直抵牙帐，斩首万余、俘男女十余万，颉利西逃，三月被行军副总管张宝相擒获，东突厥亡。

e.mod: northern foot of the Yin Mountains, Inner Mongolia
e.note: Illig sent envoys to offer his submission, and Taizong sent Tang Jian to reassure him. Judging that Illig "would certainly not be on guard", Li Jing took 10,000 cavalry with 20 days' rations and, under cover of a thick fog, struck straight at the royal camp, taking over 10,000 heads and capturing more than 100,000 men and women. Illig fled west and in the 3rd month was captured by the deputy expedition commander Zhang Baoxiang; the Eastern Turkic Qaghanate came to an end.
e.cmd: Li Jing and Li Ji vs. Illig Qaghan

items.cmd: 李靖、侯君集、李道宗 vs 伏允可汗
items.note: 吐谷浑尽烧野草，使唐军马无所食，李靖分兵两路，侯君集、李道宗南路行无人之境二千余里、“人龁冰、马啖雪”，追至柏海、星宿川；伏允在大漠中为左右所杀。

e.note: The Tuyuhun burned all the wild grass so that the Tang horses would have nothing to eat. Li Jing split his forces into two columns; on the southern route Hou Junji and Li Daozong marched over 2,000 li through uninhabited land, "the men chewing ice and the horses eating snow", pursuing as far as Baihai and Xingxiu Valley. Fuyun was killed by his own followers in the great desert.
e.cmd: Li Jing, Hou Junji and Li Daozong vs. Fuyun Qaghan

items.cmd: 牛进达 vs 吐蕃军
items.note: 松赞干布以求婚不遂为由率二十万众进攻松州，唐先锋牛进达夜袭其营，斩首千余级，吐蕃退兵谢罪，再度请婚。

e.note: Using his failed marriage request as a pretext, Songtsen Gampo attacked Songzhou with 200,000 men. The Tang vanguard commander Niu Jinda raided his camp by night and took over 1,000 heads; the Tibetans withdrew, apologized, and asked again for a marriage.
e.cmd: Niu Jinda vs. the Tibetan army

items.cmd: 侯君集、薛万均 vs 麴智盛
items.note: 麴文泰以为唐军不能越过沙碛而来，闻唐军至碛口忧惧而死。侯君集以巨型抛车、撞车攻城，麴智盛出降，得二十二城，唐置西州。

e.note: Qu Wentai believed no Tang army could cross the desert to reach him; when he heard it had reached the edge of the desert, he died of fear and worry. Hou Junji attacked the city with giant catapults and battering rams, Qu Zhisheng came out and surrendered, 22 towns were taken, and Tang set up Xizhou.
e.cmd: Hou Junji and Xue Wanjun vs. Qu Zhisheng

items.cmd: 李勣 vs 大度设
items.note: 薛延陀乘太宗将东封泰山之际以二十万众南侵李思摩，李勣率步骑追至诺真水，薛延陀步战失利，斩首三千，大度设遁走。

e.note: Taking advantage of the moment when Taizong was about to go east for the feng sacrifice at Mount Tai, the Xueyantuo struck south against Li Simo with 200,000 men. Li Ji pursued with infantry and cavalry as far as the Nuozhen River; the Xueyantuo were beaten fighting on foot, 3,000 were beheaded, and Dadu Shad fled.
e.cmd: Li Ji vs. Dadu Shad

items.cmd: 郭孝恪 vs 龙突骑支
items.note: 焉耆附西突厥、背唐，安西都护郭孝恪率三千骑夜渡湖水奇袭，擒焉耆王龙突骑支。

e.note: Karasahr attached itself to the Western Turks and turned against Tang. Guo Xiaoke, protector-general of Anxi, led 3,000 horsemen across the lake waters by night in a surprise attack and captured Long Tuqizhi, king of Karasahr.
e.cmd: Guo Xiaoke vs. Long Tuqizhi

items.cmd: 唐太宗、李勣 vs 高句丽
items.note: 太宗亲征，李勣自柳城佯出怀远镇，潜师北渡辽水，先拔盖牟城；太宗渡辽泽后围辽东城，乘南风纵火焚城楼，城破。

e.note: Taizong campaigned in person. Li Ji set out from Liucheng, feinting toward Huaiyuan Garrison, then marched north in secret, crossed the Liao River and first took Gaemo Fortress. After crossing the Liao marshes, Taizong besieged Yodong Fortress; using a south wind he set fire to the towers on the walls, and the city fell.
e.cmd: Emperor Taizong of Tang and Li Ji vs. Goguryeo

items.cmd: 唐太宗、李勣、长孙无忌、薛仁贵 vs 高延寿、高惠真
items.note: 高句丽十五万援军来救安市城，太宗亲自部署，李勣列阵于西、长孙无忌伏兵于北，白衣薛仁贵冲阵立功；高延寿等率三万六千余人投降，太宗名所驻之山为驻跸山。

e.note: A Goguryeo relief army of 150,000 came to save Ansi Fortress. Taizong directed the deployment himself: Li Ji drew up to the west and Zhangsun Wuji lay in ambush to the north, while Xue Rengui, dressed in white, won distinction charging the enemy line. Go Yeon-su and others surrendered with over 36,000 men, and Taizong named the hill where he had camped Mount Zhubi.
e.cmd: Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Ji, Zhangsun Wuji and Xue Rengui vs. Go Yeon-su and Go Hye-jin

items.sides: 高句丽 守住（唐班师）
items.cmd: 唐太宗、李勣、李道宗 vs 安市城守将
items.note: 唐军筑土山攻城六十余日，土山倒塌反为守军所据；九月辽东寒冷、草枯水冻，太宗班师，叹“魏征若在，不使我有是行也”。

e.note: The Tang army built an earthen mound and attacked the city for over 60 days, but the mound collapsed and was seized by the defenders. In the 9th month, with Liaodong turning cold, the grass withered and the water frozen, Taizong withdrew, sighing, "If Wei Zheng were alive, he would not have let me make this expedition."
e.cmd: Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Ji and Li Daozong vs. the commander of Ansi

items.cmd: 李勣 vs 咄摩支
items.note: 薛延陀多弥可汗被回纥所杀，余众立咄摩支，唐军李勣至郁督军山，其众降者五万余，薛延陀亡。

e.note: Duomi Qaghan of the Xueyantuo was killed by the Huihe (Uyghurs), and the remnants of his people set up Duomozhi. When the Tang army under Li Ji reached Ötüken, over 50,000 of them surrendered, and the Xueyantuo were finished.
e.cmd: Li Ji vs. Duomozhi

items.cmd: 阿史那社尔、郭孝恪 vs 白诃黎布失毕
items.note: 阿史那社尔以昆丘道行军大总管率铁勒十三部兵，先降焉耆，后在多褐城大破龟兹王，攻克其都，擒王及其相那利；郭孝恪在城中战死。

e.note: As commander-in-chief of the Kunqiu route expedition, Ashina She'er led troops from 13 Tiele tribes. He first forced Karasahr to submit, then crushed the king of Kucha at Duohe City, took his capital, and captured the king and his minister Nali; Guo Xiaoke was killed fighting inside the city.
e.cmd: Ashina She'er and Guo Xiaoke vs. Bai Helibushibi

items.sides: 唐 胜 车鼻可汗
items.cmd: 高侃 vs 车鼻可汗
items.note: 东突厥余部车鼻可汗据金山，拒不入朝；高侃率回纥、仆骨兵进讨，追至金山擒之。此后（663—664 年）唐以单于、瀚海二都护府分统突厥与铁勒。

e.note: Chebi Qaghan, of the remnant Eastern Turks, held the Altai Mountains and refused to come to court. Gao Kan led troops of the Huihe (Uyghurs) and Pugu against him, pursued him to the Altai Mountains and captured him. Later (663–664) Tang governed the Turks and the Tiele through two protectorates, Chanyu and Hanhai respectively.
e.cmd: Gao Kan vs. Chebi Qaghan

items.mod: 新疆阿勒泰额尔齐斯河
items.cmd: 苏定方、任雅相、萧嗣业 vs 阿史那贺鲁
items.note: 苏定方率回纥兵与燕然都护府军万余人在曳咥河西遇贺鲁十姓兵十万，唐步兵持槊据原向外列阵，骑兵阵于北原，三冲不动，乘势反击，贺鲁大败；苏定方冒大雪追击，贺鲁逃至石国被擒。

e.note: With troops of the Huihe (Uyghurs) and of the Yanran Protectorate, over 10,000 men in all, Su Dingfang met Helu's 100,000 troops of the Ten Tribes west of the Irtysh. The Tang infantry held a plain with their spears pointing outward while the cavalry formed up on the northern plain; the enemy charged three times without moving them, and the Tang then counterattacked and routed Helu. Su Dingfang pursued through heavy snow, and Helu fled to Chach, where he was captured.
e.cmd: Su Dingfang, Ren Yaxiang and Xiao Siye vs. Ashina Helu

items.cmd: 金庾信 vs 阶伯
items.note: 百济将军阶伯率五千决死之士据黄山之野，四战四胜，新罗少年花郎官昌单骑冲阵而死，新罗军士气大振，阶伯战死。

e.note: The Baekje general Gyebaek held the plain of Hwangsan with 5,000 men sworn to die and won four battles out of four. The young Silla hwarang Gwanchang charged the Baekje lines alone and was killed; this roused the Silla troops, and Gyebaek died in battle.
e.cmd: Kim Yu-sin vs. Gyebaek

items.sides: 唐·新罗 胜 百济
items.cmd: 苏定方、金庾信 vs 义慈王
items.note: 苏定方率水陆十三万自成山渡海，在熊津江口登陆，与新罗军合围泗沘，义慈王逃往熊津，后与太子扶余隆出降，百济亡。

e.note: Su Dingfang took 130,000 land and naval troops across the sea from Chengshan and landed at the mouth of the Ungjin River, then surrounded Sabi together with the Silla army. King Uija fled to Ungjin and later came out and surrendered with the crown prince Buyeo Yung, and Baekje fell.
e.sides: Tang and Silla defeated Baekje (city fell)
e.cmd: Su Dingfang and Kim Yu-sin vs. King Uija

items.cmd: 渊盖苏文 vs 庞孝泰
items.note: 唐军围平壤半年，沃沮道总管庞孝泰率岭南兵屯于蛇水之上，被渊盖苏文围攻，全军覆没，庞孝泰与其子十三人皆战死；苏定方因大雪解围而还。

e.note: The Tang army besieged Pyongyang for half a year. Pang Xiaotai, commander for the Okjeo route, camped on the Sasu River with troops from Lingnan; surrounded and attacked by Yeon Gaesomun, his whole army was wiped out, and Pang Xiaotai and his 13 sons were all killed in battle. Su Dingfang lifted the siege and withdrew because of heavy snow.
e.cmd: Yeon Gaesomun vs. Pang Xiaotai

items.cmd: 郑仁泰、薛仁贵 vs 九姓铁勒
items.note: 铁勒九姓众十余万来战，选骁健数十人挑战，薛仁贵发三箭射杀三人，余众下马请降，“将军三箭定天山，战士长歌入汉关”。但郑仁泰轻进遇大雪，士卒冻馁死者甚众。
